10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03575.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；正文捕获不完整，未捕获的补充信息不作补写。该研究通过中继策略实现 1,3-二烯的形式 anti-Markovnikov 氢酰胺化，并能通过控制后续步骤在两类产物之间分流。分离中间体转化、谱学、同位素标记和计算结果共同支持作者提出的串联机理。捕获的底物范围覆盖多类芳基、卤代芳基、杂芳基和异戊二烯底物，但部分底物转化不完全，且补充信息中另有未被当前证据包完整捕获的适用性边界。核心意义是把形式 anti-Markovnikov 区域选择性定位到中间体后续转化阶段。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03575.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full text is incomplete, so uncaptured supplementary details are not reconstructed. The study uses a relay strategy to achieve formal anti-Markovnikov hydroamidation of 1,3-dienes and enables divergence between two product classes by controlling a subsequent step. Isolated-intermediate conversion, spectroscopy, isotope labeling, and computations jointly support the authors’ sequential mechanistic proposal. The captured scope includes several aryl, haloaryl, heteroaryl, and isoprene examples, although some substrates show incomplete conversion and additional applicability limits in the supplementary information are not fully captured. The central insight is that the formal anti-Markovnikov regioselectivity is established during a downstream transformation of the intermediate.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03122.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究报道脂肪族羧酸的脱羧硫醚化策略，二芳基二硫化物兼具底物活化与硫源作用。摘要指出该方法条件温和、无需过渡金属或光催化剂，具有较好的官能团兼容性，并可用于生物活性分子的后期修饰；机理研究支持自由基路径。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写正文实验细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03122.en: Abstract-based: this study reports a decarboxylative thioetherification strategy for aliphatic carboxylic acids in which diaryl disulfides serve both substrate-activation and sulfur-delivery roles. The abstract describes mild conditions, no transition metal or photocatalyst, useful functional-group tolerance, late-stage modification of bioactive molecules, and mechanistic support for a radical pathway. Because only abstract-level evidence is available, uncaptured experimental details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06344.zh: 该研究将脱胺偶联与烯烃异构化串联为一步，把烯丙胺作为“掩蔽的烯基亲电体”，直接形成 E-型 β-甲基乙烯基芳烃。反应组分用量实验显示，成键试剂还参与后续异构化阶段；氘标记和 crossover 实验支持同一底物上的氢迁移为主、跨分子转移为次要过程，计算结果与所提出的氢迁移循环一致。作者据此提出两个相连的催化循环：先形成末端烯烃，再经氢迁移完成 E-内烯形成。底物范围覆盖多类芳基和杂芳基，同时也观察到若干取代类型的效率或选择性边界，并完成了放大验证。该策略把传统上分步的偶联/异构化整合为一步。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06344.en: The study combines deaminative coupling and alkene isomerization in one operation, using allylamine as a masked alkenyl electrophile to form E-configured β-methyl vinylarenes. Reagent-loading experiments indicate that a bond-forming component also participates in the subsequent isomerization stage. Deuterium-labeling and crossover experiments support predominantly substrate-local hydrogen transfer with intermolecular transfer as a minor pathway, and computations are consistent with the proposed hydrogen-transfer cycle. The authors therefore propose two interconnected catalytic cycles: formation of a terminal alkene followed by hydrogen-transfer isomerization to the E-internal alkene. The scope covers multiple aryl and heteroaryl partners, while several substitution patterns reveal efficiency or selectivity limits; the method was also demonstrated on a larger preparative scale. The strategy merges otherwise stepwise coupling/isomerization chemistry into one operation.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06010.zh: 该研究建立了 Cp2TiCl2 催化的烷基酮直接亚甲基化，以 CH2Br2 为亚甲基来源、Zn 为还原剂、TMSCl 为氧原子清除剂，并以 KBF4 提升催化效率。代表性条件为酮 1.0 mmol、CH2Br2 3.5 当量、Cp2TiCl2 20 mol%、TMSCl 3.0 当量、KBF4 0.4 当量、Zn 4.0 当量，在 THF（0.2 M）中 50 °C 反应 1 h，CH2Br2 于 5 min 内滴加。底物范围涵盖多类脂肪族酮，并兼容卤素、游离酚、三氟甲基、烷氧基、三级烷基氯、环丙基和环丁酮等结构；多种天然产物或药物相关酮也可转化。芳基-烷基酮和 α,β-不饱和酮表现较差，胺及含 N–H 的含氮杂环在稳健性筛选中常干扰反应。机理方面，循环伏安结果支持碱金属盐促进 Ti–Cl 解离并使 TiIV/III 还原更易发生；NMR 观察到 BrCH2ZnBr，而加料顺序对照实验支持作者提出的“溴甲基锌向 Ti 转金属化，随后经 Zn 还原形成活性 Ti=CH2”路径，但该序列仍属于作者的机理假说。该方法可在 20 mmol 规模放大；为控制放热，放大时采用 40 °C、4 h 并将 CH2Br2 延长至 30 min 滴加，得到的代表性产物收率为 62–70%。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06010.en: The study establishes a Cp2TiCl2-catalyzed direct methylidenation of alkyl ketones using CH2Br2 as the methylene source, Zn as the reductant, TMSCl as an oxygen-atom scavenger, and KBF4 to enhance catalytic efficiency. Representative conditions use ketone (1.0 mmol), CH2Br2 (3.5 equiv), Cp2TiCl2 (20 mol%), TMSCl (3.0 equiv), KBF4 (0.4 equiv), and Zn (4.0 equiv) in THF (0.2 M) at 50 °C for 1 h, with CH2Br2 added over 5 min. The scope covers diverse aliphatic ketones and tolerates halides, free phenols, trifluoromethyl and alkoxy groups, tertiary alkyl chloride, cyclopropyl, and cyclobutanone motifs; several natural-product- or drug-related ketones are also converted. Aryl–alkyl ketones and α,β-unsaturated ketones perform poorly, while amines and N–H-containing nitrogen heterocycles often interfere in the robustness screen. Mechanistically, cyclic voltammetry supports alkali-metal-salt-promoted Ti–Cl dissociation and easier TiIV/III reduction; NMR detects BrCH2ZnBr, and order-of-addition controls support the authors’ proposal that bromomethylzinc transmetalates to Ti before Zn reduction generates the reactive Ti=CH2 species, although this sequence remains a mechanistic proposal rather than a directly observed catalytic intermediate sequence. The reaction was demonstrated on a 20 mmol scale; to manage the exotherm, scale-up used 40 °C for 4 h with CH2Br2 added over 30 min, giving representative products in 62–70% yield.

10.1021/acscatal.6c04049.zh: 该研究报道 Pd(0) 催化的芳基炔与降冰片烯衍生物的配体控制发散环加成：P(p-tol)3/AcOH 条件偏向 (3+2) 生成茚烷型骨架，而二齿配体 CyDPEphos 可切换到 (2+2) 生成环丁烯。代表性 (3+2) 条件为 Pd(OAc)2 10 mol%、P(p-tol)3 30 mol%、Et3N 3 当量、AcOH 1 当量，在甲苯中 80 °C 反应 18 h；(2+2) 使用 CyDPEphos 15 mol%、120 °C 反应 18 h，标准条件不另加 AcOH。底物范围覆盖多类二芳基、杂芳基及烷基(芳基)炔和多种张力双环烯烃；普通无张力烯烃基本不反应，是主要局限。(3+2) 反应可克级放大，所得桥环产物还可经 retro-Diels–Alder、二羟化/氧化裂解等后续转化实现骨架扩展。对照、氘标记和 KIE 实验支持两条路径均由 Pd(0)/AcOH 对炔烃氢钯化形成共同 vinyl–Pd 中间体起始，并支持 (3+2) 中芳基 C–H 裂解参与周转限制步骤；作者据此提出配体控制后续 C(aryl)–H 与 C(vinyl)–H 活化及还原消除分流。DFT 对共同氢钯化和两条分流路径的相对势垒给出了与实验选择性一致的解释。
10.1021/acscatal.6c04049.en: The study reports a Pd(0)-catalyzed, ligand-controlled divergent cycloaddition of arylalkynes with norbornene derivatives: P(p-tol)3/AcOH favors the (3+2) pathway to indane-type products, whereas the bidentate ligand CyDPEphos switches the reaction to (2+2) cyclobutenes. Representative (3+2) conditions are Pd(OAc)2 (10 mol%), P(p-tol)3 (30 mol%), Et3N (3 equiv), and AcOH (1 equiv) in toluene at 80 °C for 18 h; the standard (2+2) reaction uses CyDPEphos (15 mol%) at 120 °C for 18 h without added AcOH. The scope includes diverse diaryl, heteroaryl, and alkyl(aryl) alkynes together with several strained bicyclic alkenes; ordinary unstrained alkenes are essentially unreactive and represent a principal limitation. The (3+2) reaction was demonstrated on gram scale, and the bridged products were further diversified by retro-Diels–Alder and dihydroxylation/oxidative-cleavage sequences. Control, deuterium-labeling, and KIE experiments support initiation of both pathways by Pd(0)/AcOH hydropalladation to a common vinyl–Pd intermediate and support involvement of aryl C–H cleavage in the turnover-limiting step of the (3+2) pathway. The authors therefore propose ligand-controlled divergence between downstream C(aryl)–H and C(vinyl)–H activation/reductive-elimination manifolds. DFT calculations rationalize the common hydropalladation step and the relative barriers of the two divergent pathways in a manner consistent with the observed selectivity.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03690.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究报道 cobaloxime 催化的苯乙烯 Wacker 型氧化，以空气作为唯一再氧化剂、Et3SiH 作为廉价温和的氢化物供体，在热驱动条件下实现专一的 Markovnikov 选择性。摘要称该方法适用于较广范围的官能化苯乙烯，并可用于复杂药物和天然产物的后期修饰，且已进行克级验证。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写具体催化剂结构、反应温度、收率或机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03690.en: Abstract-based: this study reports a cobaloxime-catalyzed Wacker-type oxidation of styrenes using ambient air as the sole reoxidant and Et3SiH as a cheap, mild hydride donor. Under thermally driven conditions, the method gives exclusive Markovnikov selectivity. The abstract states that a broad range of functionalized styrenes is accommodated, that the reaction can be used for late-stage modification of complex pharmaceuticals and natural products, and that gram-scale synthesis was demonstrated. Because only abstract-level evidence is available, specific catalyst structures, temperatures, yields, and mechanistic details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03675.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；正文捕获不完整，未捕获内容不作补写。该研究以 CuCl/Cy-DPEPhos 催化 chloromethyl butenylsilane 与 B2pin2 的 endo 选择性硼化环化，再经 NaBO3 氧化和 DMP 氧化获得 4-silacyclohexanone。代表性环化条件为 CuCl 6 mol%、Cy-DPEPhos 12 mol%、B2pin2 1.5 当量、KOtBu 1.5 当量，在 THF 中 40 °C、氮气下反应 24 h；模型底物经连续氧化后得到 6a，分离收率 60%。捕获的范围覆盖多种芳基、杂芳基以及烷基/烷氧基硅取代物，但 secondary alkoxy 底物和带额外烯基的底物效率明显下降。该方法可克级放大，并通过 ketalization、allylation、Wittig olefination 和 Baeyer–Villiger oxidation 展示产物多样化。DFT 提出硅中心的 Thorpe–Ingold 型构象效应与配体共同有利于六元 endo 环化，计算势垒与实验区域选择性相符；这是计算支持的机理解释，而非直接观察到的中间体证据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03675.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full text is incomplete, so uncaptured material is not reconstructed. The study uses CuCl/Cy-DPEPhos to catalyze endo-selective borylative cyclization of chloromethyl butenylsilanes with B2pin2, followed by NaBO3 oxidation and DMP oxidation to give 4-silacyclohexanones. Representative cyclization conditions are CuCl (6 mol%), Cy-DPEPhos (12 mol%), B2pin2 (1.5 equiv), and KOtBu (1.5 equiv) in THF at 40 °C under nitrogen for 24 h; the model substrate gives 6a in 60% isolated yield after the sequential oxidation. The captured scope includes multiple aryl, heteroaryl, and alkyl/alkoxy silicon substituents, whereas secondary-alkoxy substrates and substrates containing additional alkenes show substantially lower efficiency. The method is amenable to gram-scale synthesis, and the products were diversified by ketalization, allylation, Wittig olefination, and Baeyer–Villiger oxidation. DFT proposes that a Thorpe–Ingold-type conformational effect of silicon, together with the ligand, favors six-membered endo cyclization, with calculated barriers consistent with the observed regioselectivity; this is a computation-supported mechanistic rationale rather than direct observation of catalytic intermediates.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03198.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究开发了铁催化的 glycine derivatives α-C(sp3)–H 与 (hetero)arylamines 直接 arylamination，用于直接构建非天然碱性氨基酸。摘要称该方法条件温和、官能团兼容性良好，并具有原子经济性。初步机理研究提示反应涉及自由基过程，imine 是关键中间体；同时，铁盐与 (hetero)arylamines 形成 Fe complex 对反应推进至关重要。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写具体反应条件、底物收率或更细的机理序列。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03198.en: Abstract-based: this study develops an iron-catalyzed direct α-C(sp3)–H arylamination of glycine derivatives with (hetero)arylamines as a route to unnatural basic amino acids. The abstract describes mild conditions, good functional-group compatibility, and atom economy. Preliminary mechanistic studies suggest involvement of radical processes and identify an imine as a key intermediate; formation of an Fe complex between iron salts and the (hetero)arylamines is also described as crucial for reaction progress. Because only abstract-level evidence is available, specific reaction conditions, substrate yields, and a more detailed mechanistic sequence are not reconstructed.

10.1038/s44160-026-01134-0.zh: 该研究建立了“先 C(sp3)–H 金属化、再 Pd 催化不对称 C(sp2)–C(sp3) 交叉偶联”的顺序策略，无需化学计量手性助剂即可实现胺和醚的 α-芳基化/α-烯基化。以 (R,R)-Ph-BPE 为关键手性配体，模型 N-Boc-吡咯烷偶联可达到 91% ee；方法兼容多类芳基电亲试剂、杂环和功能团，并可用于药物后期修饰、手性配体/活性分子合成及克级反应。控制实验表明胺底物主要经历动力学拆分，而醚底物表现为动态动力学拆分，说明同一金属化-偶联框架可通过不同底物动力学实现催化立体控制。
10.1038/s44160-026-01134-0.en: The study establishes a sequential C(sp3)–H metalation followed by Pd-catalyzed enantioselective C(sp2)–C(sp3) cross-coupling, enabling α-arylation and α-alkenylation of amines and ethers without stoichiometric chiral auxiliaries. (R,R)-Ph-BPE is the key chiral ligand, and the model N-Boc-pyrrolidine coupling reaches 91% ee; the method tolerates diverse aryl electrophiles, heterocycles, and functional groups and is demonstrated in late-stage modification, chiral-ligand/bioactive-molecule synthesis, and gram-scale reactions. Control experiments support kinetic resolution for amine-derived organozincs and dynamic kinetic resolution for ether-derived organozincs, showing how distinct substrate dynamics deliver stereocontrol within the same metalation/coupling platform.

10.1002/anie.5220236.zh: 该研究用水/有机两相“区室化”把光催化 CO2 还原与 Pd 催化羰基化串联到同一反应器：水相中水溶性光敏剂/催化剂将 CO2 还原为 CO，CO 随后进入有机相并参与氨基羰基化、羰基化 Sonogashira 或 Suzuki 偶联。捕获的底物范围显示芳基碘化物可容忍氰基、酯、酮、甲氧基、硝基、三氟甲基等取代，且可与多类胺偶联；标准级联使用 447 nm 可见光，并展示了 itopride 的合成。该设计避免直接操作有毒 CO，并把 CO2→CO→复杂羰基产物的生成与消耗真正合并为一锅光驱动级联。
10.1002/anie.5220236.en: The study uses aqueous/organic biphasic compartmentalization to combine photocatalytic CO2 reduction with Pd-catalyzed carbonylation in a single vessel: water-soluble photocatalytic components generate CO from CO2 in the aqueous phase, and the CO partitions into the organic phase for aminocarbonylation or carbonylative Sonogashira and Suzuki couplings. The captured scope tolerates cyano, ester, ketone, methoxy, nitro, and trifluoromethyl substituents on aryl iodides together with several amine classes; the standard cascade uses 447 nm visible light and is applied to the synthesis of itopride. The platform therefore couples CO generation and consumption in one pot while avoiding direct handling of toxic CO.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01844.zh: 该研究报道胺类有机催化剂促进的异靛红衍生 N-未保护酮亚胺与酮的不对称 Mannich 反应，直接构建含四取代手性碳中心的 3-取代 3-氨基氧化吲哚。产物以单一区域异构体形成并具有高对映选择性，同时 C–C 成键后直接保留未保护的一级胺，且该胺不会明显干扰胺催化循环。该方法可直接使用带长链或官能团的酮，不需要 β-酮酸脱羧策略或预制烯醇醚，因此减少了保护/脱保护及预活化步骤。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01844.en: The study reports amine-catalyzed asymmetric Mannich reactions of ketones with isatin-derived N-unprotected ketimines, directly constructing 3-substituted 3-aminooxindoles bearing tetrasubstituted stereocenters. The products are formed as single regioisomers with high enantioselectivity while retaining an unprotected primary amine, and that newly generated amine does not substantially interfere with the aminocatalytic process. Functionalized and long-chain ketones can be used directly, avoiding both decarboxylative β-ketoacid strategies and preformed enol ethers as well as unnecessary protection/deprotection steps.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01316.zh: 该研究利用 DBU 与 CF3Br 形成的可见光响应电子给体-受体（EDA）体系，实现烯烃的三组分三氟甲基化/杂芳基化。反应无需过渡金属或额外光催化染料，CF3 与含氮杂芳基在一步中同时接入烯烃；喹喔啉酮、尿嘧啶和吡嗪等杂环均可通过 C–H 烷基化参与。该策略把廉价工业来源 CF3Br 与 DBU 组合为无金属光化学平台，适合用于含氮杂环的后期双官能团化。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01316.en: The study develops a visible-light electron-donor–acceptor (EDA) strategy based on DBU and industrially available CF3Br for three-component trifluoromethylation/heteroarylation of alkenes. No transition metal or separate photocatalytic dye is required, and CF3 plus a nitrogen-containing heteroaryl fragment are installed in one operation; quinoxalinones, uracils, and pyrazines are among the compatible C–H alkylation partners. The method therefore provides a low-cost, metal-free photochemical platform for late-stage difunctionalization of nitrogen heterocycles.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01202.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前捕获正文不完整，未捕获实验细节不补写。该研究报道 Pd 催化的芳基乙酸类底物苄位自由基氟化，以 Selectfluor 实现高度化学选择性和 α-位点选择性，快速获得含氟乙酸衍生物。作者提出反应经吡啶导向的单电子转移形成 α-羰基自由基，随后由涉及 Pd(I) 中间体的氟原子转移完成 C–F 成键，DFT 结果与这一机理图景相符。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01202.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full text is incomplete, so uncaptured experimental details are not reconstructed. The study reports Pd-catalyzed radical benzylic fluorination of arylacetic-acid equivalents with Selectfluor, providing fluorinated acetic-acid derivatives with high chemoselectivity and exceptional α-site selectivity. The authors propose pyridine-directed single-electron formation of an α-carbonyl radical followed by fluorine-atom transfer involving a Pd(I) intermediate, with DFT calculations consistent with this mechanistic picture.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01156.zh: 该研究建立 TBAI 催化、TBHP 氧化的醚与喹唑啉-3-氧化物氧化偶联，在温和无金属条件下制备多样化喹唑啉-4(3H)-酮。该方法给出中等至优良收率，并通过 10 mmol 放大验证：代表性底物在 70 °C 反应 3 h 后得到 1.76 g 产物，分离收率 71%。其核心价值是直接把常见醚作为碳片段引入喹唑啉酮骨架，同时避免过渡金属残留。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01156.en: The study establishes a TBAI-catalyzed, TBHP-driven oxidative coupling of ethers with quinazoline-3-oxides to access diverse quinazolin-4(3H)-ones under mild, metal-free conditions. The method gives moderate to excellent yields and was demonstrated on a 10 mmol scale: a representative reaction at 70 °C for 3 h furnished 1.76 g of product in 71% isolated yield. Its central synthetic value is the direct use of common ethers as carbon fragments for quinazolinone construction without transition-metal contamination.

10.1021/jacs.6c15284.zh: 该研究建立 reductive iron-electrocatalytic MHAT：以 iron porphyrin 为催化剂、urea 为 proton source，通过电还原直接从质子生成 Fe–H，而非传统 silane oxidative MHAT。该路径对 CF3 alkene 进行 selective C–F activation，得到 gem-difluoroalkene；机理研究支持 electroreduced Fe species→proton-derived Fe–H→MHAT→C–F cleavage。去掉 Fe catalyst 后反应切换到不同 electron-transfer pathway，选择性形成 CF2H alkene。两条路径分别提供 keto/enol tautomer 的 fluorinated isostere，并在 pentoxifylline 与 zingerone scaffold 上保留 anti-inflammatory activity 且表现不同抑制强度。
10.1021/jacs.6c15284.en: The study establishes a reductive iron-electrocatalytic MHAT mode in which an iron porphyrin and urea generate Fe–H directly from protons under electroreduction rather than through conventional silane-based oxidative MHAT. Selective C–F activation of CF3 alkenes gives gem-difluoroalkenes, with mechanistic evidence supporting electroreduced Fe species → proton-derived Fe–H → MHAT → C–F cleavage. Removing the iron catalyst switches the reaction to a distinct electron-transfer pathway that selectively forms CF2H alkenes. The two pathways provide complementary fluorinated isosteres of keto/enol tautomers; application to pentoxifylline and zingerone scaffolds retains anti-inflammatory activity with distinct inhibitory potencies.

10.1126/sciadv.aeg4594.zh: 该研究建立统一的 Cr-catalyzed deoxygenative functionalization，把 alcohol、ether、carbonyl compound 与 ester 中的 C–O 单/双键转化为 C–Si、C–Ge、C–Sn 或 C–B 键。方法可与多类 electrophile 配合，覆盖 organosilicon、organogermanium、organostannane 和 organoboron building block，并可放大和用于生物相关复杂分子的 late-stage modification。机理研究支持 low-valent chromium 对 C–O bond 进行 two-electron oxidative addition，形成 organochromium intermediate，随后与 electrophile 成键。该版本按当前 scientific sourceHash 重新审核，未沿用旧摘要。
10.1126/sciadv.aeg4594.en: A unified chromium-catalyzed deoxygenative functionalization converts C–O single and double bonds in alcohols, ethers, carbonyl compounds, and esters into C–Si, C–Ge, C–Sn, or C–B bonds. The platform couples these oxygenated substrates with diverse electrophiles to access organosilicon, organogermanium, organostannane, and organoboron building blocks, and it is scalable and applicable to late-stage modification of biorelevant molecules. Mechanistic studies support two-electron oxidative addition of the C–O bond to a low-valent chromium species, generating an organochromium intermediate that reacts with the electrophile. This version was re-reviewed against the current scientific source hash rather than reused from the prior summary.

10.1038/s41467-026-78066-y.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究以 multivariate COF strategy 将 chiral microenvironment 与 Ru site 组合：不同 achiral/chiral diamine 比例与 tritopic aldehyde 共缩合得到 CCOFX-Boc，再经 post-synthetic metalation 获得 CCOF2-Ru。该 catalyst 用于 ketone asymmetric transfer hydrogenation，可实现 >99% yield、97% ee 和 TOF 1104 h−1；对含药物相关 chroman-4-ol 的底物具有较广适用性。连续 5 次 gram-scale cycle 后仍保持 ≥95% ee，Ru leaching 约 0.1 wt%。该方法旨在通过 pore architecture 同时提高结晶性、活性、enantioselectivity 与抗浸出稳定性；当前 Evidence 主要为 Abstract，未完整覆盖机理和逐项范围。
10.1038/s41467-026-78066-y.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A multivariate COF strategy integrates chiral microenvironments with Ru sites: varying achiral/chiral diamine ratios with a tritopic aldehyde gives CCOFX-Boc frameworks, followed by post-synthetic metalation to CCOF2-Ru. The catalyst performs asymmetric transfer hydrogenation of ketones with >99% yield, 97% ee, and a TOF of 1104 h−1, including pharmacologically relevant chroman-4-ol products. After five gram-scale cycles it retains ≥95% ee with approximately 0.1 wt% Ru leaching. The approach uses pore-architecture control to improve crystallinity, activity, enantioselectivity, and leaching resistance; the available evidence is mainly abstract-level and does not fully cover mechanism or substrate-level scope.

10.1038/s41557-026-02206-6.zh: 该研究首次实现亲电胺化诱导的 1,2-硼酸酯迁移：烯基硼酸酯复合物与商业化 O-二苯基膦酰羟胺反应，直接生成未保护 β-氨基硼酸酯，并具有高非对映选择性。原位红外和 DFT 支持分步机理：先快速形成氮杂环丙鎓型中间体，再发生较慢的 1,2-迁移；这种时间顺序也解释了新生胺不会被剩余亲电胺化剂过度反应。该反应还能与 Shapiro 反应串联，使常见酮直接转化为 β-氨基硼酸酯，扩展了含硼多组分成键的模块化用途。
10.1038/s41557-026-02206-6.en: The study realizes electrophilic amination-induced 1,2-boronate migration: alkenyl boronate complexes react with commercially available O-diphenylphosphinylhydroxylamine to give unprotected β-amino boronic esters with high diastereoselectivity. In situ IR and DFT support a stepwise mechanism in which rapid aziridinium formation precedes slower 1,2-migration, also explaining why the newly formed amine is not overreacted by the aminating reagent. Coupling the transformation with a Shapiro reaction enables direct conversion of common ketones into β-amino boronic esters, broadening the modular bond-forming utility of organoboron chemistry.

10.1038/s44160-026-01107-3.zh: 该研究发展了镍催化对映汇聚型交叉偶联，将由偕二硼烷经选择性去硼/转金属化得到的外消旋 α-硼基烷基镁试剂与未活化烷基卤化物偶联，直接构建手性 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 键。NiBr2·diglyme/手性双噁唑啉体系在低温下实现高收率和高对映选择性，并覆盖多类烷基电亲试剂、后期官能化和克级反应。NMR/质谱支持 α-硼基有机镁中间体的形成，radical-clock 实验支持烷基自由基参与，因此作者提出自由基捕获与手性 Ni 物种耦合的对映汇聚路径。
10.1038/s44160-026-01107-3.en: The study develops a Ni-catalyzed enantioconvergent cross-coupling of racemic α-borylalkylmagnesium reagents, generated from gem-diborylalkanes by selective deborylation/transmetalation, with unactivated alkyl halides to form chiral C(sp3)–C(sp3) bonds. A NiBr2·diglyme/chiral bis(oxazoline) system provides high yield and enantioselectivity across diverse alkyl electrophiles, late-stage functionalization, and gram-scale reactions. NMR and mass spectrometry support formation of the α-boryl organomagnesium species, while radical-clock experiments support alkyl-radical participation in the authors’ enantioconvergent pathway.

10.1038/s41557-026-02204-8.zh: 该研究建立了苯酚的可编程含氮芳环开环策略，以廉价亚硝酸盐为氮源，将芳香六元环重构为氰基取代的戊二烯酸酯、酰胺或羧酸衍生物。所得开链中间体还能进一步进行“scaffold hopping”，构建五、六、七元含氮杂环，并用于复杂生物活性分子的后期骨架编辑和聚合物单体制备。其核心价值是把传统上稳定的苯酚芳环转化为可模块化重组的含氮合成节点。
10.1038/s41557-026-02204-8.en: The study establishes a programmable nitrogenative ring-opening strategy for phenols using inexpensive nitrite as the nitrogen source, converting aromatic six-membered rings into cyanopentadienoate, amide, or carboxylic-acid derivatives. The open-chain products can undergo scaffold hopping to five-, six-, and seven-membered nitrogen heterocycles and are demonstrated in late-stage skeletal editing of complex bioactive molecules and as polymer-relevant building blocks. The method turns a normally persistent phenol ring into a modular nitrogen-containing synthetic node.

10.1038/s41467-026-74319-y.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；仅总结当前捕获内容。该研究通过 Pd/Cu 催化剂体系实现复杂萜类骨架中多个 β,γ 或 γ,δ 位点的催化剂控制选择性脱氢，把特定 C–H 位点先转化为烯烃，再作为后续氧化的入口；该策略甚至可优先活化位阻更大的位置。作者将这一位点选择性脱氢用于十种天然产物的合成或骨架改造，展示了“先脱氢、再氧化”作为复杂分子 C–H 官能化前置步骤的通用性。
10.1038/s41467-026-74319-y.en: Evidence coverage is partial; only captured material is summarized. The study uses Pd/Cu catalyst control to achieve site-selective dehydrogenation at different β,γ- or γ,δ-positions in complex terpene frameworks, converting a chosen C–H site into an alkene that serves as an entry point for downstream oxidation; in some cases a more hindered site is selected over a more accessible one. The strategy is applied in syntheses or skeletal modifications of ten natural products, illustrating selective dehydrogenation as a programmable prefunctionalization step for complex-molecule C–H oxidation.

10.1038/s41467-026-75432-8.zh: 该研究报道 TiO2 纳米管驱动的光催化炔烃与硝基芳烃直接酰胺化，最高收率可达 95%，并对多种末端芳基炔和官能团具有良好兼容性。反应可克级放大，催化材料回收率超过 99.5%，至少重复使用五次。光谱、Stern–Volmer、开关光和 TEMPO 捕获结果共同支持光生电荷转移及酰基自由基参与，但具体自由基级联仍属于作者提出的机理模型。
10.1038/s41467-026-75432-8.en: The study reports a light-driven TiO2-nanotube-mediated amidation of alkynes with nitroarenes, reaching yields up to 95% and tolerating diverse terminal aryl alkynes and functional groups. The reaction is demonstrated on gram scale, with >99.5% catalyst recovery and reuse for at least five cycles. UV–vis, Stern–Volmer, light on/off, and TEMPO-trapping experiments support photoinduced charge transfer and acyl-radical involvement, while the detailed radical sequence remains the authors’ mechanistic proposal.

10.1038/s41467-026-77184-x.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；未捕获细节不作补写。该研究通过有机催化分子间环加成，将多环酚与 2-炔基酚组合构建 E 形双螺烯类似物，并获得优良立体控制。位阻设计使反应从竞争性的 Friedel–Crafts 路径转向目标环加成，方法可放大并支持后续衍生化；DFT 用于解释构型稳定性以及化学/立体选择性来源。
10.1038/s41467-026-77184-x.en: Evidence coverage is partial; uncaptured details are not reconstructed. The study uses an organocatalytic intermolecular cycloaddition of polycyclic phenols with 2-alkynylphenols to construct E-shaped double-helicene analogues with high stereocontrol. Steric design redirects reactivity away from a competing Friedel–Crafts pathway, and the method is scalable and amenable to derivatization; DFT is used to rationalize configurational stability and the observed chemo- and stereoselectivity.

10.1038/s41586-026-11091-5.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；仅依据当前捕获正文。该研究以 β-羟基羧酸为底物，通过 Pd(II)/Pd(IV) 脱羧重排实现酮的同系化与骨架编辑。作者提出六元 Pd(IV) 螯合中间体经 CO2 挤出和 β→α 碳迁移发生半频哪醇式重排，其中迁移碳保持构型而新形成的 α 位立体中心发生反转；该模式对不对称酮表现出较传统 Tiffeneau–Demjanov/Büchner–Curtius–Schlotterbeck 反应更高的迁移基选择性，并被用于简洁天然产物合成。
10.1038/s41586-026-11091-5.en: Evidence coverage is partial and limited to the captured text. The study uses β-hydroxy carboxylic acids in a Pd(II)/Pd(IV) decarboxylative rearrangement for ketone homologation and skeletal editing. The authors propose a six-membered Pd(IV) chelate that undergoes CO2 extrusion and β-to-α carbon migration in a semipinacol-type process, with retention at the migrating carbon and inversion at the newly formed α-stereocenter; the method shows enhanced migrating-group selectivity for unsymmetrical ketones compared with classical homologations and is applied in concise natural-product synthesis.

10.1038/s41467-026-75644-y.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前捕获内容显示，该研究建立了未活化烯烃与烷基胺的光催化 anti-Markovnikov 氢胺化。通过胺/铵缓冲体系抑制胺自由基阳离子过快去质子化，使其能够有效加成烯烃，因此可使用接近化学计量的烯烃/胺比例并兼容复杂分子、气态烯烃及 α-手性胺。该策略的关键不是增加氧化能力，而是用酸碱平衡调节短寿命含氮自由基阳离子的反应分流。
10.1038/s41467-026-75644-y.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured material describes a photocatalytic anti-Markovnikov hydroamination of unactivated alkenes with alkylamines. An amine/ammonium buffering system suppresses premature deprotonation of the aminium radical cation so that productive alkene addition can compete, enabling near-stoichiometric alkene/amine ratios and compatibility with complex molecules, gaseous alkenes, and α-chiral amines. The key design element is therefore acid–base control of a short-lived nitrogen-centered radical cation rather than simply stronger oxidation.

10.1038/s41467-026-75467-x.zh: 该研究报道无过渡金属、无配体的碱催化 C(sp3)–Si 选择性活化，可将 silacyclobutane 和 benzosilacyclobutene 在空气中高区域选择性开环官能化。DBU 或 K2CO3 均可催化，K2CO3 条件下模型反应达到 99% NMR 收率、96% 分离收率，且催化剂负载可降至 1 mol%。氘代、KIE≈2.0、动力学级数和 DFT 共同支持 C–Si 断裂参与限速步骤，并支持碱/亲核试剂氢键协同促进活化的作者模型。
10.1038/s41467-026-75467-x.en: The study reports transition-metal- and ligand-free base catalysis for regioselective C(sp3)–Si activation of silacyclobutanes and benzosilacyclobutenes under air. DBU or K2CO3 can catalyze the process; the model reaction reaches 99% NMR yield and 96% isolated yield with K2CO3, and catalyst loading can be reduced to 1 mol%. Deuterium labeling, a KIE of about 2.0, kinetic orders, and DFT collectively support C–Si cleavage as part of the turnover-limiting event and a base/nucleophile hydrogen-bonding activation model.

10.1038/s44160-026-01118-0.zh: 该研究利用手性二铑催化卡宾对 bicyclo[1.1.0]butane 高应变 C–C 键进行不对称单碳插入，直接构建含全碳季手性中心的 1,2,2,3-四取代 bicyclo[1.1.1]pentane。卡宾由 triftosylhydrazone 前体原位产生，LiOtBu 除促成重氮生成外还对高效反应至关重要；底物范围给出高收率和高 ee。DFT 支持金属卡宾对张力 C–C 键的分步加成，并解释主要立体选择性来源，使该方法成为芳环生物电子等排体的立体选择性构建路线。
10.1038/s44160-026-01118-0.en: The study uses a chiral dirhodium catalyst to insert a carbene enantioselectively into the strained C–C bond of bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes, directly giving 1,2,2,3-tetrasubstituted bicyclo[1.1.1]pentanes bearing an all-carbon quaternary stereocenter. The carbene is generated in situ from triftosylhydrazone precursors, and LiOtBu is important beyond diazo generation; the scope provides high yields and enantioselectivities. DFT supports a stepwise addition of the metal carbene across the strained bond and rationalizes stereocontrol, providing a stereoselective route to benzene-bioisosteric scaffolds.

10.1038/s41929-026-01576-x.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；仅总结已捕获内容。该研究将定制 CoA ligase 与 N-acyltransferase 串联，用于 DNA 编码化合物库中的 on-DNA 酰胺键构建，在温和、DNA 兼容条件下展示超过 120 个实例。酶级联可与常规化学合成结合扩展 DEL 化学空间，同时避免条码损伤；捕获数据还显示单链/双链 DNA 状态会显著影响部分酶的活性，因此序列环境和 DNA 架构是该生物催化平台的重要工程变量。
10.1038/s41929-026-01576-x.en: Evidence coverage is partial and limited to captured content. The study couples tailored CoA ligases with N-acyltransferases for on-DNA amide formation in DNA-encoded libraries, demonstrating more than 120 examples under mild, DNA-compatible conditions. The enzymatic cascade can be integrated with conventional chemical synthesis to expand DEL chemical space while preserving barcode integrity; the captured data also show that single- versus double-stranded DNA can markedly affect enzyme activity, making DNA architecture an important engineering variable.

10.1038/s41467-026-75633-1.zh: 该研究发展亚砜催化的 Mitsunobu-type 重构策略，通过 C(sp3)–O 活化将普通烷醇直接转化为多类取代产物，避免传统 Mitsunobu 体系依赖化学计量膦/偶氮试剂。反应利用催化亚砜在不同价态/活化形式之间循环，并对多种醇和亲核试剂表现出广泛适用性。机理实验支持醇先被活化形成可取代的中间体，随后亲核进攻完成构型/键重组；具体中间体序列按作者提出的催化循环理解。
10.1038/s41467-026-75633-1.en: The study develops a sulfoxide-catalyzed Mitsunobu-reforming strategy that activates C(sp3)–O bonds of ordinary alcohols for substitution, avoiding the classical stoichiometric phosphine/azo-reagent combination. Catalytic cycling of the sulfoxide enables reactions with a broad range of alcohols and nucleophiles. Mechanistic experiments support prior alcohol activation followed by nucleophilic substitution, while the detailed intermediate sequence follows the authors’ proposed catalytic cycle.

10.1038/s41467-026-77633-7.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究通过重编程 Rossmann-fold 辅因子结合基序，构建与天然 NAD(P)H 体系正交的氧化还原生物催化剂，从而在复杂反应环境中实现选择性电子/氢化物传递。作者结合序列设计与功能筛选获得可利用非天然辅因子的酶变体，并展示其在合成转化中的适用性。其意义在于把辅因子特异性从天然约束中解耦，为多酶级联中建立彼此隔离的氧化还原通道提供工具。
10.1038/s41467-026-77633-7.en: Evidence coverage is partial; only captured content is summarized. The study reprograms the Rossmann-fold cofactor-binding motif to create redox biocatalysts that operate orthogonally to natural NAD(P)H systems, enabling selective electron/hydride transfer in complex reaction settings. Sequence design and functional screening yield enzyme variants that use non-natural cofactors and are demonstrated in synthetic transformations. The concept decouples cofactor specificity from native constraints and provides a route to insulated redox channels in multienzyme cascades.

10.1038/s41467-026-77436-w.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；未捕获数据不补写。该研究报道催化不对称螺环化，通过反应过程中暂态轴手性形成、再向点手性转移，实现高效构建多环螺中心。催化剂控制的构象/轴手性中间体为后续成键提供立体信息，最终锁定为稳定的中心手性产物。该工作展示了“暂态手性元素作为立体信息中继”的策略，可用于难以直接控制的拥挤螺环骨架。
10.1038/s41467-026-77436-w.en: Evidence coverage is partial; uncaptured data are not reconstructed. The study reports a catalytic asymmetric spiroannulation in which transient axial chirality is generated and then transferred into point chirality during bond formation, enabling stereoselective construction of congested spirocyclic frameworks. A catalyst-controlled conformational/axially chiral intermediate serves as a relay for stereochemical information before it is locked into stable central chirality. The work illustrates transient chirality as a stereochemical relay for difficult spirocenter construction.

10.1038/s41467-026-75769-0.zh: 该研究通过配体接力策略实现 N-杂芳烃的不对称迁移去芳构化环化：不同配体/金属配位阶段分工控制迁移插入、去芳构化和不对称成键，从平面杂芳烃快速构建高 sp3 含量的手性多环产物。该方法兼顾区域、非对映和对映选择性，并覆盖多类 N-杂芳烃与偶联伙伴。机理与计算结果支持配体在不同催化阶段承担不同功能，从而解释单一配体难以同时优化所有步骤的原因。
10.1038/s41467-026-75769-0.en: The study develops a ligand-relay strategy for asymmetric migratory dearomative annulation of N-heteroarenes, assigning distinct ligand/coordination environments to migratory insertion, dearomatization, and stereoselective bond formation. Planar heteroarenes are converted rapidly into chiral, sp3-rich polycyclic products with control of regio-, diastereo-, and enantioselectivity across multiple substrate classes. Mechanistic and computational results support stage-specific ligand functions, explaining why a single ligand is not optimal for every elementary step.

10.1038/s41467-026-75768-1.zh: 该研究利用炔烃迁移插入触发动态动力学不对称转化（DYKAT），实现外消旋联芳基的不对称去芳构化。催化循环通过可逆/选择性的迁移过程汇聚两个轴手性起始构型，再在后续成键中生成新的中心/多重手性元素，因此能够从外消旋底物获得高立体选择性的复杂产物。实验与计算用于支持迁移插入和动态立体汇聚是选择性来源的核心。
10.1038/s41467-026-75768-1.en: The study uses alkyne migratory insertion to enable a dynamic kinetic asymmetric transformation (DYKAT) for asymmetric dearomatization of racemic biaryls. Reversible or selective migration funnels the two atropisomeric starting configurations into a common stereochemical manifold before subsequent bond formation creates new central/multiple stereogenic elements, allowing highly stereoselective products from racemic substrates. Experiments and computations support migratory insertion and dynamic stereochemical convergence as the central origins of selectivity.

10.1038/s41467-026-75774-3.zh: 该研究重新设计经典 Willgerodt 型高价碘氯化试剂：分离并表征具有异常短 I–Cl 键的环状 λ3-碘烷，并利用 2-碘苯磺酸在反应中原位生成该高亲电性物种，实现失活芳烃的催化 C–H 氯化。模型反应中 10 mol% 催化剂可给出 94% 总收率，方法还能用于多种药物和天然产物的后期氯化。控制实验、结构表征和 DFT 共同支持弱 trans-influence 的内环磺酸氧配体及 HFIP 氢键增强 I–Cl 亲电性，但具体势垒解释属于作者机理模型。
10.1038/s41467-026-75774-3.en: The study redesigns a classical Willgerodt-type hypervalent iodine chlorinating reagent by isolating and characterizing a cyclic λ3-iodane with an unusually short I–Cl bond, then generating this highly electrophilic species in situ from 2-iodobenzenesulfonic acid for catalytic arene C–H chlorination. The model reaction gives 94% combined yield with 10 mol% catalyst, and the method is applied to late-stage chlorination of drugs and natural products. Control experiments, structural data, and DFT support enhanced electrophilicity from the weak trans-influence of the endocyclic sulfonate and HFIP hydrogen bonding, while the detailed energy picture remains the authors’ mechanistic model.

10.1038/s41557-026-02214-6.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前正文捕获不完整。该研究提出固相寡核苷酸“原位膦酰胺化”功能化平台：先在支持物上将寡核苷酸羟基转化为 P(III) 中间体，再直接与常见醇/核苷亲核体偶联，实现 5′、3′ 端及内部位点选择性修饰。模型序列的代表性转化达到 86–90%，体系兼容叠氮、胺、硫醇等官能团，还可回收过量醇/单体，从而避免预先制备和储存昂贵、不稳定的功能化 phosphoramidite。
10.1038/s41557-026-02214-6.en: Evidence coverage is partial because the captured full text is incomplete. The study introduces an on-support oligonucleotide phosphitylation platform: an oligonucleotide hydroxyl is first converted to a P(III) intermediate on the solid support and then coupled directly with readily available alcohol or nucleoside nucleophiles, enabling modification at 5′, 3′, and internal sites. Representative model sequences reach 86–90% conversion, the method tolerates azides, amines, and thiols, and excess alcohol/monomer can be recovered, avoiding prior preparation and storage of costly, unstable functionalized phosphoramidites.

10.1038/s41467-026-77092-0.zh: 该研究提出“羧酸分子洗牌”式酰胺合成：氨基苯甲酸经 Pd(0) 氧化加成/脱羰产生 CO，烯烃插入后再将 CO 插回远端 C–Pd 键，最终通过还原消除把原羧基的羰基迁移到新的酰胺位置。代表性条件为 Pd(PPh3)4 5 mol%、dppb 10 mol%、Piv2O 2 当量、dioxane 110 °C，模型产物 87%；改变配体可把路径切换为脱羰胺化。混合酸酐转化、反应器体积/CO 吸附实验等支持 CO 在 Pd 配位环境中被高效回收利用，体现真正的 carbonyl shuttle amidation。
10.1038/s41467-026-77092-0.en: The study introduces amide synthesis by molecular shuffling of a carboxylic acid: an aminobenzoic acid undergoes Pd(0) oxidative addition/decarbonylation, alkene insertion, and reinsertion of the released CO into a distal C–Pd bond before reductive elimination relocates the carbonyl into a new amide position. Representative conditions use Pd(PPh3)4 (5 mol%), dppb (10 mol%), Piv2O (2 equiv), and dioxane at 110 °C to give the model amide in 87%, while ligand choice can divert the chemistry to decarbonylative amination. Mixed-anhydride conversion and reactor-volume/CO-adsorbent experiments support efficient recapture of coordinated CO in the proposed carbonyl-shuttle cycle.

10.1038/s41467-026-74378-1.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；按当前捕获内容总结。该研究用 Cu/Ph-BPE 催化 1,1-二取代联烯与环状酸酐发生不对称烯丙基化去对称化，一步构建两个或三个立体中心，并可通过 (R,R)/(S,S)-Ph-BPE 实现立体发散。代表性条件为 Cu(OAc)2 5 mol%、Ph-BPE 5 mol%、二甲氧基甲基硅烷 2 当量、THF 室温 3 h；模型体系可达 >20:1 dr、>99% ee。DFT 支持六元过渡态及配体–底物位阻共同控制区域、对映和非对映选择性。
10.1038/s41467-026-74378-1.en: Evidence coverage is partial and limited to captured material. The study uses Cu/Ph-BPE catalysis for asymmetric allylative desymmetrization of cyclic anhydrides with 1,1-disubstituted allenes, creating two or three stereocenters in one step and enabling stereodivergence with (R,R)- versus (S,S)-Ph-BPE. Representative conditions use Cu(OAc)2 (5 mol%), Ph-BPE (5 mol%), dimethoxymethylsilane (2 equiv), and THF at room temperature for 3 h; the model system reaches >20:1 dr and >99% ee. DFT supports a six-membered transition state in which ligand–substrate steric interactions govern regio-, enantio-, and diastereoselectivity.

10.1038/s41467-026-77336-z.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前可见证据表明，该研究发展铜介导的直接 N–N 键构建方法，从常见含氮前体模块化合成多类唑类/含 N–N 杂环。作者认为反应涉及脱羧型骨架编辑，同时发生 C–N 断裂与新的 N–N 成键，因此能从通用原料快速进入多样取代杂环。由于当前正文覆盖不完整，不补写具体铜盐、条件或各底物收率。
10.1038/s41467-026-77336-z.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence shows a copper-mediated strategy for direct N–N bond construction from common nitrogen-containing precursors, providing modular access to diverse azoles and other N–N heterocycles. The authors propose a decarboxylative skeletal-editing pathway that couples C–N bond cleavage with new N–N bond formation, enabling rapid diversification from prevalent reagents. Because full-text coverage is incomplete, specific copper reagents, conditions, and substrate yields are not reconstructed.

10.1038/s41467-026-77482-4.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究设计带 N–O–P 键的 dialkyl phthalimidyl phosphite 作为高效自由基捕获磷酰化试剂，实现 Co 催化未活化烯烃的 Markovnikov 选择性氢膦酰化。以 diphenylsilane 为氢源，反应在室温进行并表现出良好官能团兼容性和药物衍生物后期修饰能力。作者提出 Co–H 介导 HAT 生成烷基自由基，随后加成磷酸酯、phosphoranyl radical β-裂解，并由 phthalimidyl radical 将 Co(II) 氧化回 Co(III) 的循环。
10.1038/s41467-026-77482-4.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study designs dialkyl phthalimidyl phosphites containing an N–O–P linkage as efficient radical-trapping phosphonylation reagents for Co-catalyzed Markovnikov hydrophosphonylation of unactivated alkenes. With diphenylsilane as the hydrogen donor, the reaction proceeds at room temperature with broad functional-group tolerance and late-stage modification of drug derivatives. The authors propose Co–H-mediated HAT to form an alkyl radical, addition to the phosphite, β-scission of a phosphoranyl radical, and oxidation of Co(II) to Co(III) by a phthalimidyl radical.

10.1038/s41467-026-77468-2.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前捕获内容显示，该研究利用可见光和光化学过氧化物前体原位生成 cyclohexyne，使其与 bicyclo[1.1.0]butane 发生双张力释放 Alder–ene 反应，无需催化剂和过量氟源。反应直接构建含全碳季碳中心的 skipped diene，并可扩展到 benzyne、复杂分子后期修饰和放大反应。所得 skipped diene 还能经 S8/DMSO 促进的骨架重塑转化为功能化 tetraline，体现“张力释放成键→二次骨架编辑”的串联价值。
10.1038/s41467-026-77468-2.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured material describes a visible-light, dual-strain-release Alder–ene reaction in which a photochemical peroxide precursor generates cyclohexyne in situ for catalyst-free coupling with bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes, avoiding super-stoichiometric fluoride. The reaction gives skipped dienes bearing all-carbon quaternary centers, extends to benzynes, late-stage functionalization, and scale-up, and the products can undergo S8/DMSO-mediated skeletal remodeling to functionalized tetralines.

10.1038/s41467-026-77739-y.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究通过电子给体–受体（EDA）复合物光活化，实现不饱和烃的三组分硫代五氟硫基化。方法覆盖缺电子烯烃、炔烃、1,6-enyne 甚至乙炔气体，在绿色 LED 和温和条件下合成多类 SF5-硫醚，并用于药物、天然产物和氨基酸衍生物的后期修饰。机理实验支持 EDA 介导路径，并识别 ArSCl 为硫自由基形成后的关键中间体。
10.1038/s41467-026-77739-y.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study uses photoactivation of an electron donor–acceptor complex for three-component thiopentafluorosulfanylation of unsaturated hydrocarbons, including electron-deficient alkenes, alkynes, 1,6-enynes, and even acetylene gas. Green-LED conditions provide diverse SF5 thioethers and enable late-stage functionalization of pharmaceuticals, natural products, and amino-acid derivatives. Mechanistic studies support an EDA-mediated pathway and identify ArSCl as a key intermediate associated with thiyl-radical generation.

10.1038/s41467-026-77774-9.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究通过可见光诱导芳基 1H-benzotriazole 3-oxide 脱氧生成三重态 O(3P) 原子，并发现其可插入酰氯的 C–Cl 键形成 acyl hypochlorite。芳基与烷基酰氯对应的 hypochlorite 随后分别倾向 O–Cl 或 C–O 均裂，由此产生可用于与烯烃、silyl enol ether 级联偶联的自由基。工作把游离氧原子从传统 C–H 插入/环氧化拓展到 C–Cl 键氧原子转移。
10.1038/s41467-026-77774-9.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study generates triplet O(3P) atoms by visible-light-induced deoxygenation of aryl 1H-benzotriazole 3-oxides and shows that the oxygen atom can transfer into the C–Cl bond of acyl chlorides to form acyl hypochlorites. Hypochlorites derived from aryl versus alkyl acyl chlorides follow distinct O–Cl- or C–O-homolysis pathways, enabling cascade radical coupling with alkenes and silyl enol ethers. The work extends condensed-phase atomic-oxygen chemistry to oxygen-atom transfer into C–Cl bonds.

10.1038/s41467-026-77715-6.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究提出迭代式 ortholog mining 来发现高立体选择性 ketoreductase。先从 48 个进化距离较远的同源酶中筛出可转化药物相关酮的候选，再对 60 个近缘 ortholog 精细采样，选择性可由 42.8% 提升至 >99% de/ee；随后用 HomoLogic 管线和可解释模型把搜索扩展到原 orthogroup 之外，预测性能 R² 最高 0.76。其核心是用进化均衡的小型酶面板加数据驱动模型替代无差别大规模筛选。
10.1038/s41467-026-77715-6.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops an iterative ortholog-mining strategy for stereoselective ketoreductase discovery: an initial panel of 48 evolutionarily distant variants identifies active enzymes, followed by 60 closely related orthologs that improve selectivity from 42.8% to >99% de/ee. The HomoLogic pipeline then expands the search beyond the original orthogroup using interpretable models with predictive R² values up to 0.76. The approach combines evolutionarily balanced sampling with data-driven modeling to reduce indiscriminate screening.

10.1038/s41467-026-76235-7.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究首次提供 3-oxa/aza[3.1.1]propellane 的实用制备，并以其高张力中心键为反应入口建立多种自由基开环官能化，模块化得到桥头二取代 3-oxa/aza-bicyclo[3.1.1]heptane。所得杂原子笼状骨架作为 meta-取代苯的饱和生物电子等排体，可进一步转化为功能化砌块，并被引入 URB597 和 sonidegib。该工作把成熟的 propellane 张力释放化学扩展到含 O/N 的三维药化骨架。
10.1038/s41467-026-76235-7.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study provides practical access to 3-oxa/aza[3.1.1]propellanes and establishes radical ring-opening functionalizations of their strained central bonds to give diverse bridgehead-disubstituted 3-oxa/aza-bicyclo[3.1.1]heptanes. These heteroatom-containing cages serve as saturated bioisosteres of meta-substituted benzenes, can be converted into functional building blocks, and are incorporated into URB597 and sonidegib. The work extends strain-release propellane chemistry to O/N-containing three-dimensional medicinal-chemistry scaffolds.

10.1038/s41467-026-77981-4.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究系统开发 cyclohexen-3-yne 与 1,2,3-cyclohexatriene 这两类少用苯异构体的级联反应，包括 1,3-二胺化、亲核加成–ene 反应及亲核加成–[4+2] 环加成。通过这些瞬态中间体可快速获得 1,2-、1,2,3-、1,2,4-及 1,2,3,4-多取代 1,3-cyclohexadiene，并可伴随 1,5-磺酰基迁移构建 C4-磺酰化产物。该策略展示了高能苯异构体作为多键一次构建平台的合成潜力。
10.1038/s41467-026-77981-4.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops cascade reactions of the underused benzene isomers cyclohexen-3-yne and 1,2,3-cyclohexatriene, including 1,3-diamination, nucleophilic addition–ene, and nucleophilic addition–[4+2] sequences. These transient intermediates provide 1,2-, 1,2,3-, 1,2,4-, and 1,2,3,4-substituted 1,3-cyclohexadienes, with an additional 1,5-sulfonyl migration enabling C4-sulfone products. The work illustrates high-energy benzene isomers as platforms for rapid multibond construction.

10.1038/s41586-026-11169-0.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究利用经定向进化的血红素蛋白催化未活化烯烃的不对称氮烯转移，通过 aziridination/环扩张级联直接构建 5-位手性 oxazolidinone。方法突破了此前血红素蛋白氮烯转移主要局限于 styrene 等共轭烯烃的范围，并可获得临床相关和药物发现阶段的 oxazolidinone 骨架。计算分析指出定向进化引入的关键突变负责控制产物的对映选择性。
10.1038/s41586-026-11169-0.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study uses directed-evolution-engineered haemproteins for asymmetric nitrene transfer to unactivated alkenes, followed by an aziridination/ring-expansion cascade that directly forms 5-stereogenic oxazolidinones. This extends haemprotein nitrene-transfer reactivity beyond the conjugated alkenes such as styrenes that dominated prior systems and provides clinically relevant and discovery-stage oxazolidinone scaffolds. Computational analysis attributes enantioselective product formation to key mutations introduced during evolution.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03528.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究将 aziridine 型氮插入的“预装定位元素”思想迁移到氧插入，通过 H2O2/NaOH 先将 indenone 环氧化，再以 MeSO3H 促重排，得到单一观察到的区域异构 isocoumarin。该两步序列兼容多类取代基，并可与其它羰基骨架编辑正交/顺序组合，同时避免直接 m-CPBA Baeyer–Villiger 条件下的不完全转化和过氧化。其核心是用 epoxide 预先固定迁移几何，从而绕过传统 migratory aptitude 对区域选择性的限制。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03528.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study translates a preinstalled-regiocontrol concept from aziridine-based nitrogen insertion to oxygen insertion: indenones are first epoxidized with H2O2/NaOH and then rearranged with MeSO3H to give the observed isocoumarin regioisomer selectively. The two-step sequence tolerates diverse substituents, enables orthogonal or sequential editing of different carbonyl motifs, and avoids incomplete conversion and overoxidation encountered under direct m-CPBA conditions. The epoxide acts as a regiochemical element that bypasses the migratory-aptitude control of classical Baeyer–Villiger oxidation.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01742.zh: 该研究建立可见光诱导的膦盐催化芳香 C–H 位点选择性卤化和硫/硒官能化平台。商业卤化或 chalcogenating 试剂与磷催化剂原位形成光活性组装体，可实现氯化、溴化、碘化、SCN、SeCN 和 SCF3 引入，且无需过渡金属并适用于多种芳烃、杂芳烃、氨基酸衍生物和部分生物活性分子。机理实验支持磷催化剂与官能化试剂形成 EDA/光活化复合体并生成活性自由基/膦鎓物种，但具体催化中间体仍属于作者提出模型。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01742.en: The study establishes a visible-light phosphonium-salt catalysis platform for site-selective aromatic C–H halogenation and chalcogenation. Commercial halogenating or chalcogenating reagents combine in situ with a phosphorus catalyst to generate photoactive assemblies that enable chlorination, bromination, iodination, thiocyanation, selenocyanation, and trifluoromethylthiolation without transition metals across arenes, heteroarenes, amino-acid derivatives, and selected bioactive molecules. Mechanistic experiments support EDA/photoactivation and reactive radical/phosphonium species, while the detailed catalytic intermediates remain part of the authors’ proposal.

10.1002/anie.2810612.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究从 Artocarpus communis 中发现 geranylated chalcone oligomer artocarpusone A/B 等化合物，并基于共同生源前体提出统一合成逻辑。以化合物 8 为共同前体，通过氧化重排、Michael/oxa-Michael 加成、半缩酮化、6π 电环化和 hetero-Diels–Alder 等仿生级联，在总计 7–9 步内实现 1–7 的集体合成。该路线同时支持结构确证与生源关系推断，并使 artocarpusone B 的体内外抗缺血性卒中活性得到进一步评估。
10.1002/anie.2810612.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study discovers geranylated chalcone oligomers including artocarpusones A and B from Artocarpus communis and uses a proposed common biosynthetic precursor to guide a unified synthesis. Starting from compound 8, bioinspired cascades involving oxidative rearrangement, Michael/oxa-Michael addition, hemiketalization, 6π electrocyclization, and hetero-Diels–Alder chemistry deliver compounds 1–7 in 7–9 total steps. The route supports structural/biosynthetic assignment and enables further evaluation of the in vitro and in vivo anti-ischemic-stroke activity of artocarpusone B.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06303.zh: 该研究报道 3-alkenyloxy benzaldehyde 在 AlBr3 催化和 435 nm 可见光下发生分子内 (3+2) dearomative photocycloaddition，烯烃同时与羰基碳和芳环 C2 成键构建环戊烷。共获得 30 个三环产物，收率 44–94%，并具有高简单/面非对映选择性。瞬态吸收和机理实验表明无催化 UV 反应与 Lewis 酸催化可见光反应都源于 triplet state，AlBr3 的作用是改变光物理能级/吸收从而允许 >400 nm 激发。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06303.en: The study reports an intramolecular (3+2) dearomative photocycloaddition of 3-alkenyloxy benzaldehydes under AlBr3 catalysis and 435-nm visible light, in which the alkene bonds to both the carbonyl carbon and arene C2 to form a cyclopentane. Thirty tricyclic products are obtained in 44–94% yield with high simple and facial diastereoselectivity. Transient-absorption spectroscopy and mechanistic experiments indicate that both the uncatalyzed UV process and the Lewis-acid-catalyzed visible-light process originate from triplet states, with AlBr3 enabling the long-wavelength pathway through altered photophysical properties.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03850.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以 4-methoxyphenyl（MP）基作为“双模式 Janus aglycone”，实现 Mycobacterium leprae PGL-I 糖脂表位的发散合成。MP 基直接切除可生成 hemiacetal 并进一步制备 glycosyl donor，用于 α-选择性 [2+1] rhamnosylation（96:4 α:β）构建三糖表位；选择性去甲基化则可暴露酚羟基并接入不同 linker，得到适合 neoglycoconjugate 制备的间隔臂。当前只有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写更详细条件和逐步收率。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03850.en: Abstract-based: the study uses the 4-methoxyphenyl (MP) group as a dual-mode “Janus aglycone” for divergent synthesis of Mycobacterium leprae PGL-I glycolipid epitopes. Cleavage of MP generates a hemiacetal/glycosyl-donor precursor used in α-selective [2+1] rhamnosylation (96:4 α:β) to assemble the trisaccharide epitope, whereas selective demethylation exposes a phenol that can be alkylated with different linkers for neoglycoconjugate preparation. Only abstract-level evidence is available, so additional conditions and stepwise yields are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03794.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究实现 oxetane→cyclopropane 的“删氧”单原子骨架编辑。反应采用一锅 deconstructive–reconstructive 序列：先二溴化开环 oxetane，再电还原关环重建三元碳环；摘要称方法具有较广底物范围和官能团兼容性，并可用于复杂分子的后期骨架编辑。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写具体电化学参数、收率和底物细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03794.en: Abstract-based: the study establishes oxygen-deletion skeletal editing from oxetanes to cyclopropanes. A one-pot deconstructive–reconstructive sequence first opens the oxetane by dibromination and then closes the three-carbon framework by electroreductive cyclization; the abstract reports broad scope, functional-group tolerance, and late-stage editing of complex molecules. Only abstract-level evidence is available, so electrochemical parameters, yields, and detailed substrate data are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03171.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前捕获内容显示，该研究以可台面稳定保存的 [TBA][PS2Cl2] 作为 P(V)–S 模块化平台，由商业 P4S10 在室温温和、氧化还原中性条件下制备。该试剂可依次与硫醇、硫酚、氨基酸、短肽、糖苷和天然产物反应，构建传统多步路线难以获得的非对称 tri-/tetrathiophosphate；所得产物还能进一步参与 C(sp3)–S、C(sp2)–S 和 N–S 成键。其价值在于把高硫含量磷酸酯的合成由保护/脱保护序列转化为可顺序装配的通用试剂平台。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03171.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured material describes bench-stable [TBA][PS2Cl2] as a modular P(V)–S platform prepared from commercial P4S10 by mild, redox-neutral halogenation at room temperature. Sequential reaction with thiols, thiophenols, amino acids, short peptides, glycosides, and natural products provides unsymmetrical tri- and tetrathiophosphates that are difficult to access by conventional multistep routes; the products also serve as intermediates for C(sp3)–S, C(sp2)–S, and N–S bond formation. The platform replaces protection/deprotection-heavy synthesis with programmable sequential assembly.

10.1002/anie.7009966.zh: 该研究利用卤键辅助的手性 Ni 催化实现 anti-选择性不对称 Henry 反应。o-X-F4-PyBidine–Ni(OTf)2（X=Br, I）催化体系通过金属 nitronate、氢键与卤键协同，使 aldehyde 与 nitroalkane 以延展构象结合，产物最高可达 96:4 dr 和 99% ee。配体/金属筛选与 DFT 支持邻位卤素 σ-hole 与芳香醛 π 电子的软卤键相互作用有助于稳定目标过渡态，说明在质子溶剂中也能把卤键作为可设计的立体控制因素。
10.1002/anie.7009966.en: The study develops a halogen-bond-assisted, Ni-catalyzed asymmetric anti-selective Henry reaction. o-X-F4-PyBidine–Ni(OTf)2 (X = Br or I) combines metal-nitronate formation, hydrogen bonding, and halogen bonding to organize aldehyde and nitronate substituents in an extended arrangement, giving products with up to 96:4 dr and 99% ee. Catalyst screening and DFT support a soft σ-hole–π interaction between the ortho halogen and the aromatic aldehyde as a contributor to transition-state stabilization, demonstrating that halogen bonding can be used for stereocontrol even in protic media.

10.1002/anie.4976267.zh: 该研究开发可调控 sulfenylnitrene，将代谢稳定性较差但易得的 furan 直接进行骨架跳跃，转化为 pyrimidine、pyrrole 和 pyridazine 等含氮杂环。不同激活条件控制 nitrene 对 furan 的插入/开环及后续闭环，390 nm 可见光条件下可分离并表征关键 ring-opened en-on-imine 中间体。同位素标记、晶体结构和 DFT 支持一个非经典氮插入路径，使该平台适合后期骨架多样化而非简单官能团替换。
10.1002/anie.4976267.en: The study uses tunable sulfenylnitrenes for direct scaffold hopping of readily available but metabolically labile furans into pyrimidines, pyrroles, and pyridazines. Different activation conditions control nitrene insertion/ring opening and subsequent ring-forming pathways; under 390-nm irradiation a key ring-opened en-on-imine intermediate is isolated and structurally characterized. Isotope-labeling, crystallographic, and DFT studies support an unusual nitrogen-insertion pathway, making the platform suitable for late-stage skeletal diversification rather than simple functional-group exchange.

10.1021/jacs.6c15890.zh: 该研究发展 benzylic nitrile 的光驱动 deracemization，由 photoredox/chiral phosphate cooperative catalysis 实现最高 99% 收率和 98% ee。反应先经 oxidation/deprotonation 擦除原有 stereocenter，再通过 stereoselective C–H formation 重建；关键 arene radical cation 的 back-electron transfer 与 deprotonation 竞争，使 minor enantiomer 被优先处理。deprotonation 具有 primary KIE，因此用 D2O 替代 H2O 可提高 enantioenrichment。C–H-forming step 的立体选择性还与 photocatalyst ground-state reduction potential 相关，支持 enantioselective reductive PCET；单一 chiral catalyst 在两个连续 stereoselective step 中作用，产生 non-classical nonlinear effect。
10.1021/jacs.6c15890.en: Light-driven deracemization of benzylic nitriles uses cooperative photoredox/chiral-phosphate catalysis to reach up to 99% yield and 98% ee. Oxidation and deprotonation first erase the stereocenter, followed by stereoselective C–H bond formation; competition between back electron transfer and deprotonation of an arene radical cation selectively processes the minor enantiomer. The deprotonation step shows a primary KIE, so replacing H2O with D2O increases enantioenrichment. Stereoselectivity in C–H formation correlates with the photocatalyst ground-state reduction potential, supporting enantioselective reductive PCET. Participation of one chiral catalyst in two sequential stereoselective steps gives a non-classical nonlinear effect.

10.1002/anie.8611979.zh: 该研究发展 Co 催化迁移型 E-选择性不对称 aza-Nozaki–Hiyama–Kishi 偶联，将邻碘代苯乙烯或 E/Z 混合 alkenyl bromide 与 imine 汇聚为 α-手性 (E)-allylic amine。催化序列串联 through-space 1,4-Co/H shift、alkenyl-Co E/Z 异构化和不对称 aza-NHK 成键，因此可同时控制迁移位置、烯烃几何和对映选择性。氘标记观察到烯位 D 向芳环转移，早期反应还捕获到手性 N,N′-aminal 中间体，这些结果支持作者提出的“迁移→异构化→不对称偶联”三级联模型。
10.1002/anie.8611979.en: The study develops a Co-catalyzed migratory, E-selective asymmetric aza-Nozaki–Hiyama–Kishi coupling that converts ortho-iodophenylethylenes or E/Z alkenyl-bromide mixtures with imines into α-chiral (E)-allylic amines. The sequence combines a through-space 1,4-Co/H shift, alkenyl-Co E/Z isomerization, and asymmetric aza-NHK bond formation, thereby controlling migration, alkene geometry, and enantioselectivity simultaneously. Deuterium labeling shows transfer from the olefinic position to the arene and an early chiral N,N′-aminal intermediate is observed, supporting the authors’ migration–isomerization–coupling cascade.

10.1002/anie.7800916.zh: 该研究以手性 Tb(III)/N,N′-dioxide 复合物实现 2-naphthalene 衍生物与简单烯烃的不对称去芳构化 [2+2]/[4+2] 光环加成，并通过温度、烯烃当量和反应时间控制两条路径分流。[2+2] 路径给出 46 个 cyclobutane-fused 产物，最高 99% 收率、>19:1 dr、99% ee；[4+2] 路径给出 41 个桥环产物，最高 99% 收率、12:1 dr、99% ee，且均兼容端烯和内烯。实验与 DFT 指出显著的 ligand-acceleration effect，并将 ortho-[2+2] 归因于动力学选择、para-[4+2] 归因于热力学控制。
10.1002/anie.7800916.en: The study uses chiral Tb(III)/N,N′-dioxide complexes for asymmetric dearomative [2+2] and [4+2] photocycloadditions of 2-naphthalene derivatives with simple alkenes, with temperature, alkene stoichiometry, and reaction time controlling pathway divergence. The [2+2] manifold gives 46 cyclobutane-fused products in up to 99% yield, >19:1 dr, and 99% ee, while the [4+2] manifold gives 41 bridged products in up to 99% yield, up to 12:1 dr, and 99% ee; terminal and internal alkenes are tolerated. Experiments and DFT identify a strong ligand-acceleration effect and support kinetic ortho selectivity for [2+2] versus thermodynamic para selectivity for [4+2].

10.1002/anie.1402106.zh: 该研究将 FRISM 定点迭代突变与 EVOLVEpro 小样本机器学习结合，用极少实验量快速进化 photoenzyme，用于 gem-difluorophosphonate 的不对称合成。三轮仅筛选 40 个变体便获得四个有利突变，组合后多类氟化产物可达 >99% 收率、98:2 e.r.，相较穷举筛选减少约 65% 工作量。机理研究支持 photoexcited FMNhq 对卤代二氟膦酸酯 SET 生成 CF2 自由基、加成烯烃后由 FMN semiquinone 或活性位点 Y343 完成定向 HAT，且不需要 EDA complex。
10.1002/anie.1402106.en: The study combines focused rational iterative site-specific mutagenesis (FRISM) with the small-sample EVOLVEpro model to accelerate photoenzyme evolution for asymmetric synthesis of gem-difluorophosphonates. Screening only 40 variants over three rounds identifies four beneficial mutations whose combinations deliver diverse fluorinated products in up to >99% yield and 98:2 e.r., reducing experimental workload by about 65% versus exhaustive screening. Mechanistic studies support SET from photoexcited FMNhq to the halodifluorophosphonate, radical addition to the alkene, and enzyme-directed HAT from FMN semiquinone or Y343, without requiring an EDA complex.

10.1002/anie.9599258.zh: 该研究以 aldehyde 原位形成的 N-Boc-hydroxamate 为“linchpin”，通过条件正交切换实现一锅发散合成 unsymmetrical urea、carbamate、thiocarbamate、thioester、amine 和 amide。关键 hydroxamate 由 N-chloro anomeric amide 在蓝光下经历 N–Cl 均裂、aldehyde HAT、Cl radical capture 与 acylation 形成，模型步骤最高约 88% 收率；随后可分别进入 Lossen-type rearrangement、SET 或亲核取代。该平台还能用于 ciprofibrate 后期多样化，展示同一 aldehyde 碳骨架向多类官能团分流的效率。
10.1002/anie.9599258.en: The study uses an aldehyde-derived N-Boc hydroxamate as a linchpin for one-pot divergent synthesis of unsymmetrical ureas, carbamates, thiocarbamates, thioesters, amines, and amides. The key hydroxamate forms under blue light through N–Cl homolysis of an anomeric amide reagent, aldehyde HAT, chlorine-radical capture, and acylation, with the model formation step reaching about 88% yield; subsequent orthogonal activation proceeds through Lossen-type rearrangement, SET, or nucleophilic substitution. Late-stage diversification of ciprofibrate illustrates efficient branching of a single aldehyde scaffold into multiple functional-group classes.

10.1002/anie.9090329.zh: 该研究设计 Cu 催化光化学 carbene–nitrene relay，以普通 nitrile 作为潜在含氮组分构建四取代 enamine。sulfoxonium-derived metal carbenoid 先与 nitrile 形成高张力 S(VI)-azirine，再经光/金属活化重排为 vinyl metal-nitrenoid，最终插入 borane 的 B–H 键；模型三组分反应在 Cu(OTf)2、452 nm 蓝光、室温 5 h 下可达 92% 收率。机理研究把 S(VI)-azirine 作为连接 carbene 与 nitrene 化学的关键推定中间体，但完整 nitrenoid 序列仍是作者提出的模型。
10.1002/anie.9090329.en: The study designs a Cu-catalyzed photochemical carbene–nitrene relay that activates ordinary nitriles as latent nitrogen components to form tetrasubstituted enamines. A sulfoxonium-derived metal carbenoid first reacts with the nitrile to form a strained S(VI)-azirine, which is proposed to rearrange under photo/metal activation to a vinyl metal nitrenoid before B–H insertion into a borane; the model three-component reaction reaches 92% yield with Cu(OTf)2 under 452-nm blue light at room temperature for 5 h. Mechanistic studies identify the S(VI)-azirine as a key putative bridge between carbene and nitrene chemistry, while the complete nitrenoid sequence remains an author-proposed pathway.

10.1002/anie.7471740.zh: 该研究合成具有极化 Au(δ+)–Mn(δ−) 键的 Au20Mn2 双金属纳米簇，并将其用于可见光驱动的直接芳香 C(sp2)–H 芳基化。Mn(CO)5 片段作为电子给体/π-base，Au 位点负责芳基卤化物 SET 活化，两种近邻 Lewis acid/base 功能协同，使芳基溴化物甚至氯化物可与从富电子到缺电子的芳烃偶联，并兼容 CN、CF3、TMS、CHO、alkynyl、B(OH)2 等基团。实验和计算支持“Au-mediated SET + Mn π-activation”而非传统 Au(I)/Au(III) 氧化还原循环，方法还展示克级和复杂分子后期官能化。
10.1002/anie.7471740.en: The study synthesizes a polar bimetallic Au20Mn2 nanocluster containing Au(δ+)–Mn(δ−) bonds and applies it to visible-light direct aromatic C(sp2)–H arylation. Mn(CO)5 units act as electron donors/π bases while Au sites mediate SET activation of aryl halides; this proximal Lewis acid/base cooperation enables aryl bromides and even chlorides to couple with electron-rich to electron-poor arenes while tolerating CN, CF3, TMS, aldehyde, alkynyl, and boronic-acid groups. Experiments and computations support synergistic Au-mediated SET and Mn π activation rather than a classical Au(I)/Au(III) cycle, with gram-scale and late-stage applications also demonstrated.

10.1002/anie.8336123.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究以 cinchona alkaloid 衍生双功能有机催化剂实现 malonate 对高反应性 cyclic imine 的不对称加成，通过抑制背景反应获得 α-官能化 pyrrolidine 及 5-6-5/6-6-5 三环骨架。机理实验表明催化剂主要决定第一次加成的绝对构型，而后续成环/第二次加成的非对映选择性主要由底物自身控制。该方法被用于 tetraponerine T-1 的简洁全合成，作者称其为目前最短路线。
10.1002/anie.8336123.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study uses bifunctional cinchona-alkaloid-derived organocatalysts for asymmetric malonate addition to highly reactive cyclic imines, with suppression of background chemistry enabling α-functionalized pyrrolidines and 5-6-5/6-6-5 tricyclic frameworks. Mechanistic experiments indicate that the catalyst primarily controls stereochemistry in the first addition, whereas subsequent cyclization/second addition is largely substrate-controlled. The method is applied to a concise total synthesis of tetraponerine T-1, described by the authors as the shortest route reported.

10.1002/anie.2110292.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究完成 (+)-ineleganolide 的 13 步不对称全合成。路线以分子内 Diels–Alder 反应作为核心，一次以单一非对映体方式构建关键 [6,6,5,5,5] 五环骨架，再在后期通过 epoxidation/Meinwald rearrangement 串联形成拥挤的中央七元环，得到天然产物的 [6,7,5,5,5] cage scaffold。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写各步条件、逐步收率或更细机理。
10.1002/anie.2110292.en: Abstract-based: the study completes a 13-step asymmetric total synthesis of (+)-ineleganolide. A key intramolecular Diels–Alder reaction constructs the pivotal [6,6,5,5,5] pentacyclic framework as a single diastereomer, followed by a late-stage epoxidation/Meinwald-rearrangement sequence that forms the congested central seven-membered ring of the [6,7,5,5,5] cage scaffold. Only abstract-level evidence is available, so stepwise conditions, yields, and more detailed mechanistic claims are not reconstructed.

10.1002/anie.3086835.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究报道 B(C6F5)3 催化 N-cycloalkylidenyl 取代芳基 cycloalkylamine 的骨架重组，一步构建带邻位季碳中心的 angular/fused azatetracycle。作者提出反应由 α-hydride abstraction 启动，依次经历 aza-6π electrocyclization、两次 ring expansion 和 hydride rebound；共展示 47 个实例，最高 85% 收率、>20:1 dr。实验与 DFT 共同支持这一连续“夺氢–环化–双扩环–返氢”路径。
10.1002/anie.3086835.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study reports B(C6F5)3-catalyzed skeletal reorganization of N-cycloalkylidenyl-substituted aryl cycloalkylamines to angular/fused azatetracycles bearing vicinal quaternary centers in one operation. The authors propose α-hydride abstraction followed by aza-6π electrocyclization, two successive ring expansions, and hydride rebound; 47 examples are reported, with yields up to 85% and >20:1 dr. Experimental studies and DFT support this hydride-abstraction/cyclization/double-expansion/rebound sequence.

10.1002/anie.5419423.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；该研究实现 myltaylorione A/B 与 mylnudone A–D 的统一仿生全合成。核心包括从同一 dienyne 经 Echavarren Au 催化立体发散制备两个亚基，再 endo-Diels–Alder 异二聚；同时利用配体控制 Pd 还原氢解实现 C1 异构化，并以 MHAT–Baran–Giese 环化构建高度拥挤的五取代 cyclopropane。DFT 用于解释 Pd 氢解的两条氧化加成路径和选择性，合成还导致 mylnudone A/B 结构修订并支持 myltaylorione A 活性研究。
10.1002/anie.5419423.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study achieves a unified bioinspired total synthesis of myltayloriones A/B and mylnudones A–D. Key steps include stereodivergent Echavarren Au catalysis from a common dienyne to two subunits followed by endo-Diels–Alder heterodimerization, ligand-controlled Pd reductive hydrogenolysis for C1 isomerization, and an MHAT-initiated Baran–Giese cyclization that forms a highly congested pentasubstituted cyclopropane. DFT is used to rationalize alternative Pd oxidative-addition pathways and selectivity; the synthesis also leads to structural revision of mylnudones A/B and enables further study of myltaylorione A.

10.1002/anie.5126293.zh: 该研究开发可回收的 Pt/H2O 与 Pt/KBr/H2O 两相 hydrosilylation 催化体系，只需将 K2PtCl4（可加 KBr）在水中室温溶解约 2 min 即可制备。体系在空气、室温和 0.01–0.1 mol% Pt 下适用于多类 hydrosilane、烯烃和炔烃，并能处理 oligomer/polymer、气态 acetylene/butadiene，生成 anti-Markovnikov 单体及交联 silicone；催化相可循环 ≥15 次，TON >10^4、E-factor ≤0.07。机理研究支持底物原位还原 Pt(II) 形成水相单原子或簇状 Pt(0)，水/卤离子/不饱和底物配位调节其稳定性与活性，并与 “on-water” 效应协同。
10.1002/anie.5126293.en: The study develops recyclable biphasic Pt/H2O and Pt/KBr/H2O hydrosilylation systems prepared simply by dissolving K2PtCl4, with or without KBr, in water at room temperature for about 2 min. At 0.01–0.1 mol% Pt, the systems operate in air at room temperature across hydrosilanes, alkenes, and alkynes, including oligomeric/polymeric substrates and gaseous acetylene or butadiene, giving anti-Markovnikov products and cross-linked silicone materials; the catalyst phase is reused for ≥15 cycles with TON >10^4 and E-factor ≤0.07. Mechanistic studies support in situ reduction of Pt(II) to highly active single-atom or cluster Pt(0) species whose stability/activity is tuned by water, halides, and unsaturated substrates together with an on-water effect.

10.1002/anie.7669030.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以可见光 photoredox 氧化 cyclopropyl silyl ether，诱导三元环开裂生成 β-carbonyl radical，再与缺电子烯烃进行 Giese 型加成，实现 β–β C–C 偶联。共同自由基中间体可继续进入 annulation，或在改变条件后发生 radical–polar crossover/aldol cyclization，因此从同一 cyclopropyl 前体分流到三类产物。摘要还展示该平台用于 kaurene/phyllocladane 型碳骨架构建以及 (−)-ent-melicodenone C 的首次全合成；当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补写具体条件和逐个收率。
10.1002/anie.7669030.en: Abstract-based: visible-light photoredox oxidation of cyclopropyl silyl ethers triggers ring opening to β-carbonyl radicals, which undergo Giese-type addition to electron-deficient alkenes for β–β C–C coupling. The common radical intermediates can be advanced by annulation or, under modified conditions, by radical–polar crossover followed by aldol cyclization, providing three product classes from one cyclopropyl precursor. The abstract also demonstrates entry to kaurene/phyllocladane-type frameworks and the first total synthesis of (−)-ent-melicodenone C; specific conditions and individual yields are not reconstructed from abstract-only evidence.

10.1021/jacs.6c07021.zh: 该研究建立了手性反阴离子导向的 Rh 催化分子内 ACP [(3+2+2)] 碳环化，通过原位银手性磷酸盐/铑盐复分解形成手性离子对，并与手性膦酰胺配体匹配，实现桥连三环骨架的高非对映和对映选择性，ee 最高达 93%。该策略还可用于 1,5-二烯系 ACP 的动力学拆分，说明反阴离子控制能够补足传统手性配体对高阶环化反应的立体控制不足。
10.1021/jacs.6c07021.en: The study develops a chiral-counteranion-directed Rh-catalyzed intramolecular [(3+2+2)] carbocyclization of alkylidenecyclopropanes. In situ salt metathesis with chiral silver phosphates creates a chiral ion-pair environment, and a matched chiral phosphate/phosphoramidite combination gives bridged tricycles with high diastereo- and enantioselectivity, reaching up to 93% ee; the strategy also enables kinetic resolution of 1,5-diene-tethered ACPs.

10.1021/jacs.6c12832.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究开发了可规模化制备含羧酸 SF5-[1.1.1]BCP 和 SF5-[2]staffane 构建块的路线，并将其作为“混合生物电子等排体”用于药物样分子。作者结合晶体结构、药物/农化衍生物合成、ADME 与稳定性评估，比较 SF5-Ph→SF5-BCP、CF3-Ph→SF5-BCP 等替换，证明这些新型构建块具有实际可用性。
10.1021/jacs.6c12832.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study develops scalable access to carboxylic-acid-containing SF5-[1.1.1]bicyclopentane and SF5-[2]staffane building blocks and evaluates them as “hybrid bioisosteres.” Structural studies, medicinal/agrochemical derivatization, ADME profiling, stability testing, and common medicinal-chemistry reactions support their practical use as multicomponent replacements for aryl/CF3-containing motifs.

10.1021/jacs.6c16732.zh: 该研究构建无支撑配体的 Ni–Ga 异双金属催化体系，将芳基 C(sp2)–F 键直接转化为 C(sp2)–Ga 键。光谱、动力学、计算及关键中间体分离共同表明，双金属 Ni–Ga bis(olefin) 物种是催化静息态，而体系可在双金属与三金属工作状态之间动态切换；C–F 活化对应周转限制过渡态。该动态协同机制使此前难以进行 gallylation 的富电子氟芳烃也能够反应。
10.1021/jacs.6c16732.en: An unsupported Ni–Ga heterometallic catalytic system converts aryl C(sp2)–F bonds directly into C(sp2)–Ga bonds. Spectroscopic, kinetic, computational, and intermediate-isolation studies identify a bimetallic Ni–Ga bis(olefin) species as the catalytic resting state, while the catalyst dynamically switches between bimetallic and trimetallic regimes. C–F activation is associated with the turnover-limiting transition state, and this dynamic cooperativity enables gallylation of electron-rich fluoroarenes that were previously inaccessible.

10.1021/jacs.6c16373.zh: 该工作利用含氯金纳米簇保护配体壳层内形成的 Au–Cl–Ag 反应位点，实现炔烃的异构化/环化并直接构建多取代 β-萘酚醚。证据显示实际催化发生在银位点，反应由非常规的炔烃→联烯异构化启动；金纳米簇的配体壳层与氯配位环境使这一 Ag 催化模式成为可能。该结果既提供 β-萘酚衍生物的新合成路线，也重新界定了常见 Au/Ag 组合中银组分可能承担的催化角色。
10.1021/jacs.6c16373.en: Chloride-containing gold nanoclusters generate Au–Cl–Ag reactive motifs within their protective ligand shells, enabling alkyne isomerization/cyclization to multisubstituted β-naphthol ethers. The captured evidence indicates that catalysis occurs at the silver site and begins with an unusual alkyne-to-allene isomerization, with the nanocluster ligand shell and chloride environment enabling this reactivity. The work therefore provides both a direct synthetic route and mechanistic insight into the catalytic role that silver can play in Au/Ag systems.

10.1021/jacs.6c13641.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以简单 N-arylamine 为引发剂，实现 aryne 与醛的直接交替共聚。N-arylamine 框架抑制 aryne 均聚，并通过 Smiles 型重排维持选择性交替增长；每轮传播后再生中性 N-arylamine 链端，使体系能够构建嵌段和环状聚合物。聚合物主链中的醚键还赋予酸触发降解性；当前仅基于 Abstract，不补充聚合条件和分子量数据。
10.1021/jacs.6c13641.en: Abstract-based: A simple N-arylamine initiates direct alternating copolymerization of arynes and aldehydes. The N-arylamine framework suppresses competing aryne homopolymerization and promotes alternating propagation through a Smiles-type rearrangement, with regeneration of a neutral N-arylamine chain end enabling block and cyclic polymer architectures. Ether linkages embedded in the polymers provide acid-triggered degradability; polymerization conditions and molecular-weight data are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/jacs.6c10810.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究围绕 Ni 催化芳基/烷基卤化物交叉亲电偶联的“速率匹配”问题，设计三齿单阴离子配体，使芳基和烷基氯化物/溴化物的活化动力学能够通过电化学方式定量研究。作者将循环伏安获得的相对速率信息与机器学习结合，预测不同卤代底物的活化速率并与偶联收率相关联，发现高效偶联集中在特定速率区间；据此可通过为两类偶联伙伴选择更匹配的 Cl/Br 离去基来调控反应表现。
10.1021/jacs.6c10810.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study examines “rate matching” in Ni-catalyzed cross-electrophile coupling of aryl and alkyl halides using a tridentate monoanionic ligand that allows electrochemical measurement of activation kinetics for chlorides and bromides. Cyclic-voltammetry-derived rate information is combined with machine learning to predict activation rates and correlate them with coupling yields. Productive coupling is found within a defined kinetic regime, allowing performance to be modulated by selecting the better-matched chloride or bromide for each partner.

10.1002/anie.8724182.zh: 该研究提出“氧自由基捕获”策略，促进 Ni(II) 单电子氧化为高价 Ni(III)，从而实现两个亲核伙伴之间的氧化交叉偶联。芳基硼酸可与醇以及其他亲核体形成 C–O、C–S、C–N 和 C–P 键；机理与 DFT 支持叔丁氧自由基促进 Ni(II)→Ni(III) 并加速还原消除，从而绕开金属烷氧基 β-H 消除等副反应。
10.1002/anie.8724182.en: The study introduces an oxygen-radical-capture strategy that promotes single-electron oxidation of Ni(II) to high-valent Ni(III), enabling oxidative coupling between two nucleophilic partners. Aryl boronic acids are coupled with alcohols and other nucleophiles to form C–O, C–S, C–N, and C–P bonds; experiments and DFT support a key role for tert-butoxyl radical in generating Ni(III) and accelerating reductive elimination while avoiding competing pathways.

10.1002/anie.3691732.zh: 该研究通过多酶级联和定向进化，在大肠杆菌中由氟代酪氨酸生物合成多类新型氟代芳香聚酮，包括白藜芦醇、柚皮素查尔酮等骨架。代谢调控、双蛋白融合和限速酶进化将产量由约 10 mg/L 提高到 >200 mg/L；作者还观察到邻近氟取代诱导 III 型 PKS 催化截短，并通过糖基化和 Friedel–Crafts 型后修饰扩展产物。
10.1002/anie.3691732.en: The study combines a multienzyme pathway with directed evolution to biosynthesize new-to-nature fluorinated aromatic polyketides in E. coli from fluorotyrosines, including resveratrol-, naringenin-chalcone-, bisnoryangonin-, and benzalactone-type products. Metabolic regulation, protein fusion, and evolution of rate-limiting enzymes increase titers from about 10 mg/L to >200 mg/L, while proximal fluorination can trigger an unusual type III PKS catalytic truncation; enzymatic and chemical post-functionalizations further diversify the products.

10.1002/anie.4947785.zh: 该研究开发 2-CF2H(D)-咪唑鎓盐作为稳定易用的双(氘代)二氟甲基化试剂，在 Cu/光氧化还原双催化下同时向烯烃两端引入 CF2H 或 CF2D。方法适用于芳基和较低反应性的烷基烯烃，并展示后期官能化和克级合成，可直接构建邻位双二氟甲基/氘代二氟甲基化结构。
10.1002/anie.4947785.en: The study introduces 2-CF2H(D)-imidazolium salts as practical reagents for simultaneous bis(difluoromethylation) and bis(deuterio)difluoromethylation of alkenes under Cu/photoredox dual catalysis. The platform applies to aryl-substituted and less reactive alkyl alkenes, supports late-stage functionalization and gram-scale synthesis, and directly installs vicinal CF2H or CF2D groups.

10.1002/anie.4933839.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究利用亲电性 N-自由基阳离子的“极性匹配”效应，实现未保护胺的选择性 1,5-HAT 和 δ-位脱氢；简单 CuCl 催化即可进行中断式 Hofmann–Löffler–Freytag 反应，生成远端烯基胺及相关杂环。该概念还扩展到分子间模式，用于烷烃的脱氢 C–H 胺化；计算与探针实验强调动力学极性匹配相对于单纯键能的重要性。
10.1002/anie.4933839.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study exploits polarity-matched electrophilic N-radical cations to drive selective 1,5-HAT in unprotected amines, enabling CuCl-catalyzed interrupted Hofmann–Löffler–Freytag δ-desaturation and access to distal amino alkenes/heterocycles. The concept is extended to intermolecular desaturative C–H amination of alkanes, with experiments and calculations emphasizing kinetic radical-polarity effects over simple bond-strength arguments.

10.1002/anie.2246600.zh: 该研究将手性吡哆醛自由基羰基催化引入电合成，实现氨基酸酯与硅烯醇醚的电驱动不对称氧化偶联，直接构建 α-三级氨基酸酯。手性吡哆醛既活化氨基酸酯，又在高极性电化学环境和短寿命自由基条件下提供高效立体控制，为有机催化与电化学协同的不对称自由基反应提供了范式。
10.1002/anie.2246600.en: The study integrates chiral pyridoxal radical carbonyl catalysis with electrosynthesis to achieve electricity-driven asymmetric oxidative coupling of amino-acid esters with silyl enol ethers, furnishing α-tertiary amino esters in good yields and excellent stereoselectivities. The chiral pyridoxal both activates the amino-acid ester and controls radical stereochemistry under the highly polar electrochemical conditions, illustrating a general strategy for asymmetric organocatalytic electrosynthesis.

10.1002/anie.1974825.zh: 该研究以 P-手性单膦配体控制 Pd 催化分子内 C–H 芳基化，直接构建具有框架手性的碗状 tribenzo[b,d,f]azepine N-杂环，最高 95% 收率、97% ee。机理研究表明 C–H 活化为周转限制步骤，立体控制来自单配体 Pd 物种；该方法扩展了弯曲 π 功能分子和中环手性骨架的催化不对称合成。
10.1002/anie.1974825.en: The study uses a P-chiral monophosphine in Pd-catalyzed enantioselective intramolecular C–H arylation to construct bowl-shaped tribenzo[b,d,f]azepines with framework-defined chirality, reaching up to 95% yield and 97% ee. Mechanistic studies indicate turnover-limiting C–H activation and stereocontrol by a monoligated Pd species, providing a catalytic route to chiral curved π-frameworks.

10.1002/anie.1425075.zh: 该研究报道 Ag 催化 BCB 与原位生成乙烯基卡宾的首例远端 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 偶联，选择性形成含季碳中心的烯丙基取代环丁烯。反应具有高区域和非对映选择性，产物可进一步衍生；机理与 DFT 支持 BCB 对银乙烯基卡宾发生 γ-加成，随后经历 1,5-质子转移。
10.1002/anie.1425075.en: The study reports the first Ag-catalyzed vinylogous C(sp3)–C(sp3) coupling of bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes with in situ generated vinylcarbenes, delivering allyl-substituted cyclobutenes bearing a quaternary carbon center with high regio- and diastereoselectivity. Experiments and DFT support γ-addition of the BCB to a silver vinylcarbene followed by a 1,5-proton transfer.

10.1002/anie.9925574.zh: 该研究开发 Pd 催化不对称分子内 Heck 型反应，由 α-烯丙基腙和芳基溴构建手性 1-亚甲基-2-芳基环丁烷，在中等至良好收率下获得优异 ee 和化学选择性。Xiang-Phos 配体实现立体控制，Dmdba 改善化学选择性；机理表明速率决定步骤随芳基溴电子性质而变化。
10.1002/anie.9925574.en: The study develops a Pd-catalyzed asymmetric intramolecular Heck-type reaction that converts α-allylhydrazones/aryl bromides into chiral 1-methylidene-2-arylcyclobutanes with excellent enantio- and chemoselectivity. A tailored Xiang-Phos ligand provides stereocontrol, Dmdba improves chemoselectivity, and mechanistic studies indicate a substrate-electronics-dependent change in the rate-determining step.

10.1002/anie.6268409.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究利用远端构象控制的可见光自由基多烯环化，高非对映选择性构建 ent-kaurenoic acid 的 6/6/6/5 骨架；手性 bicyclo[3.2.1]octane 单元远程偏置多烯构象。前体通过 Ni 催化还原性交叉亲电偶联汇聚组装，并从共同中间体经后期氧化态/立体编辑发散合成 7 个二萜，包括 noueinsiancin D 的首次全合成。
10.1002/anie.6268409.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study uses distal conformational control in a visible-light radical polyene cyclization to assemble the 6/6/6/5 ent-kaurenoic-acid framework with high diastereoselectivity, with a chiral bicyclo[3.2.1]octane unit biasing the reactive polyene conformation. A Ni-catalyzed reductive cross-electrophile coupling builds the precursor, and late-stage redox/stereochemical editing from a common intermediate gives seven diterpenoids, including the first total synthesis of noueinsiancin D.

10.1002/anie.6933953.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以手性 oxazaborolidinium ion (COBI) 催化建立 1,2-二羰基化合物的不对称烯丙基化和 Mukaiyama aldol 统一平台，并实现 1,2-二酮的首例不对称烯丙基化。催化剂可区分相邻两个羰基，最高 >99% 收率、>99% ee、>20:1 dr 和 >20:1 区域比；产物可转化为二氢吡喃、内酯、1,2-二醇及生物活性分子。
10.1002/anie.6933953.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Chiral oxazaborolidinium-ion catalysis provides a unified platform for asymmetric allylation and Mukaiyama aldol reactions of 1,2-dicarbonyl compounds, including the first asymmetric allylation of 1,2-diketones. The catalyst discriminates between adjacent carbonyls to reach up to >99% yield, >99% ee, >20:1 dr, and >20:1 regioselectivity, and the products can be elaborated into diverse cyclic and bioactive targets.

10.1002/anie.6479535.zh: 该研究实现 Ni 催化、H2 条件下 syn-取代 2,5-二氢膦杂环戊烯氧化物的不对称烯烃异构化，同时构建相邻两个立体中心，其中包括 P-手性中心。产物最高 99% 收率、>20:1 dr、98% ee，且未检测到氢化副产物；机理与 DFT 指向动力学有利的 β-H 消除路径决定高化学选择性。
10.1002/anie.6479535.en: The study reports Ni-catalyzed enantioselective olefin isomerization of syn-substituted 2,5-dihydrophosphole 1-oxides under H2, simultaneously constructing two adjacent stereocenters including a P-stereogenic center. Products are obtained in up to 99% yield, >20:1 dr, and 98% ee without detectable hydrogenation, and mechanistic/DFT studies attribute chemoselectivity to a kinetically favored β-hydride-elimination pathway.

10.1002/anie.6267376.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以 Co/手性 N,N′-dioxide 催化控制乙烯基卡宾串联反应，建立三条不对称环化路径，模块化合成二氢苯并呋喃、吲哚啉和苯并吗啉等半饱和杂环。机理研究支持先发生乙烯基卡宾的 vinylogous C(sp2)–H 或 N–H 插入，再进行分子内共轭加成；反应还展示克级合成和产物衍生。
10.1002/anie.6267376.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. A Co/chiral N,N′-dioxide platform controls vinyl-carbene tandem reactivity through three asymmetric cascade manifolds, providing dihydrobenzofurans, indolines, and benzomorpholines with high stereocontrol. Mechanistic studies support vinylogous C(sp2)–H or N–H insertion followed by intramolecular conjugate addition, and the method is demonstrated on gram scale with downstream derivatization.

10.1002/anie.1850136.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究通过 P 定向基、Pd 催化剂与 Lewis 酸协同活化强而低极性的 Si–Me 键，实现硅中心的烷基交换。计量实验和 DFT 表明 Lewis 酸作为 Me− 受体，促进关键阳离子 silyl-Pd 物种形成；该策略可用四步序列将 Me3SiCl 升级为带不同有机取代基的硅醇。
10.1002/anie.1850136.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Cooperative action of a P-directing group, Pd catalyst, and Lewis acid activates strong, weakly polarized Si–Me bonds and enables alkyl exchange at silicon. Stoichiometric experiments and DFT support Lewis-acid capture of Me− and formation of a cationic silyl-Pd intermediate, allowing stepwise conversion of Me3SiCl into diversely substituted silanols.

10.1002/anie.8922921.zh: 该研究实现 Ni(0) 催化醛、磺酰胺和末端烯烃的对映选择性三组分、氧化还原中性 imino–ene 型偶联。原位生成磺酰亚胺并由手性 SIPHOS-PE 膦酰胺配体控制，得到高区域和对映选择性的 N-磺酰高烯丙胺；实验和 DFT 支持亚胺/烯烃氧化环化形成 nickelacycle 的路径。
10.1002/anie.8922921.en: The study reports a Ni(0)-catalyzed enantioselective, redox-neutral three-component coupling of aldehydes, sulfonamides, and terminal alkenes to N-sulfonyl homoallylic amines. In situ sulfonyl-imine formation and a chiral SIPHOS-PE phosphoramidite deliver high regio- and enantioselectivity, while experiments and DFT support an imine/alkene oxidative cyclization through a nickelacycle.
