Diverse alkene classes are tolerated under mild conditions, with high stereoselectivity for the newly formed conjugated terminal alkene. Detailed optimization parameters, product-level yields, and mechanistic controls are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03980.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 Rh 催化的 alkyne-tethered ketoester 与 arylboronic acid 不对称 1,4-shift/double-cyclization 级联，一步形成三个化学键和两个环，de novo 构建高对映选择性的手性 spirolactone。产物可进一步转化为多类手性螺环骨架，体现合成延展性。机理实验支持作者提出的序列包含 regioselective syn insertion、1,4-rhodium shift 和后续双环化；当前证据未完整覆盖催化剂结构、具体 ee/收率范围和全部控制实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03980.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A Rh-catalyzed asymmetric 1,4-shift/double-cyclization cascade of alkyne-tethered ketoesters with arylboronic acids forms three bonds and two rings in one operation, enabling de novo synthesis of chiral spirolactones with high enantioselectivity. The products can be transformed into diverse chiral spirocycles, demonstrating synthetic utility. Mechanistic studies support the authors’ sequence involving regioselective syn insertion, a 1,4-rhodium shift, and subsequent double cyclization; catalyst details, full yield/ee ranges, and all control experiments are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03963.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作以 indole isocyanide、diarylphosphine oxide 和水为原料，发展 Mn 介导的自由基级联环化，一步同时构建 C–C、C–O 和 C–P 键，获得含多杂原子的 indolo[1,2-a]quinoxaline。改变 Mn(OAc)2 与 Mn(OAc)3 等锰物种及碱可使产物在含氧/含磷骨架之间分流，少量水既提高含羟基产物形成，也被证据指向为氧源。机理研究支持自由基途径；方法还展示了后期官能化与初步生物活性评估。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和机理实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03963.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops a Mn-mediated radical cascade of indole isocyanides, diarylphosphine oxides, and water that forms C–C, C–O, and C–P bonds in one operation to access heteroatom-rich indolo[1,2-a]quinoxalines. Changing the manganese oxidation state and base diverts the reaction between oxygen- and phosphorus-containing products, while a small amount of water enhances hydroxylated-product formation and is implicated as the oxygen source. Mechanistic studies support a radical pathway, and late-stage functionalization plus preliminary biological evaluation demonstrate utility. Full substrate and mechanistic datasets are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03908.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展光氧化还原催化的 dehydroalanine（Dha）及含 Dha 二肽二氟甲基化，以 difluoromethyl sulfone 为自由基前体，在温和条件下直接获得 β-difluoromethyl α-amino acid 衍生物。概念验证的不对称版本引入 CPA，模型产物以 55% 分离收率和 73% ee 获得。摘要中的机理实验支持 radical–polar crossover 路径，并提示产物可逆去质子化可能造成 ee 侵蚀。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的反应条件和范围细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03908.en: Abstract-based: The study develops photoredox-catalyzed difluoromethylation of dehydroalanine (Dha) derivatives and Dha-containing dipeptides using a difluoromethyl sulfone as the radical precursor, directly furnishing β-difluoromethyl α-amino-acid derivatives under mild conditions. A proof-of-concept CPA-enabled asymmetric variant gives the model product in 55% isolated yield and 73% ee. Mechanistic experiments summarized in the abstract support a radical–polar crossover pathway and suggest that reversible product deprotonation may erode enantioselectivity. Uncaptured conditions and scope details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03905.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用分子内 electron donor–acceptor（EDA）复合物，在可见光下实现一锅脱羧环化级联。通过烷基链把 indole donor 与 NHPI ester acceptor 共价连接，可在中性、无金属和无外加光催化剂条件下高效构建 Corynanthe 型单萜吲哚生物碱标志性的 6/5/6/6 四环骨架。摘要报道 22 个实例、68–98% 收率并可克级放大；该反应作为关键步骤完成 (+)-hirsutinol 与 (−)-dihydrocorynantheol 的 8 步最长线性对映选择性全合成。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充更细的光化学参数和机理步骤。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03905.en: Abstract-based: An intramolecular electron donor–acceptor (EDA) complex enables a visible-light one-pot decarboxylative cyclization cascade. Covalently tethering an indole donor to an NHPI-ester acceptor through an alkyl linker constructs the characteristic 6/5/6/6 tetracyclic core of Corynanthe-type monoterpene indole alkaloids under neutral, metal- and photocatalyst-free conditions. The abstract reports 22 examples in 68–98% yield with gram-scale practicality, and the reaction serves as a key step in 8-linear-step enantioselective total syntheses of (+)-hirsutinol and (−)-dihydrocorynantheol. Detailed photochemical parameters and mechanistic steps are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03808.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作设计并合成 methylene 和 difluoromethylene uridine bisphosphonate-carbagalactose，作为更稳定的 UDP-Gal 模拟物用于 α-1,4-galactosyltransferase（A4GALT）研究。设计中把 UDP-Gal 易水解的糖苷键和焦磷酸键替换为化学/酶学更稳定的连接，同时保留供体识别所需关键结构。方法学上实现了 secondary triflate 与 difluoromethylene bisphosphonate 的首次成功亲核取代。CH2 和 CF2 类似物 5、6 在 500 μM UDP-Gal 存在下对 A4GALT 的 IC50 分别为 249 和 217 μM。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的合成步骤或酶动力学细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03808.en: Abstract-based: Methylene- and difluoromethylene-uridine bisphosphonate carbagalactose analogues are designed as stabilized UDP-Gal mimics for probing α-1,4-galactosyltransferase (A4GALT). The labile glycosidic and pyrophosphate linkages are replaced with chemically and enzymatically stable motifs while retaining key donor-recognition features. The synthesis includes the first successful nucleophilic substitution of a secondary triflate with a difluoromethylene bisphosphonate. The CH2 and CF2 analogues 5 and 6 inhibit A4GALT with IC50 values of 249 and 217 μM, respectively, in the presence of 500 μM UDP-Gal. Uncaptured synthetic and enzyme-kinetic details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03409.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究以商业烯烃和双氮亲核试剂为原料，通过电化学连续阳极氧化/亲核进攻两次构建 C–N 键，模块化合成 piperazine 和 1,4-diazepane。模型反应在不分隔电解池中以碳阳极、Pt 阴极、5 mA 恒流运行；DBU 和四丁基铵电解质对反应关键，无电流时不生成产物。体系可容忍多种取代 styrene，并利用电子作为无痕氧化剂。作者提出先由烯烃经历逐步单电子氧化形成 radical cation/cation，再被两个 N 位点依次捕获。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和后续验证。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03409.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study uses commercial alkenes and bis-nitrogen nucleophiles in an electrochemical sequence of anodic oxidation and two nucleophilic attacks to forge two C–N bonds and assemble piperazine and 1,4-diazepane scaffolds. The model reaction operates in an undivided cell with a carbon anode, Pt cathode, and 5 mA constant current; DBU and a tetraalkylammonium electrolyte are important, and no product forms without current. Diverse substituted styrenes are tolerated, with electrons serving as traceless oxidants. The authors propose sequential single-electron oxidation of the alkene to radical-cation/cation intermediates followed by capture at the two nitrogen sites. Full scope and downstream validation are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01674.zh: 该工作发展无过渡金属、碱促进的一锅级联，由 isatogen 与 2-(2-aminophenyl)acetonitrile 同时构建 C–C、C–N 和 N–N 键，获得 indazolo[2,3-a]quinoline 四环骨架。模型优化中，等当量两底物与 Cs2CO3（1.0 equiv）在 CH3CN 室温反应 12 h 可将代表性产物收率提高到 90%；THF 和水中则无产物。底物范围支持多种稠合衍生物，部分产物具有明显荧光；该骨架还可继续经 Rh 催化构建更高度稠合的 cinnolinium salt。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01674.en: A transition-metal-free, base-promoted one-pot cascade of isatogens with 2-(2-aminophenyl)acetonitriles forms C–C, C–N, and N–N bonds simultaneously to construct indazolo[2,3-a]quinoline tetracycles. In the model optimization, equimolar substrates with 1.0 equiv Cs2CO3 in CH3CN at room temperature for 12 h give the representative product in 90% yield, whereas THF and water are ineffective. The scope provides multiple fused derivatives, selected products show notable fluorescence, and the scaffold can be further converted by Rh catalysis into more highly fused cinnolinium salts.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01138.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究“复活”热诱导 aziridine–alkene 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition，以天然萜类组成的疏水深共熔溶剂（HDES）作为高沸点反应介质，在空气中无需特殊操作即可由 N-aryl aziridine 原位生成 azomethine ylide 并合成高度取代 pyrrolidine，最高分离收率 94%。摘要还支持从 azide 起始物的一锅双环加成、溶剂回收再用和克级合成。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的底物逐项数据或机理细节。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01138.en: Abstract-based: Thermal aziridine–alkene 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition is revived in hydrophobic deep eutectic solvents (HDESs) derived from natural terpenoids, which serve as high-boiling media. N-Aryl aziridines generate azomethine ylides in situ and furnish highly substituted pyrrolidines under air without special precautions, reaching up to 94% isolated yield. The abstract also supports a one-pot double cycloaddition from an azide starting material, solvent reuse, and gram-scale synthesis. Product-level scope and detailed mechanism are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/jacs.6c16285.zh: 该研究报道 o-carborane 与 alcohol 的首次直接 B–H/O–H 交叉偶联，在 heteroleptic Cu(I) 光催化下高区域选择性实现 B(4)–H alkoxylation。benzoyl directing group 放大 B(3)–H 与 B(4)–H 的键解离能差，使 phenyl radical 可通过 1,5-HAT 选择性生成 B(4)-centered radical。TEMPO/1,1-diphenylethylene 捕获、EPR、同位素和 KIE 实验支持自由基路径，并表明 HAT 不是速率决定步骤；作者进一步提出 Cu 介导的 boron radical–polar crossover，把 B radical 氧化为亲电 boron cation，再由 alcohol 捕获形成 B–O 键。DFT 比较也支持该 outer-sphere crossover 路径。
10.1021/jacs.6c16285.en: The study reports the first direct B–H/O–H cross-coupling of o-carboranes with alcohols, using heteroleptic Cu(I) photocatalysis for highly regioselective B(4)–H alkoxylation. A benzoyl directing group amplifies the BDE difference between B(3)–H and B(4)–H, enabling selective formation of a B(4)-centered radical through 1,5-HAT by a phenyl radical. TEMPO/1,1-diphenylethylene trapping, EPR, isotope labeling, and KIE experiments support the radical pathway and show that HAT is not rate-determining. The authors further propose a Cu-mediated boron radical–polar crossover that oxidizes the B radical to an electrophilic boron cation, which is trapped by an alcohol to form the B–O bond; DFT comparisons support this outer-sphere crossover pathway.

10.1038/s44160-026-01162-w.zh: 该研究建立 Fe/Ni 双金属光电化学平台，直接利用羧酸、醇和醛等 native functional groups 构建 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 键。设计核心是把自由基生成与 Ni 催化氧化态维持解耦：光诱导 LMCT 温和地产生 alkyl radical，而电化学负责调节催化红氧平衡，因此可覆盖 primary、secondary 及位阻较大的 tertiary carbon。机理研究显示牺牲性 alkyl bromide 可消耗过量电子、防止 Ni(II) 过还原为 Ni(I)，维持 Ni(II)/Ni(III) 循环；EPR、分隔电解池、立体化学实验和 CV 共同支持作者提出的 outer-sphere SH2 radical-sorting 成键路径。
10.1038/s44160-026-01162-w.en: The study establishes a Fe/Ni dual-catalytic photoelectrochemical platform for direct C(sp3)–C(sp3) cross-coupling from native carboxylic acids, alcohols, and aldehydes. The design decouples alkyl-radical generation from maintenance of the nickel redox state: photoinduced LMCT generates radicals under mild conditions while electrochemistry regulates catalytic redox balance, allowing primary, secondary, and sterically hindered tertiary centers to participate. Mechanistic studies show that a sacrificial alkyl bromide consumes excess electrons and prevents over-reduction of Ni(II) to Ni(I), sustaining a Ni(II)/Ni(III) cycle. EPR, divided-cell controls, stereochemical experiments, and CV support the authors’ outer-sphere SH2 radical-sorting pathway.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03422.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作从易得原料经三步制得 tetrazine-derived diammonium dication 前体，并与多种富氮/富氧 energetic anion 配对得到盐 4–12，以兼顾爆轰性能、热稳定性和机械安全性。代表性化合物 9 的爆速 Vd 为 8533 m s−1、爆压 27.09 GPa、分解温度 207 °C、撞击感度 12.5 J，综合能量水平可与 RDX 相比。该结果表明 tetrazine-derived diamine cation 可作为设计热稳定 energetic salts 的平台；当前证据未完整覆盖所有盐的制备和安全测试细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03422.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A tetrazine-derived diammonium dication precursor is prepared in three steps from readily available materials and paired with nitrogen- and oxygen-rich energetic anions to give salts 4–12 that balance detonation performance, thermal stability, and mechanical sensitivity. Representative salt 9 shows Vd = 8533 m s−1, P = 27.09 GPa, Td = 207 °C, and impact sensitivity of 12.5 J, with overall energetic performance comparable to RDX. The work identifies tetrazine-derived diamine cations as a platform for thermally stable energetic salts; complete preparation and safety-test data are not captured.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05151.zh: 该研究针对 1,7-enyne 通常倾向环化的问题，发展 Cu 催化的非环化线性远程双官能化。原位生成的 CF3 radical 优先加成 C=C 而非 C≡C，随后对 propargylic C–H 发生选择性 HAT 形成 propargylic/allenyl radical，最终被 TMSCN 捕获生成 CF3-containing allenenitrile。模型体系使用 Togni reagent II、TMSCN、CuI/1,10-phenanthroline；优化后在 MeOH 中可显著提高目标 allene 形成。除 1,5-HAT 外还观察到 1,6- 和 1,7-HAT，说明该策略可把多不饱和体系的自由基反应从经典环化重新导向远程线性官能化。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05151.en: The study redirects the usual cyclization chemistry of 1,7-enynes into Cu-catalyzed noncyclizative linear remote difunctionalization. An in situ generated CF3 radical adds selectively to the C=C bond rather than the C≡C bond, followed by selective HAT from a propargylic C–H bond to form a propargyl/allenyl radical that is trapped by TMSCN to give CF3-containing allenenitriles. The model system uses Togni reagent II, TMSCN, and CuI/1,10-phenanthroline, with methanol markedly improving formation of the allene product. In addition to 1,5-HAT, 1,6- and 1,7-HAT are observed, showing that radical chemistry of multiply unsaturated substrates can be redirected from classical cyclization toward remote linear functionalization.

10.1021/acscatal.6c04883.zh: 该研究将经典 Ir 催化 C–H borylation 改造成光辅助模式，在保留 ITMH 催化框架的同时显著加快反应，并在广泛底物上提高转化/收率。与对应暗反应相比，光照提供明显速率增益，使原本需要更长时间的 C–H 硼化可在更温和、快速的条件下完成。该方法还通过 continuous-flow 反应器实现放大，说明光加速策略可直接嵌入成熟的 Ir/bipyridine C–H borylation 平台。
10.1021/acscatal.6c04883.en: The study adapts the established Ir-catalyzed C–H borylation platform to light-assisted conditions, retaining the ITMH catalytic framework while substantially accelerating reaction rates and improving conversion/yield across a broad substrate set. Relative to the corresponding dark reactions, irradiation provides a pronounced rate enhancement, allowing C–H borylation to proceed more rapidly under mild conditions. The method is also scaled using continuous-flow technology, showing that photochemical acceleration can be integrated directly into a mature Ir/bipyridine C–H borylation platform.

10.31635/ccschem.026.202507282.zh: 该研究利用 π–π stacking 与 hydrogen bonding 的协同非共价作用，解决未活化 diene 与 primary aromatic amine 氧化胺化中的区域选择性和反应顺序控制。Pd/phosphine/quinone 体系优先触发 branch-selective allylic C–H amination，随后可选择 aza-Wacker oxidation 或第二次 allylic C–H amination，从而经双 C–H 胺化分流合成 pyrrole、pyrrolidine 和 tetrahydroindole，覆盖超过 100 个实例。计算与机理研究表明，烯烃链的 π–π 定向以及阴离子配体在配位与氢键受体功能之间的协同，是 branched/linear 与后续环化选择性的关键。
10.31635/ccschem.026.202507282.en: The study uses cooperative π–π stacking and hydrogen bonding to control regioselectivity and reaction sequence in oxidative amination of unactivated dienes with primary aromatic amines. A Pd/phosphine/quinone system first promotes branch-selective allylic C–H amination, followed by either aza-Wacker oxidation or a second allylic C–H amination, enabling divergent access to pyrroles, pyrrolidines, and tetrahydroindoles through dual C–H amination across more than 100 examples. Mechanistic and computational studies identify orientation of the alkene chain by π–π interactions and the combined coordination/hydrogen-bond-acceptor roles of the anionic ligand as central to regioselectivity and subsequent cyclization.

10.31635/ccschem.026.202507094.zh: 该研究以 N-fluorocarboxamide 作为 remote carbon-radical mediator，发展 Cu 催化未活化烯烃分歧官能化，可选择实现 anti-Markovnikov hydroalkylation 或 1,2-alkylalkynylation。作者提出的级联过程包括 N-centered radical 生成、分子内 1,5-HAT 抽取远端 benzylic C(sp3)–H、所得 benzyl radical 加成烯烃、单电子氧化以及后续还原消除/捕获。体系具有较广底物范围及高区域/化学选择性，并把 alkane、alkene 与 alkyne 在一锅中连接，展示远端 C–H 作为碳自由基来源的模块化价值。
10.31635/ccschem.026.202507094.en: The study uses N-fluorocarboxamides as remote carbon-radical mediators for Cu-catalyzed divergent functionalization of unactivated alkenes, enabling either anti-Markovnikov hydroalkylation or 1,2-alkylalkynylation. The authors propose a cascade involving N-centered-radical generation, intramolecular 1,5-HAT from a remote benzylic C(sp3)–H bond, benzyl-radical addition to the alkene, single-electron oxidation, and subsequent reductive-elimination/trapping steps. Broad scope and high regio- and chemoselectivity are reported, including one-pot coupling of alkane-, alkene-, and alkyne-derived components.

10.1002/anie.9826344.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究系统解析 bacterial tailoring acyltransferase AntB 的“双底物 promiscuity”：酶可接受 8 类结构差异明显的天然产物受体，并处理 43 种 acyl donor，其中 22 种此前未报道。晶体结构显示活性中心位于双结构域界面，His117/Asp121 构成关键催化单元，宽阔通道分别容纳受体和多样 acyl-CoA；工程化 S17A/M265L 使 SPN-J acylation 活性提高 4.45 倍。作者进一步把 AntB 与工程化 acyl-CoA synthetase 组合成一锅再生平台，用于 deacyl-UK-2A 后期多样化，并获得具有增强抗真菌活性的新品。当前证据未完整覆盖全部动力学参数。
10.1002/anie.9826344.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study establishes dual substrate promiscuity in the bacterial tailoring acyltransferase AntB: the enzyme accepts eight structurally diverse natural-product acceptors and 43 distinct acyl donors, including 22 previously unreported donors. Crystal structures place the active site at the interdomain interface, with His117/Asp121 forming a key catalytic unit and spacious channels accommodating acceptors and diverse acyl-CoA donors. Engineering gives the S17A/M265L variant with a 4.45-fold activity increase for SPN-J acylation. AntB is then combined with engineered acyl-CoA synthetases in a one-pot regeneration platform for late-stage diversification of deacyl-UK-2A, yielding new analogues with enhanced antifungal activity. Full kinetic data are not completely captured.

10.1002/anie.9277033.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作以构象刚性的手性 bis(oxazoline)–Ni 体系，实现 aryl、heteroaryl 和 alkenyl halide/triflate 对脂肪族 N-sulfonyl aldimine 的不对称还原加成，多数手性胺达到 99% ee 或 >99.5% ee。范围包括约 80 个 (hetero)arylation 和 60 个 alkenylation 实例，多数反应仅需 1 mol% Ni，并可克级放大；方法还用于 10 个药物相关 benzylamine/azacycle 的简洁制备。动力学显示 Mn 还原步骤显著影响总速率，Lewis-acidic titanium alkoxide 主要通过协助 Mn 表面脱卤促进还原；DFT 支持 neutral aryl–Ni(I) 对 imine 的低势垒 1,2-insertion，并将高 ee 与刚性配体的 Thorpe–Ingold 效应联系起来。
10.1002/anie.9277033.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Conformationally rigid chiral bis(oxazoline)–Ni complexes catalyze enantioselective reductive addition of aryl, heteroaryl, and alkenyl halides/triflates to aliphatic N-sulfonyl aldimines, with most chiral amines formed in 99% ee or >99.5% ee. The reported scope includes about 80 (hetero)arylation and 60 alkenylation examples, usually with 1 mol% Ni and gram-scale practicality, and the method is applied to concise synthesis of 10 medicinally relevant benzylamines/azacycles. Kinetic studies show that Mn-mediated reductions contribute strongly to the overall rate, while Lewis-acidic titanium alkoxide assists reduction by removing halide from the Mn surface. DFT supports low-barrier 1,2-insertion of neutral aryl–Ni(I) into imines and relates high enantioselectivity to the rigid ligand framework through a Thorpe–Ingold effect.

10.1002/anie.8881851.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究从 safflower 鉴定 Ct6OGT、Ct7OGT、Ct3OGT 和 CtFLS 四个关键酶，其中 Ct6OGT 被表征为首个高区域选择性的 flavonoid 6-O-glycosyltransferase。酶学实验表明 6-hydroxykaempferol 3,6,7-tri-O-glycoside 按 6-O→7-O→3-O 的线性顺序糖基化生成；组合生物合成进一步获得 26 个 flavonoid 6-O-glycoside，并扩展出更广的 mono/di/tri-glycoside 产品谱。zebrafish 模型显示 6-hydroxylation 与 6-O-glycosylation 可增强抗血栓活性。当前证据未完整覆盖所有产物定量与体内验证，作者亦指出仍需进一步 in vivo 验证。
10.1002/anie.8881851.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Four key safflower enzymes—Ct6OGT, Ct7OGT, Ct3OGT, and CtFLS—are characterized, with Ct6OGT identified as the first highly regioselective flavonoid 6-O-glycosyltransferase. Enzymatic assays show that 6-hydroxykaempferol 3,6,7-tri-O-glycosides are assembled through a linear 6-O → 7-O → 3-O glycosylation sequence. Combinatorial biosynthesis produces 26 flavonoid 6-O-glycosides and a broader set of mono-, di-, and triglycosides. Zebrafish assays indicate that 6-hydroxylation and 6-O-glycosylation enhance antithrombotic activity. Complete product quantification and in vivo validation are not captured, and the authors note that further in vivo validation remains necessary.

10.1002/anie.8050538.zh: 该研究利用 HF/pyridine 同时提供强酸环境和氟源，使 paraformaldehyde 原位生成 primary fluoromethyl-oxocarbenium 类亲电体，从而把 alkyne 一步 difluoromethylenation 为 allyl difluoride，同时形成两个 C(sp3)–F 键和一个 C=C 键。65 wt% HF/pyridine 给出最佳模型表现；反应兼容多种含 N/O/S 官能团底物、enynes 及部分药物相关复杂分子，并可克级运行。内部炔的区域选择性取决于 vinyl-cation 中间体稳定性。低温 NMR、对照与计算支持 fluoromethyl-oxocarbenium 参与的机理；所得 allyl difluoride 还能进行取代、烯化、脱保护和 Heck-type 偶联等衍生化。
10.1002/anie.8050538.en: The study uses HF/pyridine as both a strongly acidic medium and fluoride source to generate a primary fluoromethyl-oxocarbenium-type electrophile from paraformaldehyde, enabling one-step difluoromethylenation of alkynes to allyl difluorides while forming two C(sp3)–F bonds and one C=C bond. A 65 wt% HF/pyridine mixture gives the best model performance. The reaction tolerates diverse N-, O-, and S-containing functionality, enynes, and selected drug-like complex molecules, and is demonstrated on gram scale. Regioselectivity with internal alkynes follows the relative stability of vinyl-cation intermediates. Low-temperature NMR, control studies, and calculations support involvement of a fluoromethyl-oxocarbenium species, and the allyl-difluoride products undergo substitution, olefination, deprotection, and Heck-type derivatization.

10.1002/anie.7400940.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究把短寿命、强亲电的 ketenimine 反应性“存储”在可分离的 α-nitroaziridine 中：前体可克级制备、经柱层析纯化并在室温长期保存，且可先与水或 nucleophile 共存而保持 dormant。加入 LiOH·H2O 后触发开环和 nitrite extrusion，按需释放 ketenimine，用于 N/O/C 捕获、环化、环加成及后期偶联；代表性前体 4a 在 2.0 g 规模以 71% 收率获得并可保存超过 2 个月。isotope labeling、nitrite 定量、in situ IR、独立 ketenimine 生成路径汇合以及 DFT 共同支持该释放机理。当前证据未完整覆盖全部衍生化条件。
10.1002/anie.7400940.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study stores the reactivity of short-lived, highly electrophilic ketenimines in isolable α-nitroaziridines. These precursors are accessible on gram scale, tolerate chromatography and prolonged room-temperature storage, and remain dormant when premixed with water or nucleophiles. LiOH·H2O triggers ring opening and nitrite extrusion to release ketenimines on demand for N-, O-, and C-trapping, cyclization, cycloaddition, and late-stage conjugation; representative precursor 4a is prepared on 2.0 g scale in 71% yield and remains stable for more than two months. Isotope labeling, nitrite-release quantification, in situ IR, convergence with an independent ketenimine-generation route, and DFT support the release mechanism. Full derivatization conditions are not completely captured.

10.1002/anie.7232174.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究通过在 CoOx 表面构建 frustrated Lewis pair（FLP）微环境，增强 O2 吸附和单电子活化，而不是重新开发全新催化材料。FLP-CoOx 在 120 °C、1 MPa O2、6 h 条件下把 polyethylene 氧化升级为 dicarboxylic acids，碳收率最高 86.0%，约为常规催化剂的 4 倍，并可处理多类真实废塑料。结构表征、in situ spectroscopy、EPR 和 DFT 支持表面 FLP 位点促进 O2 单电子还原生成 O2•−，从而加速 PE 氧化断链。当前证据未完整覆盖所有废塑料的产品分布。
10.1002/anie.7232174.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study engineers frustrated Lewis-pair (FLP) microenvironments on CoOx to enhance O2 adsorption and single-electron activation rather than replacing the established catalyst with an entirely new material. FLP-CoOx oxidatively upcycles polyethylene to dicarboxylic acids at 120 °C and 1 MPa O2 over 6 h, reaching up to 86.0% carbon yield—about fourfold higher than the conventional catalyst—and performs well with several real waste plastics. Structural characterization, in situ spectroscopy, EPR, and DFT support a role for surface FLP sites in promoting single-electron reduction of O2 to O2•− and accelerating PE oxidation. Complete product distributions for all waste feeds are not captured.

10.1002/anie.4827662.zh: 该研究发展可见光、无过渡金属的 phenol derivative 重构：以 trifluoromethyl 或 sulfonyl radical 启动 1,4-aryl migration，经 phenyl acrylate 类底物的 C–O 键断裂生成 β-arylpropionic acid，同时模块化引入 fluoroalkyl 或 sulfonyl 基团。反应具有较宽官能团和迁移芳基范围，并用于 11 个复杂 phenolic natural product/药物衍生物的后期官能化。作者提出关键为 reductive radical–polar crossover：先把迁移后自由基还原为 carbanion，再发生芳基 C–O 键 heterolysis 生成 carboxylate，从而抑制常见的 CO2 extrusion；DFT 支持这一分流机制。
10.1002/anie.4827662.en: The study develops a visible-light, transition-metal-free remodeling of phenol derivatives in which trifluoromethyl or sulfonyl radicals initiate a 1,4-aryl migration from phenyl-acrylate-type substrates, cleaving an aryl C–O bond to furnish β-arylpropionic acids while installing fluoroalkyl or sulfonyl groups modularly. Broad functional-group and migrating-aryl tolerance is reported, including late-stage functionalization of 11 complex phenolic natural products and drug derivatives. The authors propose a key reductive radical–polar crossover: reduction of the post-migration radical to a carbanion is followed by heterolytic aryl C–O cleavage to a carboxylate, suppressing competing CO2 extrusion. DFT supports this mechanistic divergence.

10.1002/anie.4613575.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究提出一锅 acid–base sequential catalysis，把 vinylene-linked COF 的孔壁官能化与骨架生长在时间上解耦：先以酸催化 Schiff-base condensation 将 functional monoaldehyde 安装到 benzylic diamine node 上，再原位切换到碱性条件进行 Knoevenagel polymerization。该策略构建了 20 个 crystalline framework，可引入 nitro、halogen、organic oxoacid、electron-deficient heterocycle 和 cyano 等多类内向孔壁基团，并可独立调节孔径。成对 COF 的 water-vapor sorption 对比进一步显示 pore confinement 会改变协同吸附行为。当前证据未完整覆盖全部结构参数和吸附数据。
10.1002/anie.4613575.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A one-pot acid–base sequential catalytic strategy temporally decouples pore-wall functionalization from formation of vinylene-linked COFs: acid-catalyzed Schiff-base condensation first installs functional monoaldehydes on benzylic diamine nodes, followed by an in situ switch to basic Knoevenagel polymerization. The strategy furnishes 20 crystalline frameworks bearing inward-facing nitro, halogen, organic oxoacid, electron-deficient heterocycle, cyano, and related functionalities while independently tuning pore aperture. Paired COFs further show that pore confinement modulates cooperative water-vapor uptake. Complete structural and sorption datasets are not fully captured.

10.1002/anie.1701592.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作发展 lithiation–borylation–aromatic Pummerer（LiBAP）策略，实现 thiazole C5 位与 chiral boronic ester 的立体专一 C(sp2)–C(sp3) 交叉偶联。pendant sulfinyl group 先发生外环亲电活化，随后触发 Pummerer-type 1,2-migration，从而克服 thiazole 芳环亲核性不足并避免无效 C–B 断裂；反应表现 complete stereospecificity 和较广官能团耐受性。产物保留的 C2 sulfide 可作为后续 C–S 多样化把手，并用于 bioactive γ-secretase inhibitor 的 formal asymmetric synthesis。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和条件。
10.1002/anie.1701592.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A lithiation–borylation–aromatic Pummerer (LiBAP) strategy enables stereospecific C5-selective C(sp2)–C(sp3) coupling of thiazoles with chiral boronic esters. A pendant sulfinyl group undergoes exocyclic electrophilic activation and triggers a Pummerer-type 1,2-migration, overcoming the low nucleophilicity of thiazoles while avoiding unproductive C–B fragmentation. The reaction proceeds with complete stereospecificity and broad functional-group tolerance, while the retained C2 sulfide serves as a handle for downstream C–S diversification. The method is applied to a formal asymmetric synthesis of a bioactive γ-secretase inhibitor. Full scope and condition data are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03671.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 Ag 催化 chemoselective cascade，高效构建 pyran-fused indole pseudo-natural products，共报道 41 个实例、3 类独特 scaffold，最高收率 93%。所得分子进一步用于抗肿瘤筛选，其中 3t 对 MGC-803、KYSE-30 和 MCF-7 的 IC50 分别为 5.25、6.31 和 5.53 μM；细胞实验显示 3t 可诱导 G2/M 期阻滞和 apoptosis，并抑制细胞迁移。当前证据未完整覆盖全部级联机理与结构–活性关系。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03671.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A chemoselective Ag-catalyzed cascade provides pyran-fused indole pseudo-natural products across 41 examples and three distinct scaffolds, with yields up to 93%. The products are evaluated for antitumor activity; compound 3t shows IC50 values of 5.25, 6.31, and 5.53 μM against MGC-803, KYSE-30, and MCF-7 cells, respectively. Cellular studies indicate G2/M arrest, induction of apoptosis, and suppression of cell migration. The complete cascade mechanism and structure–activity relationships are not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03424.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作通过调节电解质与溶剂，使同一 flavone 在室温、不分隔电解池中分歧生成 dihydroflavonol 或 3-iodoflavone，无需外加氧化剂或过渡金属。dihydroflavonol 分支的代表性条件为 KI/TBAPF6、MeOH/MeCN、graphite anode/Pt cathode、14 mA、室温 5 h，模型产物 70% 收率。BHT trapping、HRMS 和 CV 支持 I− 先被阳极氧化为 I•；在 MeOH 中 I• 经 HAT 形成 •OMe 进入 dihydroflavonol 路径，而 iodination 条件下 I• 直接加成 flavone，后续氧化/去质子化得到 3-iodoflavone，阴极同时析氢。当前证据未完整覆盖第二分支的全部优化参数。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03424.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Switching the electrolyte and solvent diverts the same flavone substrate electrochemically to either dihydroflavonols or 3-iodoflavones in an undivided cell at room temperature without an external oxidant or transition metal. Representative dihydroflavonol conditions use KI/TBAPF6 in MeOH/MeCN with a graphite anode, Pt cathode, 14 mA constant current, and 5 h reaction time, giving the model product in 70% yield. BHT trapping, HRMS, and CV support preferential anodic oxidation of I− to I•; in MeOH, HAT generates •OMe for the dihydroflavonol pathway, whereas under iodination conditions I• adds directly to the flavone followed by oxidation/deprotonation to the 3-iodoflavone, with H2 evolution at the cathode. Full optimization of the second branch is not completely captured.

10.1038/s41586-026-11108-z.zh: 该研究建立 thianthrenium ylide 作为通用 metal–carbene 前体的新平台，解决传统 sulfonium ylide 在 cyclopropanation 中 carbene transfer 效率不足的问题。该体系允许 olefin 与 carbene 两端同时广泛变化，而非仅局限于 styrene 等活化烯烃；thianthrene 的高位阻和低 Lewis basicity 被用来解释其可避免其他 sulfonium donor 的低能无效构型。thianthrenium salt 同时具有良好安全性，可进行规模化甚至 solid-state ball-milling 操作。除 cyclopropanation 外，该 carbene-transfer 平台还可进入 σ-bond insertion 和 sigmatropic rearrangement，显示其为一般性的 metal–carbene chemistry。
10.1038/s41586-026-11108-z.en: The study establishes thianthrenium ylides as a general platform for metal–carbene generation and transfer, overcoming the poor cyclopropanation performance of conventional sulfonium ylides. Both the olefin and carbene partners can be diversified, rather than restricting the reaction to activated alkenes such as styrenes. The steric bulk and low Lewis basicity of thianthrene are used to rationalize avoidance of low-energy unproductive minima that limit other sulfonium donors. Thianthrenium salts also show a favorable safety profile that permits scale-up, including solid-state ball-milling. Beyond cyclopropanation, the platform supports σ-bond insertion and sigmatropic rearrangements, establishing broader metal–carbene-transfer chemistry.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06078.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展首例 Ni 催化、AQ directing group 引导的位阻 gem-dimethyl cyclopropane secondary C(sp3)–H arylation，并以 trans-selectivity 获得拥挤的多取代 cyclopropane；方法还可扩展到 cyclobutane、cyclopentane、cyclohexane、spirocycle 和 adamantane 等骨架。机理研究表明反应先经常规 cis-nickelacycle，而最终 trans 产品来自反应条件下的热力学 epimerization；KIE 约为 1.0，说明 C–H cleavage 不太可能是速率决定步骤，DFT 与 epimerization 实验共同支持这一解释。当前证据未完整覆盖所有催化条件和底物收率。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06078.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops the first Ni-catalyzed AQ-directed secondary C(sp3)–H arylation of sterically congested gem-dimethyl cyclopropanes, furnishing highly substituted products with trans selectivity. The protocol extends to cyclobutanes, cyclopentanes, cyclohexanes, spirocycles, and adamantane-type frameworks. Mechanistic studies indicate formation of a conventional cis-nickelacycle followed by thermodynamically driven epimerization to the observed trans products; a KIE of about 1.0 argues against C–H cleavage as the rate-determining step, and DFT plus epimerization experiments support this interpretation. Full catalyst conditions and product-level yields are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03826.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展可见光诱导的 1,7-enyne 与 α-bromocarbonyl radical cascade spirocyclization，一步构建 functionalized spirooxindole，并表现高非对映选择性。模型条件使用 2 mol% fac-Ir(ppy)3、Cs2CO3、DCM，在 N2、室温、10 W blue LED 下 24 h，模型产物 65% 收率且 dr >20:1；无光或无 photocatalyst 时不反应。控制实验支持包含碳自由基加成、关键 1,5-hydride shift 和 radical rearrangement 的路径。芳基取代对反应重要，而部分 alkyl-tethered/internal alkene 或 terminal alkyne 底物不能参与。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03826.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A visible-light radical cascade spirocyclization of 1,7-enynes with α-bromocarbonyl compounds constructs functionalized spirooxindoles in one step with high diastereoselectivity. Model conditions use 2 mol% fac-Ir(ppy)3 and Cs2CO3 in DCM under N2 at room temperature with a 10 W blue LED for 24 h, giving the model product in 65% yield and >20:1 dr; no reaction occurs without light or photocatalyst. Control experiments support a pathway involving carbon-radical addition, a key 1,5-hydride shift, and radical rearrangement. Aryl substitution is important, whereas selected alkyl-tethered/internal alkenes and terminal alkynes fail. Full scope details are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03702.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作通过催化剂和温度控制同一 dienyne-amide/dialkyl bromomalonate 前体的 cascade rearrangement，实现三类 N,O-heterocycle 的分歧合成。Au 催化、室温条件下经历 cycloisomerization/cyclopropanation/1-aza-Cope cascade 生成 furan-fused dihydroazepine；升温则触发 formal [1,3]-rearrangement 得到高 dr 的 spirocycle；改用 Ag 催化时，经 oxotriene formation/vinyl-cyclopropane rearrangement 导向另一类 spirocycle。方法具有较广底物范围和可放大性，体现通过外部条件而非重新设计底物实现 skeletal divergence。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03702.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Catalyst and temperature control divert a common dienyne-amide/dialkyl bromomalonate precursor into three distinct N,O-heterocyclic scaffolds. Au catalysis at room temperature promotes a cycloisomerization/cyclopropanation/1-aza-Cope cascade to furan-fused dihydroazepines; heating triggers a formal [1,3]-rearrangement to highly diastereoselective spirocycles; switching to Ag catalysis redirects the pathway through oxotriene formation and vinyl-cyclopropane rearrangement to a different spirocyclic class. Broad scope and scalability are reported, illustrating skeletal divergence by external reaction control rather than substrate redesign.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01824.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 Brønsted base 促进、无过渡金属的 [3+2] cycloaddition，以比 diazonium salt 更稳定的 arylazo sulfone 构建 cyano- 和 phosphonyl-substituted tetrazole，并对 2,5-disubstitution 表现高区域选择性。代表性 cyano-tetrazole 条件为 arylazo sulfone 1.0 equiv、偶极组分 2.0 equiv、NaHCO3 4.0 equiv、MeCN、65 °C、空气；电子给/吸基、位阻芳基以及 thiophene、quinoline、fluorene、indazole 和天然产物衍生基团均可兼容。方法还展示 dual tetrazole、克级反应及后续转化。当前证据未完整覆盖 phosphonyl 分支的全部条件与机理。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01824.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A Brønsted-base-promoted, transition-metal-free [3+2] cycloaddition uses relatively stable arylazo sulfones instead of diazonium salts to construct cyano- and phosphonyl-substituted tetrazoles with high 2,5-regioselectivity. Representative cyano-tetrazole conditions use 1.0 equiv arylazo sulfone, 2.0 equiv coupling partner, 4.0 equiv NaHCO3 in MeCN at 65 °C under air. Electron-donating, electron-withdrawing, sterically demanding, heteroaryl, and natural-product-derived aryl groups are tolerated, and dual-tetrazole synthesis, gram-scale operation, and product transformations are demonstrated. Complete conditions and mechanism for the phosphonyl branch are not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01805.zh: 该研究以 N-aryloxysulfonamide 和 2-bromoallyl sulfone 为原料，通过“先碱后酸”的顺序处理合成 2-(arylsulfonylmethyl)benzofuran。Cs2CO3 首先促进 formal nucleophilic vinylic substitution，生成 O-aryl-N-vinyl hydroxylamine 中间体，随后 p-toluenesulfonic acid 触发室温 [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement/环化形成 benzofuran。该路线把易得前体转化为带 sulfonylmethyl 把手的 benzofuran，并且 allenoate ester 也可按类似模式反应得到 benzofuran ester，展示了该重排逻辑的可扩展性。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01805.en: Sequential base/acid treatment of N-aryloxysulfonamides and 2-bromoallyl sulfones provides 2-(arylsulfonylmethyl)benzofurans. Cs2CO3 first promotes a formal nucleophilic vinylic substitution to form an O-aryl-N-vinyl hydroxylamine intermediate, after which p-toluenesulfonic acid triggers a room-temperature [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement/cyclization to the benzofuran. The route converts readily accessible precursors into benzofurans bearing a sulfonylmethyl handle, and an allenoate ester undergoes an analogous sequence to furnish benzofuran esters, demonstrating the broader reach of the rearrangement logic.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01791.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究以模块化 Cu(I) 催化三组分反应获得 γ-羟基-γ-内酰胺，并经 N-酰亚胺鎓中间体构建 Pandanus 生物碱特征性的二氮杂螺环骨架，实现 pandanusine B、pandanusine A 和 pandamarine 的集体全合成。(±)-Pandanusine B 以 4 步、40% 总收率获得，(±)-pandanusine A 以 5 步、26.5% 总收率获得；HPLC 分离的 pandanusine A/B 对映体绝对构型由 VCD/ECD 与 DFT/TD-DFT 联合确定。当前证据未完整覆盖 pandamarine 全路线及全部单步条件。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01791.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A modular Cu(I)-catalyzed three-component reaction provides γ-hydroxy-γ-lactams that are converted through N-acyliminium intermediates into the diazaspirocyclic frameworks of Pandanus alkaloids, enabling collective total syntheses of pandanusines A and B and pandamarine. (±)-Pandanusine B is obtained in four steps and 40% overall yield, whereas (±)-pandanusine A is obtained in five steps and 26.5% overall yield. Absolute configurations of HPLC-separated pandanusine A/B enantiomers are assigned by combined VCD/ECD and DFT/TD-DFT analysis. The captured evidence does not fully cover the complete pandamarine sequence or every step condition.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01517.zh: 该研究在室温下以 3 mol% TfOH 催化邻苯胺基炔丙醇与醛反应，利用 CH(OCH3)3 原位生成缩醛并构建 3-亚甲基-2,3-二氢-4-喹诺酮，共报道 30 个衍生物。优化体系使用 DCM，CH(OCH3)3 同时承担缩醛化等多重作用。控制实验与既有 Meyer–Schuster 化学基础支持作者提出的串联路径：缩醛截获的 Meyer–Schuster 重排、1,3-迁移、分子内共轭加成以及甲氧基离去。该方法无需金属催化，并兼容多类取代底物。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01517.en: At room temperature, 3 mol% TfOH catalyzes reactions of o-anilinopropargyl alcohols with aldehydes, using CH(OCH3)3 to generate acetals in situ and furnishing 3-methylidene-2,3-dihydro-4-quinolones; 30 derivatives are reported. DCM is used under the optimized conditions, and CH(OCH3)3 plays multiple roles including acetal formation. Control experiments and established Meyer–Schuster chemistry support the authors’ proposed cascade involving acetal-intercepted Meyer–Schuster rearrangement, 1,3-migration, intramolecular conjugate addition, and methoxy-group departure. The method is metal-free and accommodates diverse substitution.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01447.zh: 该工作发展无过渡金属、无外加氧化剂的电化学一锅法，可先裂解多类 C(sp3)–X 键（包括 C–H、C–C、C–N 和 C–O），再对芳环 C(sp2)–H 进行酰氧基化。代表性条件使用碳阳极/Pt 阴极、8 mA、室温 22 h，并以 NH3/EtOH 显著改善电解质溶解和溶液电导；去除 NH3 或电流时反应停止。自由基捕获及同位素实验支持乙酰氧自由基直接参与芳环官能化，而不是传统 AcO− 亲核进攻。底物类型覆盖烷基芳烃、苄醇、苄胺、苄醚、苄基酮等，并给出醛、酮、酯和亚磺酸酯等多类产物。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01447.en: A transition-metal-free, external-oxidant-free electrochemical one-pot strategy combines cleavage of diverse C(sp3)–X bonds—including C–H, C–C, C–N, and C–O—with subsequent C(sp2)–H acyloxylation. Representative conditions use a carbon anode/Pt cathode at 8 mA and room temperature for 22 h, with NH3 in EtOH markedly improving electrolyte dissolution and solution conductivity; removing either NH3 or electricity suppresses the reaction. Radical-trapping and isotope experiments support direct arene functionalization by an acetoxy radical rather than classical AcO− nucleophilic attack. The scope includes alkylarenes, benzyl alcohols, amines, ethers, ketones, and related substrates, providing aldehydes, ketones, esters, sulfinates, and other products.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01127.zh: 该研究建立 Proc（propargyloxycarbonyl）保护胍基的 Pd 催化快速脱笼方法，在无需膦配体的条件下同时适用于芳香和脂肪胍。与此前 Alloc 型胍保护和经典胺脱笼相比，该体系显著加快脱保护动力学；机理研究表明，胍基相邻氮原子是加速反应的关键，作者提出其可能以“自配位”方式帮助招募 Pd 催化剂。该策略还能在活细胞中于数分钟内释放 Proc 保护的胍基荧光团，显示其用于时空控制含胍生物分子的潜力。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01127.en: A Pd-catalyzed fast-decaging method is developed for Proc (propargyloxycarbonyl)-caged guanidines without a phosphine ligand and works for both aromatic and aliphatic guanidines. Relative to the earlier Alloc-based guanidine system and classical amine decaging, the Proc platform shows markedly faster kinetics. Mechanistic studies identify the adjacent guanidino nitrogens as the key accelerating feature, and the authors propose a “self-liganded” mode that facilitates Pd recruitment. Proc-caged guanidinyl fluorophores can also be released within minutes in living cells, demonstrating potential for spatiotemporal control of guanidine-containing biomolecules.

10.1021/jacs.6c14997.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 trichothecene 天然产物的分歧不对称合成平台，实现 miophytocen D、roridin E、verrucarin J 和 verrucarol 的合成，其中包括 miophytocen D 的首次全合成和百毫克级 verrucarol 制备。路线的关键包括 exo-选择性 Diels–Alder 反应、仿生化学选择性 oxacyclization 构建四氢吡喃、构象控制的烯烃–环氧化物环化实现骨架分流，以及基于 RCM 的模块化大环化。已捕获证据还显示 DFT 用于解释 Diels–Alder 的 exo 选择性，并为作者提出的生物合成转化提供化学支持。
10.1021/jacs.6c14997.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops a divergent asymmetric platform for trichothecene natural products, enabling syntheses of miophytocen D, roridin E, verrucarin J, and verrucarol, including the first total synthesis of miophytocen D and hundred-milligram-scale access to verrucarol. Key elements are an exo-selective Diels–Alder reaction, a biomimetic chemoselective oxacyclization for tetrahydropyran construction, a conformation-controlled alkene–epoxide cyclization for scaffold divergence, and modular RCM-based macrocyclization. The captured evidence also uses DFT to rationalize exo selectivity and provides chemical support for a proposed biosynthetic transformation.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03878.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 C2 对称手性芳基硫醇催化的光驱动甲叉茚不对称氢二氟烷基化，以 α-溴二氟酰胺为自由基前体，获得含偕二氟基的手性茚衍生酰胺，并实现良好至优异收率和高对映选择性。机理研究表明，底物 gem-dimethyl 取代可放大两条非对映 HAT 过渡态之间的自由能差，而底物 N-phenyl 与硫醇催化剂苄位取代基之间的 π–π 相互作用被作者认为是对映控制的重要来源。当前证据未完整覆盖全部优化条件和底物级数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03878.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A C2-symmetric chiral arylthiol catalyzes a photodriven asymmetric hydrodifluoroalkylation of methyleneindanes with α-bromodifluoroamides, giving chiral gem-difluorinated indane-derived amides in good-to-excellent yields and high enantioselectivities. Mechanistic studies indicate that a gem-dimethyl substituent amplifies the free-energy difference between competing diastereomeric HAT transition states, while a π–π interaction between the substrate N-phenyl group and the catalyst benzylic substituent is proposed to contribute to enantiocontrol. Full optimization and product-level scope data are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03717.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究报道 Ni 催化、无导向基 N-磺酰和 N-芳基醛亚胺与烷基卤化物的还原性烷基化。反应在环境温度下可使用未活化一级、二级和三级烷基碘化物以及部分活化烷基溴化物，并具有较广官能团兼容性；复杂分子来源烷基碘、克级反应和 β-氨基酯衍生化展示了合成实用性。摘要中的机理研究支持 Ni 介导生成可进入溶液的烷基自由基，并与自由基从外球途径加成醛亚胺的模型一致。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03717.en: Abstract-based: A nickel-catalyzed reductive alkylation of directing-group-free N-sulfonyl and N-aryl aldimines operates at ambient temperature with unactivated primary, secondary, and tertiary alkyl iodides as well as selected activated alkyl bromides, with broad functional-group tolerance. Complex-molecule-derived alkyl iodides, a gram-scale reaction, and β-amino-ester derivatizations demonstrate synthetic utility. Mechanistic studies summarized in the abstract support nickel-mediated generation of a solution-accessible alkyl radical and are consistent with outer-sphere radical addition to the imine.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03451.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究利用芳基、乙基和叔丁基二硫键在未保护多肽中的本征反应性差异，实现“结构架构指导”的顺序二硫键编辑，无需先全局还原或引入额外保护基。不同二硫键可与匹配的还原/碱激活模式选择性响应；芳基二硫键还可进行与脂肪族二硫键正交的亚磷酸酯介导转化。方法在多种肽序列、不同二硫键位置及缺少芳香残基的体系中仍可工作，为复杂多肽中逐个操控 S–S 键提供可编程策略。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03451.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study exploits intrinsic reactivity differences among aryl, ethyl, and tert-butyl disulfides embedded in fully unprotected peptides to enable architecture-guided sequential disulfide editing without global reduction or additional protecting groups. Distinct disulfide classes respond selectively to matched reductant/base-activation modes, while aryl disulfides also undergo a phosphite-mediated transformation orthogonal to aliphatic disulfides. The approach tolerates varied peptide sequences, disulfide positions, and systems lacking aromatic residues, providing a programmable strategy for editing individual S–S bonds in complex peptides.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03250.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究报道外消旋烷基硼酸酯与（杂）芳基卤化物的首例对映汇聚脱硼不对称 Suzuki–Miyaura 交叉偶联，由光氧化还原/Ni 双催化实现。反应覆盖多类带不同官能团的（杂）芳基溴化物，并直接从外消旋 C(sp3)–B 前体构建手性 C(sp2)–C(sp3) 键。作者指出 4-cyanopyridine 与 pentafluoropyridine 的协同使用对兼顾高反应性和高对映选择性至关重要。当前证据未完整覆盖全部条件、数值和机理实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03250.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study reports the first enantioconvergent deboronative asymmetric Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling of racemic alkylboronic esters with (hetero)aryl halides under dual photoredox/nickel catalysis. Diverse functionally substituted (hetero)aryl bromides are represented, allowing chiral C(sp2)–C(sp3) bond formation directly from racemic C(sp3)–B precursors. The authors identify cooperative use of 4-cyanopyridine and pentafluoropyridine as crucial for achieving both high reactivity and excellent enantioselectivity. Full conditions, numerical scope, and mechanistic studies are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01925.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作发展无金属、氟化物促进的 hydrocyanamidation，使 N-cyano-N-aryl-p-methylbenzenesulfonamide（NCTS）与活化烯烃或炔烃反应，制备结构多样的二取代 cyanamide。代表性体系使用 TBD/Et3N·3HF 各 1.0 equiv、MeCN、室温、空气中 12–24 h；适用底物包括 alkynone、alkyl propiolate、enone 以及 2-(alkenyl/alkynyl)pyridine。克级反应和后期官能化验证实用性，作者提出反应经原位生成的 cyanamide anion 加成。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01925.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A metal-free, fluoride-promoted hydrocyanamidation couples N-cyano-N-aryl-p-methylbenzenesulfonamide (NCTS) with activated alkenes or alkynes to furnish structurally diverse disubstituted cyanamides. Representative conditions use 1.0 equiv each of TBD and Et3N·3HF in MeCN at room temperature under air for 12–24 h. Alkynones, alkyl propiolates, enones, and 2-(alkenyl/alkynyl)pyridines are represented; gram-scale synthesis and late-stage functionalization demonstrate utility. The authors propose addition of an in situ generated cyanamide anion.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01880.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发现共轭 α,β,γ,δ-不饱和内酯在氰化物作用下发生出乎预期的重排，生成具有相邻醚、腈和内酰胺官能团的新型三环 furopyrrolidinone。反应对氰化物计量和底物结构高度敏感，作者将其与氰化物对不饱和内酯的多次加成联系起来。两个产物的单晶 X 射线结构用于支持立体化学指认，并为动态平衡过程提供证据。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物适用性和详细机理序列。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01880.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Conjugated α,β,γ,δ-unsaturated lactones undergo an unexpected cyanide-mediated rearrangement to new tricyclic furopyrrolidinones bearing adjacent ether, nitrile, and lactam functionality. The transformation is strongly dependent on cyanide stoichiometry and substrate structure and is attributed to multiple cyanide additions to suitable unsaturated lactones. Single-crystal X-ray structures of two products support the stereochemical assignments and provide evidence for a dynamic-equilibrium process. The complete substrate boundaries and detailed mechanistic sequence are not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01197.zh: 该工作以 prolinol 支撑的四配位 Al 阳离子催化 3-取代吲哚 C2–H 活化，并与 enone 进行不对称 Michael 加成，获得 C2-烷基化吲哚且具有良好至优异对映选择性。优化反应使用 10 mol% 手性 Al 阳离子催化剂和 5 equiv Michael 受体，室温进行。机理研究支持配体胺碱位点与 Lewis 酸性 Al 中心协同的 concerted metalation–deprotonation 为速率决定步骤；化学计量 NMR 直接观察到 on-cycle Al 络合物，且封闭配体胺位点会完全抑制 C2–H 活化。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01197.en: Prolinol-supported tetracoordinate aluminum cations catalyze C2–H activation of 3-substituted indoles followed by enantioselective Michael addition to enones, giving C2-alkylated indoles with good-to-excellent enantioselectivity. Optimized reactions use 10 mol% of the chiral Al cation catalyst and 5 equiv of the Michael acceptor at room temperature. Mechanistic studies support ligand-assisted concerted metalation–deprotonation by the basic amine and Lewis-acidic Al center as the rate-determining step. Stoichiometric NMR directly detects an on-cycle aluminum complex, and blocking the ligand amine site completely suppresses C2–H activation.

10.1021/jacs.6c14478.zh: 该研究发展光氧化还原/Ni 双催化的对映汇聚醛烯丙基化，以 vinyl cyclic carbonate 与醛制备带全取代季碳立体中心的手性 allylic 1,3-diol。优化条件为 NiCl2·6H2O 10 mol%、手性配体 L4 10 mol%、4CzIPN 2 mol%、Hantzsch ester 1.5 equiv、K3PO4 1.5 equiv，THF 中 30 °C 6 h；模型产物以 76% 收率、98% ee、>20:1 dr 获得且不检测到线性异构体。控制和光物理实验支持还原猝灭路径，作者将单体手性 Ni 络合物视为立体控制单元，并提出亲核 allyl–Ni 中间体对醛加成。
10.1021/jacs.6c14478.en: A dual photoredox/nickel enantioconvergent allylation of aldehydes with vinyl cyclic carbonates provides chiral allylic 1,3-diols bearing fully substituted quaternary stereocenters. Optimized conditions use 10 mol% NiCl2·6H2O, 10 mol% chiral ligand L4, 2 mol% 4CzIPN, 1.5 equiv Hantzsch ester, and 1.5 equiv K3PO4 in THF at 30 °C for 6 h, giving the model product in 76% yield, 98% ee, and >20:1 dr with no detectable linear isomer. Control and photophysical studies support a reductive-quenching pathway; the authors identify a monomeric chiral Ni complex as the stereocontrol element and propose nucleophilic allyl–Ni addition to the aldehyde.

10.1021/jacs.6c14022.zh: 该研究报道 Cu 催化 gem-difluorocyclopropane 与 aniline 的对映专一交叉偶联，通过张力驱动 C–C 键活化生成支链 fluoroallylamine，并为 Cu 催化中的 C–C 氧化加成提供实验与计算证据。标准体系使用 CuTC 15 mol%、meso 二胺配体 30 mol%、MeOH、40 °C、N2；由对映富集 (R) 底物得到立体反转的 (S) 产物，73% 收率、96% ee（96% es）。作者进一步提出非常规的协同取代型还原消除，同时涉及 C–F 与 N–H 键断裂，从而绕过传统 allyl–metal 中间体。
10.1021/jacs.6c14022.en: A copper-catalyzed enantiospecific cross-coupling of gem-difluorocyclopropanes with anilines uses strain-driven C–C activation to form branched fluoroallylamines and provides experimental and computational evidence for C–C oxidative addition to copper. Standard conditions employ 15 mol% CuTC, 30 mol% a meso diamine ligand, MeOH, 40 °C, and N2; an enantioenriched (R) substrate gives the stereoinverted (S) product in 73% yield and 96% ee (96% es). The authors further propose an unusual concerted substitution-type reductive elimination involving simultaneous C–F and N–H bond cleavage, bypassing conventional allyl–metal intermediates.

10.1021/jacs.6c13291.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究通过刻意减慢 β-ketoenamine COF 的形成动力学，捕获并结构表征毫米级中间超分子组装体（ISA），为 COF 生长中长期假设的中间阶段提供直接结构证据。i-TpTAPT 单晶可在无需催化剂或调节剂的情况下，经 150 °C、24 h 温和热处理转化为 COF；热分析和结构变化支持 enol-imine 向 keto-enamine 的后续互变异构。三个相近体系的比较表明，单体内在反应性会决定是否及如何进入有序框架。该结果同时提出一种酸自由、潜在可规模化的 COF 制备思路。
10.1021/jacs.6c13291.en: Evidence coverage is partial. By deliberately slowing β-ketoenamine COF formation, the study captures and structurally characterizes millimeter-scale crystals of an intermediate supramolecular assembly (ISA), providing direct structural evidence for a long-hypothesized stage in COF growth. i-TpTAPT crystals convert to the COF by mild thermal treatment at 150 °C for 24 h without added catalyst or modulator; thermal and structural data support subsequent enol-imine-to-keto-enamine tautomerization. Comparison of three related systems shows that intrinsic monomer reactivity governs framework evolution, while the catalyst-free route suggests a greener, potentially scalable COF synthesis strategy.

10.1021/jacs.6c12207.zh: 该研究在阴离子交换膜电解槽中使用碳载 Co 催化剂进行含氮芳烃选择性电催化加氢，并把活性归因于工作状态下适中的 Co(0)/CoOx 比例。以 CoSO4·7H2O 为前体、750 °C 煅烧得到的优化催化剂在环境电解条件下将吡啶转化为哌啶，收率 >99%；原位 Co K-edge XAFS 显示，过度还原或氧化物比例过高都会降低活性。动力学与 DFT 支持吡啶和表面 Hads 共吸附的 Langmuir–Hinshelwood 型路径。通过间歇电解抑制长期运行中的过度还原后，克级吡啶可转化为哌啶，收率 89%。
10.1021/jacs.6c12207.en: A carbon-supported cobalt catalyst in an anion-exchange-membrane electrolyzer selectively hydrogenates nitrogen-containing aromatics, with activity governed by an intermediate Co(0)/CoOx ratio under operating conditions. The optimized catalyst, prepared from CoSO4·7H2O and calcined at 750 °C, converts pyridine to piperidine in >99% yield under ambient electrolysis conditions; operando Co K-edge XAFS shows that either excessive reduction or an oxide-rich state lowers activity. Kinetic analysis and DFT support a Langmuir–Hinshelwood-type pathway involving coadsorbed pyridine and surface Hads. Intermittent electrolysis prevents over-reduction during prolonged operation and enables gram-scale conversion to piperidine in 89% yield.

10.1038/s41929-026-01616-6.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究针对 Ni(I)/Ni(III) C(sp2)–杂原子偶联中氧化加成慢、底物范围窄和催化剂负载高的问题，进行机理导向的 ligand/additive 设计。新配体 dpabpy 在高反应性的 Ni(I) metalloradical 与稳定的方平面 Ni(II) ligand-centered-radical 状态之间取得平衡；非亲核碱 BTMG 则通过可逆配位促进 bench-stable Ni(II) 前催化剂在蓝光下直接生成 Ni(I)。该体系可使电子丰富 aryl bromide 与 N/O/S/P 亲核试剂偶联，Ni 负载最低达 100 ppm，并兼容位阻较大的亲核试剂、克级合成和复杂分子的后期官能化。
10.1038/s41929-026-01616-6.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Mechanistically guided ligand/additive design addresses the slow oxidative addition, narrow scope, and high catalyst loadings of Ni(I)/Ni(III) C(sp2)–heteroatom coupling. The dpabpy ligand balances a highly reactive Ni(I) metalloradical with a stabilizing square-planar Ni(II) ligand-centered-radical state, while non-nucleophilic BTMG promotes direct blue-light generation of Ni(I) from a bench-stable Ni(II) precatalyst through reversible coordination. Electron-rich aryl bromides can be coupled with N-, O-, S-, and P-based nucleophiles at nickel loadings as low as 100 ppm, including sterically encumbered nucleophiles, gram-scale synthesis, and late-stage functionalization.

10.1021/jacs.6c09785.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以具有 gyroid 纳米结构且一端嵌段已交联的 ABC 三嵌段共聚物作为稳健三维模板，在凝胶内部对未交联嵌段进行空间选择性化学改性，从而把材料的化学功能与原有平衡形貌部分解耦。作者展示了 C 端嵌段选择性胺化用于金属离子配位/吸附和纳米颗粒定向生成，以及分别局限在 B 或 C 相的磺化；后者得到可保持结构完整性且体积膨胀最高约 600 vol % 的单体 gyroid 水凝胶。顺序和分区功能化还可产生 pH 响应的纳米结构 polyampholyte。
10.1021/jacs.6c09785.en: Abstract-based: Self-assembled ABC triblock terpolymers with a gyroid nanoarchitecture and one cross-linked end block are used as robust three-dimensional templates for spatially defined in-gel functionalization of the remaining tethered blocks, partially decoupling chemical functionality from equilibrium morphology. The abstract demonstrates selective amine attachment in the C block for metal-ion coordination, uptake, and nanostructure-directed nanoparticle synthesis, as well as phase-confined sulfonation of either the B or C block. The latter produces monolithic gyroidal hydrogels that retain structural integrity while swelling by up to about 600 vol%, and sequential/block-selective functionalization yields a pH-responsive nanostructured polyampholyte.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06753.zh: 该研究建立光氧化还原/Co 双催化平台，通过 Kharasch 型加成和 cotelomerization 合成 α-氯代羰基化合物。烷基自由基先加成 Michael 受体，随后 Co–Cl 对生成的 α-羰基自由基进行卤原子转移；标准 Kharasch 体系使用 Co 催化剂、Ir(ppy)3、collidine/其盐体系和 MeCN，蓝光照射 15 h。平台兼容由 redox-active ester、oxalate 单电子还原或烯烃 MHAT 等不同方式生成烷基自由基。TEMPO 完全抑制模型反应并捕获自由基加合物，支持自由基路径。作者同时指出，MHAT cotelomerization 对脂肪和缺电子烯烃的化学选择性仍是当前局限。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06753.en: A dual photoredox/cobalt platform synthesizes α-chlorocarbonyls through Kharasch-type addition and cotelomerization. Alkyl radicals add to Michael acceptors, after which cobalt chloride transfers a halogen atom to the resulting α-carbonyl radicals. Representative Kharasch conditions use the cobalt catalyst and Ir(ppy)3 in MeCN with collidine/collidinium chloride under blue light for 15 h. The platform supports alkyl-radical generation by single-electron reduction of redox-active esters or an oxalate and by MHAT from alkenes. TEMPO completely suppresses the model reaction and traps a radical adduct, supporting the radical pathway. The authors identify insufficient chemoselectivity in MHAT cotelomerization of aliphatic and electron-deficient alkenes as a current limitation.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03465.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究实现可见光介导的 furan→pyridazine 骨架编辑，以 hydrazine hydrate 完成形式上的 O→NN 原子对交换。反应在无金属、室温、空气条件下进行，可由易得 furan 以完全区域控制得到二、三和四取代 pyridazine，并展示广泛官能团兼容性、克级反应和复杂分子的后期骨架编辑。机理实验提示水可抑制 hydrazine 对激发态光催化剂的猝灭，其他实验则支持氧来源活性物种参与整体转化；当前证据未完整覆盖全部机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03465.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Visible-light-mediated skeletal editing converts furans to pyridazines through a formal O-to-NN atom-pair exchange with hydrazine hydrate. The metal-free reaction proceeds at room temperature in air and provides di-, tri-, and tetrasubstituted pyridazines with complete regiocontrol, broad functional-group tolerance, gram-scale synthesis, and late-stage editing of complex molecules. Mechanistic experiments suggest that water suppresses hydrazine-mediated quenching of the excited photocatalyst, while additional experiments support involvement of oxygen-derived reactive species. The complete mechanistic sequence is not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01817.zh: 该研究报道 amycomycin（vancoresmycin 的 aglycon）C24-去甲基类似物的汇聚式合成，并重点解决高度拥挤片段之间的连接问题。最初设想通过醛/酮 aldol 加成–消除构建中央 C23–C25 enone；模型体系可行，但在高度官能化真实片段上因位阻而无法完成消除，因此作者将逆合成断键改到 C23–C24。成功路线以 vinyl iodide 为关键中间体，经 Li/I 交换形成乙烯基亲核体后与醛进行汇聚偶联；同时利用 Boron–Wittig olefination 构建位阻显著的 vinyl boronate。路线末端再引入 tetramic acid，并通过复杂 3-acyl tetramic acid 的 O→C 酰基迁移完成完整骨架。该工作表明，对于这类高氧化态、强位阻 polyketide，改变汇聚断键位置与把 tetramic-acid 重排后移到末期，可显著提高路线可行性。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01817.en: The study reports a convergent synthesis of a C24-desmethyl analogue of amycomycin, the aglycon of vancoresmycin, with emphasis on solving a highly congested fragment-coupling problem. An initial aldehyde/ketone aldol-addition–elimination plan for the central C23–C25 enone worked in model systems but failed on advanced fragments because steric congestion prevented productive elimination. The retrosynthetic disconnection was therefore shifted to C23–C24. In the successful route, a vinyl iodide serves as the pivotal intermediate; Li/I exchange generates a vinyl nucleophile for convergent addition to the aldehyde, while a Boron–Wittig olefination provides access to sterically congested vinyl boronates. Tetramic acid is introduced late, followed by an O-to-C acyl transfer on the complex 3-acyl tetramic acid to complete the desmethyl amycomycin skeleton. The work shows how changing the convergent bond construction and postponing tetramic-acid rearrangement can unlock densely functionalized, sterically demanding polyketide targets.

10.1002/anie.8317220.zh: 该研究利用 triplet–triplet annihilation photon upconversion（TTA-UC）把低能绿光转换为可触发 photoclick 的蓝光，从而避免传统 9,10-phenanthrenequinone–electron-rich alkene（PQ–ERA）反应对 UV/深蓝光的依赖。代表性体系以 PdOEP 为 sensitizer、DPA 为 annihilator，在 550 nm LED、50 mW cm−2 下运行；绿光先激发 PdOEP，经三重态能量转移和 TTA 生成 DPA 单重激发态及蓝光，再被 PQ 吸收并启动 [2+2] photoclick。该 PdOEP/DPA 体系最高 upconversion quantum yield 达 17.2%，在 50 mW cm−2 下仍为 5.3%；photoclick 可在约 5 min 内完成，kobs 最高约 0.015 s−1。作者还验证了另一套 BODIPY/perylene TTA-UC 组合，并通过 PEG 包封把反应拓展到水相、不同 pH 和 hydrogel 环境。
10.1002/anie.8317220.en: The study uses triplet–triplet annihilation photon upconversion (TTA-UC) to convert low-energy green light into blue photons capable of driving 9,10-phenanthrenequinone–electron-rich alkene (PQ–ERA) photoclick reactions, avoiding the usual dependence on UV or deep-blue excitation. A representative system employs PdOEP as the sensitizer and DPA as the annihilator under a 550 nm LED at 50 mW cm−2. Green-light excitation of PdOEP is followed by triplet energy transfer and TTA to generate the DPA singlet state and blue emission, which overlaps the PQ absorption and triggers the photoclick event. The PdOEP/DPA system reaches an upconversion quantum yield of 17.2% and still gives 5.3% at 50 mW cm−2; the photoclick reaction can finish within about 5 min with kobs up to approximately 0.015 s−1. A second BODIPY/perylene TTA-UC pair was also demonstrated, and PEG encapsulation enabled aqueous reactions across different pH values and in hydrogel matrices.

10.1002/anie.8267819.zh: 该研究发展 Pd 催化不对称 bisallylation/环闭复分解串联，由简单 coumarin 衍生的三取代烯烃快速构建带相邻三级/全碳四级立体中心的 steroid-like 多环骨架。核心步骤使用空气稳定的 allyl potassium trifluoroborate 与商业 allyl acetate，在新设计的手性 biaryl monophosphine/Pd2(dba)3 体系中一次安装两个 allyl 单元；模型底物经优化在 CPME、30 °C、48 h 下可得 95% 收率、95:5 er 和 >20:1 dr，随后加入 Grubbs II 催化剂完成 RCM。产物保留烯烃和酯等可继续衍生的官能团。计算研究表明，顺序反应中 bis-π-allylpalladium 中间体的形成是速率决定步骤。该催化体系还可用于 cyclic N-sulfonyl imine，生成手性 homoallylic amine 和更复杂的含氮多环骨架。
10.1002/anie.8267819.en: The study develops a Pd-catalyzed asymmetric bisallylation/ring-closing-metathesis sequence that rapidly converts simple coumarin-derived trisubstituted alkenes into steroid-like polycycles bearing adjacent tertiary and all-carbon quaternary stereocenters. The key bisallylation uses air-stable allyl potassium trifluoroborate and commercial allyl acetate to install two allyl groups under a newly designed chiral biaryl-monophosphine/Pd2(dba)3 system. For the optimized model substrate, CPME at 30 °C for 48 h gives the bisallylation product in 95% yield, 95:5 er, and >20:1 dr, after which Grubbs II catalysis closes the ring. The products retain alkene and ester handles for further diversification. Computations identify formation of the bis-π-allylpalladium intermediate as the rate-determining step of the sequential process. The catalyst system is also applicable to cyclic N-sulfonyl imines, providing chiral homoallylic amines and more complex nitrogen-containing polycyclic frameworks.

10.1002/anie.6888467.zh: 该研究实现 Pd(0) 催化的 thiazole N-oxide C4 位直接 atroposelective C–H arylation，以无需预官能化的 C–H/aryl bromide 偶联直接建立 heterobiaryl 手性轴。反应的关键是作者设计的 point- and axially chiral 单膦配体 L12；代表性优化条件为约 5 mol% Pd、10 mol% L12、30 mol% PivOH、Cs2CO3、toluene、80 °C，模型产物可达 93% 分离收率和 93:7 er。未氧化的对应 thiazole 在相同体系中不反应，显示 N-oxide 对提高 1,3-azole C–H arylation 反应性至关重要。平行 KIE 仅约 1.2，结合 PivOH 对速率而非 ee 的影响，支持 carboxylate-assisted CMD 型 C–H 活化且其并非 turnover-limiting。方法兼容多类 aryl/heteroaryl bromide，并可克级放大；N-oxide 后续还原不会导致手性轴消旋。
10.1002/anie.6888467.en: The study achieves Pd(0)-catalyzed direct atroposelective C4 C–H arylation of thiazole N-oxides, creating heterobiaryl stereogenic axes without prefunctionalizing the heteroarene C–H partner. A designer point- and axially chiral monophosphine ligand, L12, is central to both reactivity and stereocontrol. Representative optimized conditions use about 5 mol% Pd, 10 mol% L12, 30 mol% PivOH, Cs2CO3, and toluene at 80 °C, affording the model atropisomer in 93% isolated yield and 93:7 er. The corresponding unoxidized thiazole is unreactive under the same conditions, showing the importance of N-oxide activation for 1,3-azole C–H arylation. A parallel KIE of only about 1.2, together with the effect of PivOH on rate but not enantioselectivity, supports a carboxylate-assisted CMD-type C–H activation that is unlikely to be turnover-limiting. The method accommodates aryl and heteroaryl bromides, scales to gram quantities, and permits N-oxide reduction without racemization of the chiral axis.

10.1002/anie.6111891.zh: 该研究建立 Co 催化环状 1,2- 与 1,3-diacid anhydride 的不对称去对称化氢化，可直接获得高对映富集的 γ- 和 δ-lactone，最高达 99% ee，并覆盖不同环尺寸、非环底物、含氮底物及 bridged anhydride。优化体系以 CoBr2/手性 diphosphine 为核心；代表性条件为 3 mol% Co、3 mol% ligand、THF、80 °C、80 bar H2、24 h，并需要还原剂活化前催化剂。不同底物可在 (S)-Binapine 与 (R,R)-Ph-BPE 等配体之间匹配以维持高选择性，且多种药物/天然产物相关 lactone 可克级制备。DFT 指向 d7 Co(II) dihydride 为活性物种，氢化走 outer-sphere hydride-transfer，而不是依赖底物强配位的 inner-sphere 路径；作者据此解释其对结构差异明显的 anhydride 仍具有较广底物适用性。
10.1002/anie.6111891.en: The study establishes cobalt-catalyzed asymmetric desymmetrizing hydrogenation of cyclic 1,2- and 1,3-diacid anhydrides, providing highly enantioenriched γ- and δ-lactones with up to 99% ee. The scope includes different ring sizes, an acyclic substrate, an N-heterocyclic substrate, and bridged anhydrides. The optimized platform is based on CoBr2 and a chiral diphosphine; representative conditions use 3 mol% Co, 3 mol% ligand, THF, 80 °C, 80 bar H2, and 24 h, with reductive precatalyst activation required. Ligands such as (S)-Binapine and (R,R)-Ph-BPE are matched to different substrate classes to maintain high stereoselectivity, and several pharmaceutically or natural-product-relevant lactones are prepared on gram scale. DFT identifies a d7 Co(II) dihydride as the catalytically active species and supports an outer-sphere hydride-transfer pathway rather than a coordination-dependent inner-sphere mechanism, which the authors use to rationalize the broad structural tolerance.

10.1002/anie.4546692.zh: 该研究完成与肠道菌 Ruminococcus gnavus 多糖相关的支化 glucorhamnan 五糖、十糖和二十糖的立体选择性化学合成，并进一步研究其构象与促炎活性。路线以 orthogonally protected 五糖重复单元为核心：rhamnan 主链中的 1,2-trans 键借助邻基参与控制，而连接 isomaltose 侧链的拥挤 1,2-cis-α-glucosidic 键是主要难点。初始全 benzyl 保护的 disaccharide donor 易发生 1,6 键断裂；把 C6 保护基改为电子吸拉的 benzoyl 后，[3+2] glycosylation 可在 90% 收率、单一 α 选择性下得到关键五糖。随后通过 Yu glycosylation 迭代延长得到十糖与二十糖。NMR 与 MD 显示这些 glucorhamnan 形成延展的左手螺旋构象并规律暴露 isomaltose 侧链；合成寡糖可诱导 BMDC 释放 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-12，其中 TNF-α 响应在等摩尔比较时随糖链增长而增强。
10.1002/anie.4546692.en: The study completes stereoselective chemical syntheses of branched glucorhamnan penta-, deca-, and eicosaccharides related to the polysaccharide of the gut bacterium Ruminococcus gnavus, followed by conformational and pro-inflammatory evaluation. The route is built around an orthogonally protected pentasaccharide repeat unit: neighboring-group participation controls the 1,2-trans linkages of the rhamnan backbone, whereas the sterically demanding 1,2-cis-α-glucosidic linkage connecting the isomaltose side chain is the central challenge. A fully benzyl-protected disaccharide donor undergoes problematic 1,6-bond fragmentation, but replacing the C6 protecting group with electron-withdrawing benzoyl enables the key [3+2] glycosylation in 90% yield with exclusive α selectivity. Iterative Yu glycosylation then gives the deca- and eicosaccharides. NMR and MD analyses show an extended left-handed helicoidal conformation with regular exposure of the isomaltose side chains. The synthetic glycans induce TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-12 release from BMDCs, with TNF-α responses increasing with chain length on an equimolar basis.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05418.zh: 该研究发展 Cu/Pd 协同催化的 1,3-enyne allylboration，并利用 electrophile 身份控制化学/区域发散：普通 allyl carbonate 使反应选择性生成 borylated 1,4-enallene，而 dienyl carbonate 则把反应导向 propargylation，得到 1,3,7-dienyne。代表性 allyl-carbonate 条件使用 B2pin2 1.5 equiv、CuCl 5 mol%、Pd(dba)2 5 mol%、DavePhos 15 mol%、toluene、50 °C、16 h；dienyl-carbonate 分支则使用 CyJohnPhos，并在 60 °C 约 4 h 完成。两类反应均表现出较高区域/立体选择性，并提供可继续转化的 organoboronate。DFT 指向共同的 η3-allyl–η1-allenyl Pd 中间体：allyl 派生中间体发生 1,1′-型 reductive elimination 形成四取代 allene，而 vinyl-substituted allyl-Pd 更倾向发生分子内 propargylic addition，由此解释 electrophile-controlled 分流。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05418.en: The study develops a Cu/Pd-catalyzed allylboration of 1,3-enynes in which the electrophile controls chemo- and regiochemical divergence. Simple allyl carbonates selectively furnish borylated 1,4-enallenes, whereas dienyl carbonates redirect the reaction toward propargylation to give 1,3,7-dienynes. Representative allyl-carbonate conditions use 1.5 equiv B2pin2, 5 mol% CuCl, 5 mol% Pd(dba)2, 15 mol% DavePhos, toluene, 50 °C, and 16 h; the dienyl-carbonate branch uses CyJohnPhos and proceeds at 60 °C over about 4 h. Both manifolds provide synthetically useful organoboronates with high regio- and stereoselectivity. DFT supports a common η3-allyl–η1-allenyl Pd intermediate: the allyl-derived species undergoes 1,1′-type reductive elimination to form the tetrasubstituted allene, whereas the vinyl-substituted allyl-Pd species preferentially undergoes intramolecular propargylic addition, accounting for the electrophile-controlled switch in product class.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05353.zh: 该研究报道 Ir 催化的跨酰胺骨架烯烃迁移，直接把亲电性的 α,β-unsaturated amide 转化为亲核性的 enamide。该过程不是沿连续碳链 chain-walking，而是利用 amide 两侧彼此分离的片段进行分子内氢转移；不需要外加氢源，整体 redox-neutral、atom-economical，且不依赖强碱。模型反应的优化条件为 [Ir(COD)2]NTf2 10 mol%、双膦 L1 12 mol%、Cs2CO3 1.3 equiv、PhF、130 °C、5 h，目标 enamide 以 93% NMR 收率形成。体系兼容 benzyl ether、silane、thioether、CF3、CN、sulfone 等多种官能团。机理研究支持不可逆的 intramolecular hydrogen-transfer pathway，而非传统链行走异构化；作者还获得了不对称分子内 transfer hydrogenation 的初步结果。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05353.en: The study reports an Ir-catalyzed alkene translocation across an amide linkage that directly converts electrophilic α,β-unsaturated amides into nucleophilic enamides. Rather than chain walking along a continuous carbon framework, the reaction transfers hydrogen intramolecularly between two segments separated by the amide; it requires no external hydrogen source and is redox-neutral, atom-economical, and free of strong base. Optimized model conditions use 10 mol% [Ir(COD)2]NTf2, 12 mol% diphosphine L1, 1.3 equiv Cs2CO3, PhF, 130 °C, and 5 h, affording the enamide in 93% NMR yield. Benzyl ether, silane, thioether, CF3, nitrile, sulfone, and other functional groups are tolerated. Mechanistic studies support an irreversible intramolecular hydrogen-transfer pathway rather than conventional chain-walking isomerization, and the authors also report preliminary success toward an enantioselective intramolecular transfer-hydrogenation variant.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03933.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究报道可见光介导的三组分串联脱羧双官能团化，以 glycosyl acid、styrene 和 cyanopyridine 一步组装多取代 C-alkyl glycoside。作者指出，该方法兼容多种 styrene、保护的 monosaccharide 与药物活性片段，并可进行克级制备。机理研究支持 glycosyl radical 参与的串联过程：glycosyl acid 经脱羧产生糖基自由基，随后参与 styrene 的多组分官能团化并与 pyridine 组分结合。该方法针对既有 C-glycoside 合成多以两组分偶联为主的局限，提供了以 styrene 为连接平台的三组分糖基化策略。由于当前证据仅为 Abstract，本摘要不补写未捕获的具体光催化剂、反应条件、逐项收率/选择性或更细机理控制实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03933.en: Abstract-based: the study reports a visible-light-mediated three-component tandem decarboxylative difunctionalization of glycosyl acids, styrenes, and cyanopyridines for one-step assembly of polysubstituted C-alkyl glycosides. The authors state that the method tolerates various styrenes, protected monosaccharides, and pharmaceutically active fragments and can be performed on gram scale. Mechanistic studies support a tandem pathway involving glycosyl radicals generated through decarboxylation, followed by multicomponent functionalization of the styrene and incorporation of the pyridine component. The strategy addresses the predominance of two-component couplings in C-glycoside synthesis by using styrene as a platform for three-component glycosylation. Because the current evidence is Abstract-only, this summary does not reconstruct uncaptured photocatalysts, detailed conditions, individual yields/selectivities, or additional mechanistic controls.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03918.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的底物范围和完整机理实验不作补写。该研究发展了 oxime ether 与 indole 衍生物的分子间可见光能量转移型 [2+2] cycloaddition，通过 indole dearomatization 快速构建同时含 indoline 与 azetidine 单元的稠合或桥环多环结构。作者以能量转移产生的 triplet-state indole 为反应逻辑基础，将此前主要见于分子内体系的 indole/imine 类 [2+2] 反应扩展到分子间版本，并需要控制 head-to-head/head-to-tail 区域选择性以及底物自二聚等竞争过程。已捕获的优化表显示，不同 photocatalyst 与溶剂会显著影响产率和区域异构体比例，部分条件可达到约 90% 级别产率。当前证据不足以可靠补写完整底物边界、各产物选择性及作者全部机理验证。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03918.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured substrate scope and the full mechanistic data set are not reconstructed. The study develops an intermolecular visible-light energy-transfer [2+2] cycloaddition of oxime ethers with indole derivatives, using indole dearomatization to rapidly build polycyclic products containing both indoline and azetidine units in fused or bridged architectures. The reaction design is based on energy-transfer generation of triplet-state indoles and extends indole/imine-type [2+2] chemistry, previously exemplified mainly by intramolecular systems, to an intermolecular setting where head-to-head/head-to-tail regioselectivity and substrate homodimerization must be controlled. The captured optimization table shows strong photocatalyst and solvent effects on yield and regioisomer ratio, with selected conditions reaching roughly 90% yield. The available evidence is insufficient to reconstruct the complete substrate boundaries, product-by-product selectivity, or all mechanistic validation experiments.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03895.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究开发了单原子镍催化剂 Ni-N-C-700，用于 quinoline N-oxide 与 dioxazolone 的直接 C–H amidation，可制备一系列 2-acetamidoquinoline N-oxide。作者还从商业 quinoline 出发设计了两条 one-pot 路线，可分别导向 2-acetamidoquinoline N-oxide 和药物化学常见的 2-aminoquinoline 骨架。摘要显示，该单原子 Ni 催化剂具有良好稳定性、可回收性与操作简便性；EXAFS 支持明确的 Ni–N4 配位环境，hot-filtration 实验支持催化体系的异相性质。该工作展示了单原子异相 Ni 催化用于杂芳烃 C–H 功能化的可行性。由于当前证据仅为 Abstract，本摘要不补写未捕获的具体反应条件、逐项底物收率或更细机理步骤。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03895.en: Abstract-based: the study develops a single-atom nickel catalyst, Ni-N-C-700, for direct C–H amidation of quinoline N-oxides with dioxazolones, providing a range of 2-acetamidoquinoline N-oxides. Two one-pot routes starting from commercially available quinoline are also designed to access either 2-acetamidoquinoline N-oxides or pharmaceutically relevant 2-aminoquinoline scaffolds. The abstract reports good catalyst stability, recyclability, and operational simplicity; EXAFS supports a defined Ni–N4 coordination environment, while a hot-filtration experiment supports the heterogeneous nature of the system. The work illustrates the use of single-atom heterogeneous nickel catalysis for heteroarene C–H functionalization. Because the current evidence is Abstract-only, this summary does not reconstruct uncaptured reaction conditions, product-by-product yields, or detailed mechanistic steps.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03866.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的具体条件矩阵与逐项同位素数据不作补写。该研究以 aryl thianthrenium salt 为通用电芳基前体，建立结构多样的碳同位素标记 carbonylation。核心设计是使用接近化学计量的、预先在体系外生成的 CO，并配合简单、空气稳定的 Pd 催化剂，从同一类 thianthrenium electrophile 快速进入不同 carbonyl-containing 标记产物。作者采用 Design of Experiments（DoE）而不是单因素逐项筛选来加速条件优化，同时从多参数响应中获得机理信息。捕获的摘要表明该方法适用于电子性质不同的 electrophile，并已用于若干药物分子的合成和 late-stage isotope labeling。该策略的意义在于降低碳同位素 CO 的用量并把 thianthrenation 与后续羰基化标记连接成模块化流程。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03866.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured condition matrices and product-level isotope data are not reconstructed. The study uses aryl thianthrenium salts as versatile electrophilic precursors for structurally diverse carbon-isotope-labeling carbonylations. The central design employs near-stoichiometric, ex situ-generated carbon monoxide together with simple, air-stable palladium catalysts, allowing a common class of thianthrenium electrophiles to be diverted into multiple carbonyl-containing labeled products. Design of Experiments (DoE), rather than one-factor-at-a-time screening, is used to accelerate optimization and extract mechanistic information from the multivariable response. The captured abstract reports tolerance of electronically diverse electrophiles and applications to synthesis and late-stage isotope labeling of several pharmaceutical molecules. The approach is notable for reducing the amount of isotopic CO required while linking arene thianthrenation and carbonylative labeling in a modular workflow.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03398.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的完整底物表和机理细节不作补写。该研究发展 phenolic OH 导向的 Pd 催化不对称 C(sp2)–H arylation，直接构建 P-stereogenic 手性中心，最高收率 90%、最高 98% ee，并报道约 30 个 P-chiral 产物。反应设计依赖双重协同配位：底物上的 phenolic hydroxyl 作为 directing element，而 (S)-6-oxopiperidine-2-carboxylic acid 同时充当手性配体，两者与 Pd 中心共同组织 C–H 活化与芳基化过程。产物绝对构型由 X-ray diffraction 确认。作者结合控制实验与 DFT 提出催化循环，用以解释 OH 导向和手性诱导的协同作用。该方法提供了从 C–H 键直接建立 P 中心手性的另一种路径。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03398.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so the complete substrate table and detailed mechanistic sequence are not reconstructed. The study develops a phenolic-OH-directed Pd-catalyzed asymmetric C(sp2)–H arylation that directly creates P-stereogenic centers, reaching up to 90% yield and 98% ee across about 30 reported P-chiral products. The reaction relies on synergistic coordination: the substrate phenolic hydroxyl acts as a directing element, while (S)-6-oxopiperidine-2-carboxylic acid functions as the chiral ligand, with both components organizing the palladium center for C–H activation and arylation. Product absolute configurations are established by X-ray diffraction. Control experiments and DFT calculations support the authors’ proposed catalytic cycle and the cooperative roles of OH direction and chiral induction. The method provides a direct C–H-functionalization route to phosphorus-centered chirality.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c02094.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的逐步收率和完整保护基操作不作补写。该研究完成 (−)-neoxaline 的对映选择性 formal synthesis，围绕 oxaline alkaloid 中具有挑战性的 1,1-dimethylallyl（reverse-prenyl）苄位结构设计汇聚路线。作者首先探索不对称 deaminative cross-coupling，把 reverse-prenyl 单元安装到 oxindole 骨架；随后转向 Ir 催化的 asymmetric reverse prenylation，在 tryptamine 型底物上建立关键手性并进一步构建高度官能化 α-carboline framework。该路线最终与已知 neoxaline 合成中间体衔接，因此构成 formal synthesis。作者将这种 Ir-catalyzed reverse-prenylation/α-carboline 构建视为可能拓展至其他 oxaline alkaloid 的通用策略。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c02094.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured stepwise yields and full protecting-group operations are not reconstructed. The study completes an enantioselective formal synthesis of (−)-neoxaline, organized around installation of the challenging benzylic 1,1-dimethylallyl, or reverse-prenyl, motif characteristic of oxaline alkaloids. An initial strategy explores asymmetric deaminative cross-coupling to introduce the reverse-prenyl group on an oxindole framework. Subsequent routes turn to Ir-catalyzed asymmetric reverse prenylation of tryptamine-type substrates, establishing the key stereochemistry and enabling construction of a densely functionalized α-carboline framework. The sequence converges with a known intermediate en route to neoxaline and therefore constitutes a formal synthesis. The authors present the Ir-catalyzed reverse-prenylation/α-carboline strategy as a potentially general entry to related oxaline alkaloids.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01998.zh: 该研究发展 peroxide 介导的 germyl radical cascade，使 N-propargyl aromatic amine 与 germane 一步经历 germylation、环化和芳构化，构建 3-germyl-substituted quinoline，并同时形成 C–Ge 与 C–C 键。模型反应中，dilauroyl peroxide（LPO）明显优于 DTBP、TBHP 和 BPO；优化条件使用 LPO 2.0 equiv、THF、60 °C、N2、12 h，目标产物可达 82% NMR 收率，而空气中仅有痕量产物，符合自由基被 O2 截获的特征。底物可容忍 alkoxy、thioether、halogen、ester 等官能团，并对复杂芳环表现较高区域选择性。机理实验支持 germyl radical 参与的级联过程，并指出 Ge–H 键断裂是速率决定步骤。该方法为在 quinoline 药效骨架上直接引入有机锗单元提供了简洁路线。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01998.en: The study develops a peroxide-mediated germyl-radical cascade in which N-propargyl aromatic amines and germanes undergo germylation, cyclization, and aromatization in one operation to furnish 3-germyl-substituted quinolines while forming C–Ge and C–C bonds. In the model reaction, dilauroyl peroxide (LPO) substantially outperforms DTBP, TBHP, and BPO; optimized conditions use 2.0 equiv LPO in THF at 60 °C under N2 for 12 h, giving the target product in 82% NMR yield, whereas only trace product is obtained in air, consistent with interception of radical intermediates by O2. Alkoxy, thioether, halogen, ester, and other functionality is tolerated, and complex aromatic substrates can react with high regioselectivity. Mechanistic studies support a germyl-radical cascade and identify Ge–H bond cleavage as the rate-determining step. The method provides a concise route for installing organogermanium functionality on quinoline pharmacophore frameworks.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01873.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的详细条件、底物逐项数据和完整机理实验不作补写。该研究报道 Rh(III) 催化 indoline 与 nitroalkene 的直接 C7 alkylation，在环境空气下区域选择性构建 7-(2-nitroalkyl)indoline。其核心价值是借助可拆卸 directing group 把通常较难直接区分的 indoline C7 位转化为可选择性 C–H 官能化位点，同时保持良好的 chemo- 与 regioselectivity。导向基可在后续步骤中移除，所得 indoline 还可进一步氧化成相应 7-(2-nitroalkyl)indole，从而把该反应接入更常见的 indole 骨架合成。作者根据控制实验提出了合理的 Rh(III)-mediated C–H activation/alkylation 机理。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01873.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured detailed conditions, product-level scope data, and the complete mechanistic experiments are not reconstructed. The study reports Rh(III)-catalyzed direct C7 alkylation of indolines with nitroalkenes under an ambient atmosphere, regioselectively furnishing 7-(2-nitroalkyl)indolines. The key synthetic feature is use of a removable directing group to turn the otherwise difficult-to-differentiate C7 position of indoline into a selectively functionalized C–H site while maintaining strong chemo- and regioselectivity. The directing group can subsequently be removed, and the resulting indolines can be oxidized to the corresponding 7-(2-nitroalkyl)indoles, connecting the method to more conventional indole scaffolds. On the basis of control experiments, the authors propose a plausible Rh(III)-mediated C–H activation/alkylation pathway.
