10.1021/acs.joc.6c01677.zh: 该研究把 BCB strain-release chemistry 拓展到通常反应性较低、位阻较大的 ketone：La(OTf)3 催化 bicyclo[1.1.0]butane 与 N-substituted isatin 反应，高非对映选择性生成 3-(cyclobuten-3-yl)-3-hydroxyindolin-2-one，最高收率 97%、dr >20:1。模型体系中 10 mol% La(OTf)3、DCM、约 1.1:1 BCB/isatin 可给约 81% 收率和 >20:1 dr；无 Lewis acid 不反应，THF 因强配位 La 而显著抑制反应。控制实验和 DFT 支持 Baylis–Hillman-type ring-opening activation：isatin 的 amide carbonyl 一方面通过邻位效应增强 C3 ketone 的亲电性，另一方面稳定关键 cationic intermediate；两个消除路径的能差以及主要非对映体结晶共同造成高 dr。部分产物会从 DCM 中自发析出，可直接过滤分离，有利于放大。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01677.en: The study extends BCB strain-release chemistry to relatively unreactive and sterically hindered ketones: La(OTf)3 catalyzes reactions of bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes with N-substituted isatins to give 3-(cyclobuten-3-yl)-3-hydroxyindolin-2-ones in up to 97% yield and >20:1 dr. In the model system, 10 mol% La(OTf)3 in DCM with an approximately 1.1:1 BCB/isatin ratio gives about 81% yield and >20:1 dr; no reaction occurs without a Lewis acid, while THF strongly suppresses reactivity through coordination to lanthanum. Control experiments and DFT support a Baylis–Hillman-type ring-opening activation. The isatin amide carbonyl both increases the electrophilicity of the adjacent C3 ketone and stabilizes key cationic intermediates; an energy difference between competing elimination pathways, together with crystallization of the major diastereomer, contributes to the high dr. Several products precipitate directly from DCM and can be isolated by filtration, improving scalability.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01153.zh: 该研究发展 Co 催化 benzylic C(sp3)–H 直接 azidation，以 C–H 底物作为限量试剂制备 benzylic azide。模型优化条件使用 CoCO3 7.5 mol%、商业 N,N-bidentate ligand L6 11 mol%、氧化剂 O4 1.5 equiv、MeCN、40 °C、Ar、2 d，分离收率 68%；Co 源、L6 和氧化剂均不可缺少，THF/EtOAc 等溶剂明显不利。体系兼容芳基/萘基电子效应变化、卤素、杂芳环、ester 以及多类 diarylmethane 和药物相关复杂分子，也能处理部分三级苄位 C–H。机理研究支持先发生 benzylic HAT 生成 benzyl radical，再进入 azide 构建过程；氧化剂电子性质对 HAT/单电子过程有显著影响。该方法以相对温和的 Co/N,N-ligand 体系直接把常见苄位 C–H 转化为可进一步 click 或还原衍生的 C–N3 键。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01153.en: The study develops cobalt-catalyzed direct azidation of benzylic C(sp3)–H bonds, using the C–H substrate as the limiting reagent to prepare benzylic azides. Optimized model conditions employ 7.5 mol% CoCO3, 11 mol% of a commercially available N,N-bidentate ligand L6, 1.5 equiv oxidant O4, MeCN, 40 °C, argon, and 2 days, giving 68% isolated yield. The cobalt source, L6, and oxidant are all required, and solvents such as THF or EtOAc strongly reduce reactivity. The scope includes electronically varied aryl/naphthyl substrates, halides, heteroarenes, esters, diarylmethanes, drug-relevant complex molecules, and selected tertiary benzylic C–H bonds. Mechanistic studies support initial benzylic HAT to generate a benzyl radical before azide formation, with oxidant electronics strongly influencing the HAT/single-electron process. The method directly converts common benzylic C–H bonds into versatile C–N3 functionality under a cobalt/N,N-ligand platform.

10.1021/jacs.6c17816.zh: 该研究把 asymmetric transfer hydrogenation（ATH）用于无环外消旋 1,4-diketone，并通过 double dynamic kinetic resolution（double DKR）把同一类多羰基底物选择性转化为四类手性环状产物：dihydrofuran、γ-lactone、tetrahydrofuranol 和 tetrahydrofuran。产物分流可通过底物 electron-withdrawing group 与催化/酸碱条件调节。一个代表性 dihydrofuran 路线以 1 mol% 手性 ATH catalyst B、DCE、HCO2H/DABCO、室温约 4 h 完成；经后续脱水可得到 86% 收率、8:1 dr、99% ee 的产物。机理实验与 DFT 表明，最终成环产物的构型在最初 ATH 步骤中即被决定，而 EWG 对后续成环方式和产品分布具有关键作用。作者进一步将该策略用于 megacerotonic acid、salvianolic acid V、prunellanate B、calyxolane A 及 magnosalicin-type neolignane 等生物活性分子的合成。
10.1021/jacs.6c17816.en: The study applies asymmetric transfer hydrogenation (ATH) to acyclic racemic 1,4-diketones and uses a double dynamic kinetic resolution (double DKR) to convert a common class of polycarbonyl substrates selectively into four types of chiral cyclic products: dihydrofurans, γ-lactones, tetrahydrofuranols, and tetrahydrofurans. Product divergence is controlled by substrate electron-withdrawing groups and by the catalytic/acid–base conditions. A representative dihydrofuran sequence uses 1 mol% chiral ATH catalyst B in DCE with HCO2H/DABCO at room temperature for about 4 h; after dehydration, the product is isolated in 86% yield, 8:1 dr, and 99% ee. Mechanistic experiments and DFT indicate that the stereochemical configuration of the final annulation products is set in the initial ATH event, while the electron-withdrawing group plays a key role in controlling subsequent cyclization and product distribution. The strategy is further applied to syntheses of megacerotonic acid, salvianolic acid V, prunellanate B, calyxolane A, and a magnosalicin-type neolignane.

10.1021/jacs.6c14230.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的逐步条件与全部中间体数据不作补写。该研究首次完成复杂核苷抗生素 ezomycin A1 和 A2 的全合成，采用统一的汇聚、模块化策略，最长线性步骤分别为 22 和 20 步。关键 trans-fused furanopyran C8 monosaccharide 骨架通过 stereoselective Ni-catalyzed reductive cross-coupling 与后续分子内成环建立；ezoaminuronic acid 片段则经 de novo asymmetric carbohydrate synthesis 制备，其中包含 diastereoselective Henry reaction。高度拥挤的核苷连接使用温和的 (p-Tol)2SO/Tf2O-promoted N-glycosylation 安装 cytosine，并通过 C6′/C2′ 羟基正交保护实现后续位点选择性 O-glycosylation。晚期氧化、urea 构建、全脱保护和 cystathionine 侧链安装最终分别给出 A1/A2。该路线为 ezomycin 家族提供了统一合成平台。
10.1021/jacs.6c14230.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured stepwise conditions and complete intermediate data are not reconstructed. The study reports the first total syntheses of the complex nucleoside antibiotics ezomycin A1 and A2 through a unified convergent and modular strategy, with longest linear sequences of 22 and 20 steps, respectively. The key trans-fused furanopyran C8 monosaccharide framework is assembled through a stereoselective Ni-catalyzed reductive cross-coupling followed by intramolecular cyclization. The ezoaminuronic acid fragment is prepared by de novo asymmetric carbohydrate synthesis featuring a diastereoselective Henry reaction. A mild (p-Tol)2SO/Tf2O-promoted N-glycosylation installs cytosine from a highly strained thioglycoside donor, while orthogonal protection of the C6′/C2′ hydroxyl groups enables subsequent site-selective O-glycosylation. Late-stage oxidation, urea formation, global deprotection, and cystathionine-side-chain incorporation complete A1 and A2, establishing a unified synthetic platform for the ezomycin family.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03473.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作建立了 Pd/NBE 催化的游离 NH 咔唑 C1–H 直接胺化，以环状胺为氮源，可兼容酰基、新戊酰基和卤素等取代基，为难以获得的 C1-胺化咔唑提供更直接的合成入口。当前证据不足以完整核对全部条件、底物范围与机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03473.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports a Pd/NBE-catalyzed direct C1–H amination of free-NH carbazoles with cyclic amines, with tolerance of acyl, pivaloyl, and halogen substituents. The method provides a more direct entry to otherwise challenging C1-aminated carbazole scaffolds; the available evidence does not fully cover all conditions, scope details, or mechanistic studies.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03459.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该研究利用芳基(TMP)碘鎓盐的“类金属”反应性实现叔丙二酸酯芳基化，从而构建苄位季碳中心；DoE 用于筛得温和条件，并覆盖包括富电子芳基在内的多类芳基亲电体。作者还将碘鎓盐制备与 C–C 偶联串联为一锅过程，展示了从芳基碘化物出发的模块化潜力。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03459.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence describes arylation of tertiary malonates with aryl(TMP)iodonium salts to construct benzylic quaternary centers. Design of experiments was used to identify mild conditions with a broad aryl-electrophile scope, including electron-rich aryl groups, and the iodonium-salt formation/C–C coupling sequence was telescoped into a one-pot process from aryl iodides.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03434.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作开发了钴催化串联腈水合/炔烃区域选择性氢芳基化，以 2-氰基取代芳基硼酸和 1-芳基-2-三甲基硅基乙炔为底物，合成 2-烯基一级苯甲酰胺。摘要明确强调该反应具有优良的化学选择性、区域选择性和立体选择性；未捕获到足够正文证据以补充具体条件、产率分布或机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03434.en: Abstract-based: A cobalt-catalyzed tandem nitrile hydration/regioselective alkyne hydroarylation uses 2-cyano-substituted arylboronic acids and 1-aryl-2-trimethylsilylacetylenes to access 2-alkenyl primary benzamides. The abstract emphasizes high chemo-, regio-, and stereoselectivity; the captured evidence does not support reconstruction of detailed conditions, yield distributions, or mechanism beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03394.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以芳基三氯甲烷、烯烃和亚硝酸叔丁酯为三组分原料，在可见光下区域选择性合成异噁唑啉/异噁唑。控制实验支持 PhCHCl2 为可能中间体，作者提出体系原位生成腈氧化物 1,3-偶极体后发生区域选择性 [3+2] 环加成；摘要还指出反应无需预制偶极前体或过渡金属催化剂，并具有较好的官能团兼容性。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03394.en: Abstract-based: A visible-light three-component reaction of aryl trichloromethanes, alkenes, and tert-butyl nitrite provides regioselective access to isoxazoline/isoxazole scaffolds without a preformed 1,3-dipole or transition-metal catalyst. Control experiments support PhCHCl2 as a plausible intermediate, and the authors propose in situ nitrile-oxide formation followed by regioselective [3+2] cycloaddition.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03313.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作发展了铜催化不对称 Michael 加成，使 α-氟代氮杂芳基乙酸酯与 β-氟烷基烯酮偶联，构建相邻 F/CF3、F/CHF2 或 F/CH2F 立体中心，最高达到 >20:1 dr 和 98% ee。放大实验和后续转化支持其实用性，机理实验与 DFT 用于解释催化循环和对映选择性来源；当前证据不足以完整核对所有底物与条件。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03313.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports a copper-catalyzed asymmetric Michael addition of α-fluoro aza-heteroaryl acetates to β-fluoroalkyl enones, furnishing vicinal F/CF3, F/CHF2, or F/CH2F stereocenters with up to >20:1 dr and 98% ee. Scale-up and downstream transformations demonstrate utility, while mechanistic experiments and DFT are used to rationalize the catalytic cycle and enantioselectivity; full scope and condition details are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03239.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作报道铁催化还原性脱氟交叉偶联，将三氟甲基烯烃与带 1,3-二氧戊环或 1,3-二氧杂环庚烷取代基的烷基碘化物连接，快速构建同时含环状缩醛和偕二氟烯烃的氟化骨架。摘要将其定位为扩展脱氟偶联反应类型并获得药物化学相关结构的模块化方法；具体条件与机理未由当前 Abstract 证据支持。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03239.en: Abstract-based: An iron-catalyzed reductive defluorinative cross-coupling joins trifluoromethyl alkenes with alkyl iodides bearing 1,3-dioxolane or 1,3-dioxepane units, giving fluorinated scaffolds that combine cyclic acetals with gem-difluoroalkenes. The abstract presents the method as a modular expansion of defluorinative coupling chemistry; detailed conditions and mechanistic claims are not reconstructed beyond the captured abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03228.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该反应以二氟乙酸为 CF2H 自由基来源，在可见光和二乙酸碘苯活化下实现非活化烯烃的区域选择性氯二氟甲基化，随后由 N-氯代丁二酰亚胺捕获形成 C–Cl 键。末端、二取代和三取代烯烃均可参与，所得氯代产物还能进一步进行杂原子取代等衍生化；当前证据未完整覆盖全部条件和底物数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03228.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence describes visible-light regioselective chlorodifluoromethylation of unactivated alkenes using difluoroacetic acid as the CF2H-radical precursor, activation by (diacetoxyiodo)benzene, and trapping with N-chlorosuccinimide. Terminal, di-, and trisubstituted alkenes are represented, and the resulting C–Cl bond supports further derivatization; complete condition and scope data are not available in the captured evidence.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01696.zh: 该研究建立了双功能相转移催化的不对称 aza-Michael 加成平台，可同时适用于链状和环状烯酮，61 个实例中 β-氨基羰基产物最高达 99% 收率和 98% ee。产物可进一步转化为对映富集 1,3-氨基醇，并用于 N14-desacetoxytubulysin H 关键中间体的制备。控制实验、1H NMR 滴定和 DFT 与作者提出的“双重组织”工作模型一致，即催化剂通过协同的底物相互作用实现立体控制。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01696.en: A bifunctional phase-transfer catalytic platform enables enantioselective aza-Michael addition to both linear and cyclic enones across 61 examples, reaching up to 99% yield and 98% ee. The adducts were converted into enantioenriched 1,3-amino alcohols and used toward a key intermediate for N14-desacetoxytubulysin H. Control experiments, 1H NMR titrations, and DFT are consistent with the authors’ working dual-organization picture involving cooperative catalyst–substrate interactions.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01653.zh: 该工作以 CaC2 作为固体乙炔源，通过 K2S 介导的二硒化物串联硒化/环化一步合成 2-甲基苯并硒唑。优化条件中 K2S、CaC2、NMP、120 °C 和 12 h 构成关键组合；底物对多种间位/对位给电子或吸电子取代基具有兼容性，并完成克级验证。HRMS、1H NMR 和控制实验支持作者提出的 Se–S 动态交换生成硒负离子、继而形成乙烯基硒化物并由 S3•− 参与促进环化的路径。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01653.en: This study uses CaC2 as a solid acetylene source in a K2S-mediated tandem selenylation/cyclization of diselenides to synthesize 2-methylbenzoselenazoles in one step. The optimized system relies on K2S and CaC2 in NMP at 120 °C for 12 h; meta- and para-substituted substrates with either electron-donating or electron-withdrawing groups are tolerated, and gram-scale synthesis was demonstrated. HRMS, 1H NMR, and control experiments support the authors’ proposed Se–S dynamic-exchange pathway leading to selenium anions, vinyl selenides, and S3•−-assisted cyclization.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01559.zh: 该研究通过一锅多组分反应构建带非对称脲侧链的 pyrimido[6,1,2-cd]pyrrolizine 荧光团。三乙胺/乙腈体系可高效形成核心骨架，顺序式多组分过程进一步引入多类脂肪胺和部分芳胺；产物在溶液中呈橙红荧光，固态发射可明显红移。单晶、DFT/TD-DFT 与静电势分析用于解释结构和光物理性质，Candida albicans 成像实验显示细胞摄取和胞内定位，同时观察到可测的抗真菌活性。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01559.en: A one-pot multicomponent strategy constructs pyrimido[6,1,2-cd]pyrrolizine fluorophores bearing unsymmetrical urea side chains. A triethylamine/acetonitrile system forms the core scaffold, and a sequential multicomponent sequence accommodates diverse aliphatic amines and selected arylamines. The products show orange-red fluorescence in solution and pronounced solid-state red shifts; single-crystal analysis, DFT/TD-DFT, and electrostatic-potential calculations probe their photophysics, while Candida albicans studies demonstrate cellular uptake, intracellular localization, and measurable antifungal activity.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03733.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用膦氧配位的 Ni–Al 双金属催化体系，使 N-烷基苯并咪唑与炔烃发生串联 C(sp2)–H/C(sp3)–H 环化，直接构建四氢吡啶并苯并咪唑骨架。摘要报道多种产物可由易得原料获得，收率为 40–98%，核心意义在于突破脂肪 C(sp3)–H 反应性较低对该类稠环构建的限制；当前仅基于 Abstract，不补充具体催化条件或机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03733.en: Abstract-based: A phosphine-oxide-ligated Ni–Al bimetallic catalyst enables tandem C(sp2)–H/C(sp3)–H annulation of N-alkyl benzimidazoles with alkynes to furnish tetrahydropyridobenzimidazoles in reported yields of 40–98%. The transformation addresses the low reactivity of aliphatic C(sp3)–H bonds in this fused-ring construction; specific catalytic conditions and mechanistic details are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03732.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作设计了可台式储存且可放大的三氟烯丙基硫鎓盐，并在铜催化下与多类有机锌试剂反应，高效获得带末端烯烃的烯丙基三氟甲基化产物，具有高区域选择性。产物后续转化进一步证明了该类新型三氟烯丙基化试剂的合成可用性；当前证据未完整覆盖全部条件和范围。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03732.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports bench-stable, scalable trifluoroallyl sulfonium salts that react with a range of organozinc reagents under copper catalysis to give allylic trifluoromethyl products bearing terminal alkenes with high regioselectivity. Subsequent product transformations demonstrate synthetic utility, while full condition and scope details are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03574.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作提出无需外加光催化剂的可见光串联策略，将双环[1.1.0]丁烷的张力释放与芳烃远程去芳构化/螺环化耦合。亚硝胺被用作可安装磺酰胺和肟功能团的试剂，从而生成具有三维螺环结构的复杂分子。当前仅有 Abstract 证据，因此不补充具体光照参数、底物产率或详细机理。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03574.en: Abstract-based: A photocatalyst-free visible-light strategy couples bicyclo[1.1.0]butane strain release with remote arene dearomatization and spirocyclization. Nitrosamines serve as reagents for installing sulfonamide and oxime functionality, generating structurally complex three-dimensional spirocycles. Only abstract-level evidence is available, so detailed irradiation parameters, substrate yields, and mechanistic steps are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03301.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作以易得二芳基二硫化物作为“掩蔽芳基化试剂”，实现 Pd 催化简单芳烃位点选择性 C–H 芳基化，并将适用范围扩展到富电子和缺电子芳烃。作者将多取代芳烃的位点选择性与类亲电芳香取代（SEAr）机理联系起来；当前证据不足以完整核对所有条件、底物和控制实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03301.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence uses readily available diaryl disulfides as masked arylating reagents for Pd-catalyzed site-selective C–H arylation of simple arenes, including both electron-rich and electron-deficient substrates. The authors relate the site selectivity of multisubstituted arenes to an electrophilic-aromatic-substitution-like pathway; full conditions, scope, and control experiments are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03166.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展铁催化、迭代且立体专一的糖烯环氧化物糖基化，用于收敛式构建聚葡萄糖醛酸。该方法能够组装多种 GlcA-β-1,4-GlcA 键，并以高立体选择性获得 PGA 八糖，针对葡萄糖醛酸供体难活化这一长期问题提供了催化方案。当前仅基于 Abstract，不补充具体催化剂用量、步骤收率或更细的机理解释。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03166.en: Abstract-based: Iron-catalyzed iterative, stereospecific glycosylation with glycal epoxides provides a convergent route to polyglucuronic acids. The method assembles GlcA-β-1,4-GlcA linkages in complex glycans and gives PGA octasaccharides with high stereoselectivity, addressing the difficult activation of glucuronic-acid donors. Catalyst loading, stepwise yields, and detailed mechanism are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01866.zh: 该工作实现了 4-(N-烷基-N-丙烯酰胺基)香豆素与芳基磺酰氯的可见光串联磺酰化/环化，在室温且无需外加光敏剂、碱或氧化剂的条件下合成芳基磺酰化 4,5-稠合多环香豆素。反应具有较广底物范围，并通过克级反应和自然光照验证实用性。机理实验支持自由基级联：底物受光激发后向芳基磺酰氯发生能量转移，诱导 S–Cl 均裂，随后发生自由基加成和分子内环化。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01866.en: A visible-light cascade sulfonylation/cyclization of 4-(N-alkyl-N-acrylamido)coumarins with arylsulfonyl chlorides furnishes arylsulfonylated 4,5-fused polycyclic coumarins at room temperature without an external photosensitizer, base, or oxidant. The reaction shows broad scope and was demonstrated on gram scale and under natural sunlight. Mechanistic studies support a radical cascade initiated by energy transfer from photoexcited coumarin substrate to the sulfonyl chloride, followed by S–Cl homolysis and intramolecular cyclization.

10.1021/jacs.6c12532.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该研究以 Ni/光氧化还原双催化实现“中断式”均裂取代（int-SH2），将烯丙胺反应性重定向为三分子交叉偶联，并通过电子与空间效应驱动的自由基分选实现氨基迁移和选择性成键。方法展示了广泛官能团兼容性和较高化学/区域选择性，报道超过 60 个结构多样的烷基胺产物，并用于药物相关骨架的模块化构建。
10.1021/jacs.6c12532.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence introduces interrupted homolytic substitution (int-SH2) under nickel/photoredox dual catalysis to redirect allylamines into modular three-component cross-coupling. Electronic and steric radical sorting orchestrates amino migration and selective bond formation, giving broad functional-group tolerance and high chemo- and regioselectivity across more than 60 alkylamine products, with applications to pharmaceutically relevant scaffolds.

10.31635/ccschem.026.202608315.zh: 该工作完成了 (+)-和 (−)-minfiensine 的对映分歧全合成，并比较两种对映体在乳腺癌细胞模型中的活性。合成以酶促拆分获得对映富集起始物，并通过区域选择性的 interrupted Fischer 吲哚化构建关键稠合三环骨架。细胞活力、迁移和血管生成相关实验显示两种对映体均有明显活性；细胞与计算分析提示其可能增强微管再生并提高对去聚合的抵抗，这一部分属于作者基于实验与计算提出的作用解释。
10.31635/ccschem.026.202608315.en: The study completes enantiodivergent total syntheses of (+)- and (−)-minfiensine and compares their activity in breast-cancer cell models. Enzymatic resolution provides enantioenriched starting materials, and a regioselective interrupted Fischer indolization builds the key fused tricyclic framework. Cell-viability, motility, and angiogenesis assays show pronounced activity for both enantiomers; complementary cellular and computational analyses suggest enhanced microtubule regrowth and resistance to depolymerization, which is an interpretation proposed by the authors.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05820.zh: 该研究通过膦/AgF 协同催化，使 α-取代联烯酸酯与烯酮发生乙炔基化加成，在原本通常不参与成键的联烯酸酯 α-碳上构建全碳季碳中心。作者提出关键中间体为银烯醇盐–乙烯基氟膦烷物种，其中 Ag(I) 作为 Lewis 酸促进对烯酮的 α-加成，P(V) 部分随后参与 E1cb 型消除。利用 Ag(I) 对手性双齿配体的配位能力，体系还实现了高对映选择性的不对称版本。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05820.en: Phosphine/AgF cocatalysis enables ethynylative addition of α-substituted allenoates to enones, forming an all-carbon quaternary center at the normally unreactive allenoate α-carbon. The authors propose a silver-enolate/vinyl-fluorophosphorane intermediate in which Ag(I) acts as a Lewis acid to promote α-addition and the P(V) unit participates in an E1cb-type elimination. Coordination of Ag(I) to chiral bidentate ligands also enables a highly enantioselective asymmetric variant.

10.1021/acscatal.6c04954.zh: 该工作以手性 Cp-Rh 催化剂和改造的手性氨基酸协同实现 6-羟基异喹啉衍生物与内炔的不对称 C–H 官能化/环化，合成一系列 azahelicene，最高收率 93%、最高 99% ee。控制实验与 DFT 支持作者提出的催化循环，其中高价 Rh 中间体的还原消除是关键步骤之一。该策略为含氮螺旋芳烃提供了直接的对映选择性构建方法。
10.1021/acscatal.6c04954.en: A chiral Cp-Rh catalyst combined with a modified chiral amino acid enables asymmetric C–H functionalization/annulation of 6-hydroxyisoquinoline derivatives with internal alkynes, furnishing azahelicenes in up to 93% yield and 99% ee. Control experiments and DFT support the authors’ proposed catalytic cycle, which includes reductive elimination from a high-valent Rh intermediate. The method offers a direct enantioselective route to nitrogen-containing helicenes.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03854.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作首次完成二聚 Cephalotaxus 生物碱 (−)-cephalancetine C 的全合成，采用收敛的双片段策略，关键成键包括 aldol 反应和立体专一的 5-exo-trig aza-Michael 加成。作者同时记录了一条失败的仿生路线：对中间体进行 Polonovski 型反应时意外得到共轭环状烯胺，这一结果促使路线重新设计。当前证据未完整覆盖全部步骤与单步数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03854.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports the first total synthesis of the dimeric Cephalotaxus alkaloid (−)-cephalancetine C through a convergent two-segment strategy, with an aldol reaction and a stereospecific 5-exo-trig aza-Michael addition as key bond-forming events. An attempted biomimetic Polonovski-type route instead produced a conjugated cyclic enamine, prompting route redesign. The available evidence does not fully cover every step or stepwise performance.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03851.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该研究首次全合成金黄色葡萄球菌 CP8 的两性离子三糖重复单元，总收率为 2.8%。目标结构包含三个具有挑战性的 1,2-cis 糖苷键以及一处胺和两处乙酰胺；作者利用噁唑烷酮保护的 L-fucosamine 实现 α-选择性糖基化，并与叠氮基保持正交，从而结合直接 β-甘露糖基化完成三糖组装。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03851.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports the first total synthesis of the zwitterionic trisaccharide repeating unit of Staphylococcus aureus CP8 in 2.8% overall yield. The target contains three challenging 1,2-cis glycosidic linkages and orthogonal nitrogen functionality. Oxazolidinone-protected L-fucosamine enables α-selective glycosylation while remaining orthogonal to the azide functionality, supporting assembly together with direct β-mannosylation.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03520.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作以 Au(I) 催化邻炔基苯胺与亚硝酸叔丁酯反应，通过区域选择性 C≡C 键断裂制备 2-氨基苯甲腈。摘要所述机理研究支持三步序列：Au(I) 催化 5-endo-dig 环化生成吲哚、TBN 介导吲哚亚硝化、随后 Au(I) 催化 C–C 键断裂；氨基承担导向作用，TBN 是腈基氮源。当前仅基于 Abstract，不补充更细的条件或底物数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03520.en: Abstract-based: Au(I)-catalyzed regioselective C≡C-bond cleavage of o-alkynyl anilines with tert-butyl nitrite provides 2-aminobenzonitriles. Mechanistic studies summarized in the abstract support a three-step sequence involving Au(I)-catalyzed 5-endo-dig cyclization to an indole, TBN-mediated nitrosation, and Au(I)-catalyzed C–C cleavage; the amino group acts as a directing group and TBN supplies the nitrile nitrogen. Detailed conditions and scope data are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03455.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展 DIH 催化的炔酸酯与腈氧化 [3+2] 环化，合成具有药物化学价值的噁唑。作者结合实验和 DFT 提出：DIH/吡啶 N-氧化物首先把炔酸酯转化为 α-碘代 α,α′-二羰基碳正离子，并可共振表示为由碘孤对电子稳定的 Fischer 型碘卡宾样物种，随后被腈捕获并环化。摘要还支持较广底物范围、可放大性及产物衍生化。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03455.en: Abstract-based: DIH-catalyzed oxidative [3+2] annulation of alkynoates with nitriles affords oxazoles. Experimental evidence and DFT summarized in the abstract support the authors’ proposal that DIH/pyridine N-oxide oxidation first forms an α-iodo-α,α′-dicarbonyl cation with a resonance-stabilized Fischer-type iodocarbenoid description, which is then trapped by a nitrile and cyclized. The abstract also supports broad scope, scalability, and downstream derivatization.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03373.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作通过 Cu(I) 催化 O-炔丙基肟与硫叶立德的 2,3-重排驱动环丙烷化，一锅构建含四个连续立体中心的 spirochromeno[4,3-b][1,3]pyrrole-cyclopropane。产物通常具有较高非对映选择性，机理研究指出 MeCN 对立体结果具有关键控制作用。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物、收率和实验细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03373.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence describes Cu(I)-catalyzed, 2,3-rearrangement-driven cyclopropanation of O-propargylic oximes with sulfur ylides, assembling spirochromeno[4,3-b][1,3]pyrrole-cyclopropanes with four contiguous stereocenters in one pot. High diastereoselectivity is reported, and mechanistic studies identify MeCN as important for stereochemical control. Full substrate, yield, and experimental details are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03346.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作实现 roridin E 的首次催化不对称全合成。相转移催化 β-酮酯烷基化以定量收率、>99% ee 在十克级建立关键立体信息并形成 (−)-verrucarol 前体，随后以 Z-选择性分子内 Horner–Wadsworth–Emmons 宏环化完成 33 步最长线性序列。合成样品在六种癌细胞系中的细胞毒性与天然样品相符。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03346.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports the first catalytic asymmetric total synthesis of roridin E. A phase-transfer-catalyzed β-keto-ester alkylation establishes a stereodefined (−)-verrucarol precursor in quantitative yield and >99% ee on decagram scale, and a Z-selective intramolecular Horner–Wadsworth–Emmons macrocyclization completes a 33-step longest linear sequence. Synthetic roridin E matched the natural isolate in cytotoxicity across six cancer cell lines.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03276.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该研究以 Pd(PtBu3)2 催化 N-炔酰基吲哚或吡咯与芳基溴化物发生串联去芳构化 Heck 反应，得到同时含季碳中心和四取代烯烃的苯并吡咯里嗪酮/吡咯里嗪酮。作者提出反应经历炔烃 syn-芳基钯化、乙烯基 Pd(II) 的 E→Z 异构化以及随后的去芳构化 Heck 环化；产物衍生化显示了合成可用性。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03276.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports a Pd(PtBu3)2-catalyzed tandem dearomative Heck reaction of N-propiolyl indoles or pyrroles with aryl bromides, furnishing benzopyrrolizinone and pyrrolizinone products bearing a quaternary center and a tetrasubstituted alkene. The authors propose alkyne syn-arylpalladation, E-to-Z isomerization of a vinyl-Pd(II) species, and subsequent dearomative Heck cyclization. Product transformations demonstrate synthetic utility.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01498.zh: 该工作利用 Ag(I) 促进 1-isocyano-2-((2-alkoxyphenyl)ethynyl)benzene 的级联环化，以一锅两步方式组装四环稠合的 benzofuro[2,3-b]quinoline 骨架。方法具有较广底物范围和良好至优异收率，并完成克级反应。控制实验与电子结构 DFT 用于提出反应路径；部分产物还通过 UV–vis、荧光光谱和 TD-DFT 研究了光物理性质与前线轨道。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01498.en: Ag(I)-assisted cascade cyclization of 1-isocyano-2-((2-alkoxyphenyl)ethynyl)benzenes provides a one-pot, two-step route to four-ring benzofuro[2,3-b]quinoline scaffolds. The method shows broad scope, good-to-excellent yields, and gram-scale practicality. Control experiments and electronic-structure DFT underpin the proposed pathway, while selected products were examined by UV–vis/fluorescence spectroscopy and TD-DFT for photophysical and frontier-orbital properties.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01347.zh: 该研究发现 FeCl3 可催化由仲苄醇衍生的 N-tosyl carbamate 快速 C–O 键裂解，生成可被外加亲核试剂捕获的苄基碳正离子，从而实现 Friedel–Crafts 烷基化和环化。反应在 25 °C、5 min–5 h 内完成，最高收率达 96%。控制实验表明 N-tosylisocyanate 的引入显著提高苄醇活化效率，为从易得仲苄醇进行快速多样化提供了通用入口。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01347.en: Catalytic FeCl3 promotes rapid C–O cleavage of N-tosyl carbamates derived from secondary benzyl alcohols, generating benzylic carbocations that can be intercepted by external nucleophiles for Friedel–Crafts alkylations and annulations. Reactions proceed at 25 °C over 5 min to 5 h and reach up to 96% yield. Control experiments show that incorporation of N-tosylisocyanate substantially enhances benzylic-alcohol activation.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03443.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作在 apo-myoglobin 蛋白骨架内共价引入非天然水杨醛位点，构建模拟 PLP 的人工催化中心。该人工酶可通过类似 PLP 酶的底物活化方式生成具有亲核性的甘氨酸酯中间体，并促进其 α-位 C–C 成键官能化。该结果展示了把非天然催化基元嵌入蛋白以获得天然酶体系之外反应性的策略；具体底物范围与催化参数未由当前 Abstract 完整支持。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03443.en: Abstract-based: An artificial enzyme is constructed by covalently installing an abiological salicylaldehyde site within an apo-myoglobin scaffold to mimic a PLP-like catalytic center. The engineered catalyst activates glycine esters to form nucleophilic intermediates and enables direct α-functionalization through C–C bond formation. The work illustrates how non-natural catalytic motifs can confer new-to-nature reactivity on proteins; detailed scope and catalytic parameters are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c02955.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作通过 Rh 催化芳香羧酸与 7-oxabenzonorbornadiene 的 [3+2] 级联环化，一步构建平面 π 共轭 benzo[a]fluorenone。作者描述的序列包括羧基导向的 C–H 对烯烃直接加成与脱水，随后发生分子内 Friedel–Crafts 反应；所得骨架具有有序的人字形滑移堆积特征。当前证据未完整覆盖全部条件和底物表现。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c02955.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports Rh-catalyzed [3+2] cascade annulation of aromatic acids with 7-oxabenzonorbornadienes to access planar π-conjugated benzo[a]fluorenones in one step. The authors describe carboxyl-directed C–H addition to the alkene followed by dehydration and an intramolecular Friedel–Crafts reaction; the products display an ordered herringbone packing motif with slipped stacking. Full condition and substrate-performance details are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01939.zh: 该研究实现 enaminone 与酚类的电化学环化，并通过底物与条件调控选择性获得 7-aryloxy benzofuran 或 5-hydroxy benzofuran。带烷氧基或氨基等给电子基的酚倾向经历苯并呋喃成环后芳基 C–H aryloxylation，而 hydroquinone 在调整条件后选择性给出 5-羟基产物。循环伏安实验直接显示 HFIP 可降低酚底物的氧化电位，是体系实现反应性的关键介质效应。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01939.en: Electrochemical annulation of enaminones with phenols is tuned to selectively furnish either 7-aryloxybenzofurans or 5-hydroxybenzofurans. Electron-rich phenols bearing alkoxy or amino groups favor benzofuran annulation followed by aryl C–H aryloxylation, whereas hydroquinone under modified conditions selectively gives 5-hydroxy products. Cyclic-voltammetry experiments directly show that HFIP lowers the oxidation potential of the phenol substrates, establishing a key role for the solvent in enabling the reaction.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01846.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该方法以非活化 methylenecyclopropane 为自由基受体，在可见光、室温且无过渡金属条件下进行张力释放驱动的 1,3-碘磺酰化。该级联过程通过形式上的 C–C 键断裂实现区域和立体选择性双官能化，得到同时含烷基碘和烯基砜单元的产物；当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和机理实验。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01846.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence describes a visible-light, strain-release-enabled 1,3-iodosulfonylation of unactivated methylenecyclopropanes under ambient, transition-metal-free conditions. The radical cascade proceeds through formal C–C bond cleavage to give regio- and stereoselective difunctionalization products containing both an alkyl iodide and an alkenyl sulfone. Full substrate and mechanistic datasets are not completely captured.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06622.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该研究在同二聚体转氨酶中发现跨亚基通道，可把高度不稳定的氨基醛中间体直接在两个 PLP 活性位点之间传递，从而避免其释放到溶液后快速环化或聚合。基于机理的半理性工程得到 S122G/Y324N 变体，提高 DFF 逐步二胺化为 BAMF 的催化效率；停流动力学和分子动力学支持通道由紧锁态转为动态传输态。作者还将该策略用于由可再生 5-HMF 制备 BAMF 的全细胞级联并进行 TEA/LCA 分析。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06622.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence identifies a trans-subunit tunnel in a homodimeric transaminase that directly channels a highly unstable amino-aldehyde intermediate between two PLP active sites, avoiding release into bulk solution where competing cyclization and polymerization are rapid. Mechanism-guided engineering produced the S122G/Y324N variant with improved efficiency for stepwise conversion of DFF to BAMF; stopped-flow kinetics and molecular dynamics support a shift from a locked state to dynamic transport. The strategy was also implemented in a whole-cell cascade from renewable 5-HMF to BAMF with TEA/LCA analysis.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03954.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该工作先对非活化芳烃进行 thianthrenation，再以 Pd 催化其与 enynone 发生无重氮的区域选择性卡宾偶联；enynone 原位生成 furyl carbene，经环异构化、迁移插入和 β-H 消除形成 furyl 取代烯基芳烃。反应具有高位点选择性、较广范围和卤素兼容性，并通过药物/类药分子的后期衍生展示应用潜力。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03954.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence describes prior thianthrenation of unactivated arenes followed by a Pd-catalyzed, diazo-free regioselective carbene coupling with enynones. Furyl carbenes are generated in situ and participate in a cascade involving cycloisomerization, migratory insertion, and β-hydride elimination to form furyl-substituted alkenylarenes. High site selectivity, broad scope, halogen tolerance, and late-stage derivatization of drug-like molecules are reported.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03909.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究把溴三氟甲烷（CF3Br，Halon-1301）作为三氟甲基来源，用于（杂）芳烃的光催化 C–H 三氟甲基化。反应在常温常压、无需外加氧化剂条件下进行，最高收率 89%，并可用于包括核苷在内的生物活性分子。该方法同时提供了对高温室效应和臭氧消耗物质 Halon-1301 的增值利用路径；更详细机理未由当前 Abstract 支持。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03909.en: Abstract-based: Bromotrifluoromethane (CF3Br, Halon-1301) is used as the trifluoromethyl source for photocatalytic C–H trifluoromethylation of (hetero)arenes. The reaction operates at ambient temperature and pressure without an external oxidant, reaches up to 89% yield, and is compatible with bioactive molecules including nucleosides. The method therefore provides a value-added use for Halon-1301; detailed mechanistic claims are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03898.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作发展光氧化还原/钴肟协同催化的吡咯烷直接脱氢芳构化，以 HAT 介导的自由基生成为关键策略获得吡咯。与连续 SET 氧化相比，作者指出 HAT 路径可抑制竞争性氧化，从而扩大底物范围并保持较好化学选择性。可回收 mpg-CN 光催化剂的使用进一步展示了体系的实用性；具体条件和机理证据不在当前 Abstract 覆盖范围内。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03898.en: Abstract-based: A synergistic photoredox/cobaloxime system enables direct dehydrogenative aromatization of pyrrolidines to pyrroles through HAT-mediated radical generation. Compared with sequential SET oxidation, the authors report that the HAT pathway suppresses competing oxidation and broadens substrate compatibility while maintaining high chemoselectivity. Use of a recyclable mpg-CN photocatalyst demonstrates practical potential; detailed conditions and mechanistic evidence are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03876.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究通过铜催化 10-(pyridin-2-yl)-10H-phenothiazine 的级联 C–H 活化/acyloxylation，快速构建 phenothiazine 衍生 BF2 配合物。所得材料同时表现 anti-Kasha 双发射、室温磷光和压致变色三类光学行为，作者称这是首次在有机二氟硼配合物中集成这些功能。当前仅基于 Abstract，不补充具体配体、条件或光物理数值。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03876.en: Abstract-based: Copper-catalyzed cascade C–H activation/acyloxylation of 10-(pyridin-2-yl)-10H-phenothiazines provides phenothiazine-derived BF2 complexes in a streamlined manner. The products combine anti-Kasha dual emission, room-temperature phosphorescence, and piezochromic behavior, which the authors report as a first integration of these three functions in organic difluoroboron complexes. Specific ligand, reaction, and photophysical numerical details are not reconstructed beyond the abstract.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03825.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作首次报道 Fe(Pytacn) 催化的分子内脂肪 C(sp3)–H 胺化，通过金属-氮宾介导的 C–H 插入在室温构建杂芳基官能化 sultam。摘要报道 20 个结构多样产物，最高 90% 收率和 >20:1 dr。机理研究支持自由基路径，并表明 Pytacn 配体和 acac 对体系关键；动力学同位素效应指向 C–H 插入为速率决定步骤。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03825.en: Abstract-based: Fe(Pytacn)-catalyzed intramolecular aliphatic C(sp3)–H amination proceeds through metal-nitrene-mediated C–H insertion to access heteroarene-functionalized sultams at room temperature. The abstract reports 20 products in up to 90% yield and >20:1 dr. Mechanistic studies support a radical pathway, identify the Pytacn ligand and acac counterion as critical, and use a kinetic isotope effect to implicate C–H insertion as rate-determining.

10.1021/jacs.6c17644.zh: 该工作以手性 CpxRh(III) 催化剂将 acrylamide 的烯基 C(sp2)–H 官能化与烯丙基二氟化物的脱氟偶联结合，直接合成对映富集的含氟 skipped 1,4-diene，最高 99% 收率和 99% ee。机理研究支持位点选择性烯基 C–H 活化、对映选择性迁移插入和 β-F 消除的序列。值得注意的是，酯衍生的烯丙基二氟化物会转入不同级联路径，形成手性 2-piperidone，显示该反应网络具有底物控制的分歧性。
10.1021/jacs.6c17644.en: A chiral CpxRh(III) catalyst merges alkenyl C(sp2)–H functionalization of acrylamides with defluorinative coupling of allylic difluorides to give enantioenriched fluorinated skipped 1,4-dienes in up to 99% yield and 99% ee. Mechanistic studies support site-selective C–H activation, enantioselective migratory insertion, and β-fluoride elimination. Ester-derived allylic difluorides instead enter a divergent cascade to form chiral 2-piperidones, revealing substrate-controlled reaction divergence.

10.1021/jacs.6c16907.zh: 该研究通过五轮定向进化改造 P450BM3，实现 sclareol 上此前难以选择性氧化的 C18 一级甲基 C–H 键羟基化。Ox18M3–3 变体把区域选择性从 4% 提升至 >99%，同时催化活性提高 2.2 倍。该位点特异性氧化随后被嵌入天然产物合成，使作者从 sclareol 出发以 10 步最长线性序列首次合成七环 spiromyrrhene B，体现了精确生物催化对重塑全合成路线的价值。
10.1021/jacs.6c16907.en: Five rounds of directed evolution of P450BM3 deliver selective C18 primary-methyl C–H hydroxylation of sclareol, a position that is difficult to access by conventional undirected oxidation. The Ox18M3–3 variant raises regioselectivity from 4% to >99% while increasing catalytic activity 2.2-fold. Incorporating this site-specific oxidation into synthesis enables the first synthesis of heptacyclic spiromyrrhene B from sclareol in a 10-step longest linear sequence.

10.1021/jacs.6c16812.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作设计亚甲基桥联 thianthrenium 二阳离子，把烯烃与亲核试剂通过一个额外的单碳单元双向连接。试剂利用两个 C–S 键不同的氧化还原与张力释放反应性，先发生烯烃 hydroalkylation，再通过取代、交叉偶联或自由基路径引入第二个亲核片段。体系覆盖 N、O、B、S、Se、C 及卤素等多类亲核体，并可连接复杂生物相关片段，从而进入传统烯烃 hydrofunctionalization 难以覆盖的“多一个碳”化学空间。
10.1021/jacs.6c16812.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A methylene-bridged thianthrenium dication acts as a one-carbon linchpin for bidirectional coupling of alkenes and nucleophiles. Distinct redox and strain-release behavior of its two C–S bonds enables sequential alkene hydroalkylation followed by nucleophile incorporation through substitution, cross-coupling, or radical pathways. N, O, B, S, Se, C, and halide nucleophiles are represented, including coupling of complex biorelevant fragments, thereby accessing one-carbon-shifted products beyond conventional alkene hydrofunctionalization.

10.1021/jacs.6c14159.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。已抓取证据显示，该研究首次实现 2-碘苯胺与 vinyldiazo acetate 的 Pd 催化不对称 [3+3] 环加成，其中 Ming-Phos 提供关键活性和对映选择性诱导。两类偶联伙伴均具有一定范围，可制备多种对映富集 dihydroquinoline，收率中等至良好。当前证据未完整覆盖全部催化参数、底物数据和机理实验。
10.1021/jacs.6c14159.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The captured evidence reports the first Pd-catalyzed asymmetric [3+3] annulation of 2-iodoanilines with vinyldiazo acetates, with Ming-Phos providing distinctive activity and enantioinduction. Both coupling-partner classes show useful scope, giving diverse enantioenriched dihydroquinolines in moderate-to-good yields. Full catalyst parameters, substrate data, and mechanistic experiments are not completely captured.

10.1021/jacs.6c09019.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作从共同的 allene 前体出发，以两条互补路线实现 angular triquinane 的非对映发散合成：Lewis 酸促进的分子内 [3+2] Danheiser 环化通向 cis,trans 骨架，而光化学 [2+2] 环加成/氧化扩环通向 cis,cis 骨架；特定 R1 取代还可反转 [3+2] 的非对映选择性。DFT 指出初始螺环化控制 [3+2] 的反应性与立体结果。该策略被用于 (±)-arnicenone 的全合成，并以两条路线展示互补性。
10.1021/jacs.6c09019.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A common allene precursor is directed into two complementary routes to angular triquinanes: Lewis-acid-promoted intramolecular [3+2] Danheiser annulation gives cis,trans frameworks, whereas photochemical [2+2] cycloaddition followed by oxidative ring expansion gives cis,cis frameworks. Certain R1 substitution reverses the [3+2] diastereoselectivity. DFT attributes reactivity and stereochemical outcome to the initial spirocyclization, and the strategy is demonstrated in the total synthesis of (±)-arnicenone through complementary routes.

10.1021/jacs.6c17163.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究用 V3+/V2+ 氧化还原穿梭体把电极反应与酚类加氢在空间上解耦，以绕过高电流密度/高底物浓度下的界面传质限制。PtRu/C 上 Ru 负责促进酚活化、Pt 调节 H* 吸附，二者协同降低反应势垒；稀水相中在 70 °C、−200 mA cm−2 时 cyclohexanol 法拉第效率达 82.6%，双相连续体系可处理有机相中 >11 mol L−1 的酚并稳定运行超过 310 h。该策略还可扩展到其他木质素来源平台分子的加氢。
10.1021/jacs.6c17163.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A V3+/V2+ redox shuttle spatially decouples electrode reactions from phenol hydrogenation to bypass interfacial mass-transfer limitations at high current density and substrate concentration. On PtRu/C, Ru promotes phenol activation while Pt tunes H* adsorption. The captured evidence reports 82.6% cyclohexanol Faradaic efficiency at 70 °C and −200 mA cm−2 in dilute aqueous media, processing of >11 mol L−1 phenol in the organic phase of a biphasic setup, and continuous operation for over 310 h, with extension to other lignin-derived molecules.

10.1021/jacs.6c16766.zh: 该工作建立酪氨酸酶催化的 Tyr–aniline 氧化偶联平台，在温和水相中可对未保护多肽进行位点选择性编辑、偶联和大环化，并兼容噬菌体展示。双官能芳胺可用于 Tyr 定向的分子内/分子间连接，进而对遗传编码多肽库进行在噬菌体上的后翻译大环化。靶向筛选得到针对 Keap1 和 EphA4 的环肽配体，其中 CM1 对 Keap1 的 Kd 为 211 ± 60 nM；丙氨酸扫描和 HSQC 滴定进一步支持其直接且序列依赖的识别。
10.1021/jacs.6c16766.en: Tyrosinase-catalyzed Tyr–aniline oxidative coupling provides a unified platform for site-selective editing, conjugation, and macrocyclization of unprotected peptides under mild aqueous conditions and is compatible with phage display. Bifunctional arylamines enable Tyr-directed intra- and intermolecular linking, allowing on-phage post-translational macrocyclization of genetically encoded libraries. Target-directed selections yielded cyclic ligands for Keap1 and EphA4; CM1 bound Keap1 with a Kd of 211 ± 60 nM, and alanine scanning plus HSQC titration supported direct, sequence-dependent recognition.

10.1021/jacs.6c16346.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作通过光生物催化实现 α-非酰基取代 cyclopentanone 的高位点选择性直接 β-C(sp3)–H 烷基化。经机理导向重用途开发的单一 flavin-dependent ene-reductase 在一个氧化还原级联中先催化去饱和，再促进 Giese 型自由基加成；酶对去饱和位点的控制使烷基选择性安装到邻近 α-取代基的 β 位，并得到高非对映选择性的 trans-α,β-二取代产物。通过酶和光条件协同调节还可实现位点发散。
10.1021/jacs.6c16346.en: Abstract-based: Photobiocatalysis enables highly site-selective direct β-C(sp3)–H alkylation of α-nonacyl-substituted cyclopentanones. A repurposed flavin-dependent ene-reductase orchestrates desaturation and a Giese-type radical addition within one redox cascade. Enzymatic control of the desaturation site directs alkyl installation to the β-position adjacent to the α-substituent and gives trans-α,β-disubstituted cyclopentanones with excellent diastereoselectivity; coordinated tuning of enzyme and light conditions also enables site-divergent alkylation.

10.1021/jacs.6c16323.zh: 该研究用自由基断键逻辑把 α-氨基酸一步转化为差异化的邻二胺。光催化脱羧先生成 α-氨基自由基，再被原位形成、未稳定化的 N-保护 formimine 捕获，相当于直接引入 aminomethyl 单元，从而避开传统酸→氨甲基转化中强还原剂和多步氧化还原操作。反应兼容对氢化物敏感的官能团，并通过连续流放大实现 >400 倍的时空收率提升；产物两端氮功能可进一步选择性分化。
10.1021/jacs.6c16323.en: A radical-disconnection strategy converts α-amino acids directly into differentiated vicinal diamines in one step. Photocatalytic decarboxylation forms α-amino radicals that are trapped by an in situ generated, unstabilized N-protected formimine serving as an aminomethyl equivalent, avoiding harsh hydride reductions and redox-intensive classical sequences. The reaction tolerates hydride-sensitive functionality, and continuous-flow scale-up gives a >400-fold increase in space-time yield; the differentiated nitrogens support selective downstream functionalization.

10.1021/jacs.6c14601.zh: 该工作将 sulfurdiimide 开发为自由基捕获试剂，用于从羧酸出发脱羧合成 sulfinamidine。作者首先制备一组稳定的非对称 sulfurdiimide，并通过改变 N-取代基调节其电子性质以开启自由基捕获；随后采用 acridine/Cu 协同催化，使商业易得羧酸脱羧后向 sulfurdiimide 加成，得到多样 sulfinamidine。该方法可放大并具有较好的官能团耐受性，为 aza-S(IV)/(VI) 结构提供了新的模块化入口。
10.1021/jacs.6c14601.en: Sulfurdiimides are developed as radical traps for decarboxylative synthesis of sulfinamidines from carboxylic acids. A series of stable unsymmetrical sulfurdiimides is electronically tuned through N-substitution to enable radical trapping, and acridine/copper cocatalysis then promotes decarboxylative addition of readily available carboxylic acids. The method is scalable, shows good functional-group tolerance, and provides a modular entry to aza-sulfur(IV/VI) functionality.

10.1021/jacs.6c12613.zh: 该研究重新设计 isocyanoalkyne 的制备方式，克服早期体系需要 240→−196 °C 闪速真空热解-冷凝、收率低于 10% 且易聚合等障碍，实现带芳基、杂环和脂肪取代基 isocyanoalkyne 的稳健可放大合成。结构分析与计算定位其高能反应热点，并据此发展多种可一次形成多根化学键的级联反应。工作重点不是单一反应，而是建立这一此前几乎未被探索的高能含氮炔烃家族的可获得性与基础反应图谱。
10.1021/jacs.6c12613.en: The study establishes a robust, scalable synthesis of substituted isocyanoalkynes bearing aromatic, heterocyclic, and aliphatic substituents, overcoming earlier routes that required 240→−196 °C flash-vacuum pyrolysis/condensation, gave <10% yield, and suffered rapid polymerization. Structural analysis and computation identify reactive hot spots that guide several exploratory multi-bond-forming cascades. The central advance is therefore a practical foundation for accessing and mapping the chemistry of this previously unexplored high-energy nitrogen-substituted alkyne family.

10.1021/jacs.6c16625.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作发展“双硼删除环化”（dBDA），把含两个 B2N3 单元的四重硼化前体重构为含双氮杂五元/七元环对的非交替 B,N-嵌入螺旋分子碳，共报道 12 个实例。硼删除把 cove 边转化为内侧螺旋边并显著提高消旋能垒，同时导致红移发射和 CPL；例如双 [7]helicene 2c 发射可达 730 nm。该策略展示了从平面/扭曲前体后期重塑三维手性 π 骨架并调节手性光学性质的能力。
10.1021/jacs.6c16625.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Double boron-deleting annulation (dBDA) restructures quadruply borylated precursors containing two B2N3 units into nonalternant B,N-embedded helical molecular carbons with diaza pentagon–heptagon pairs, with 12 examples reported. Boron deletion converts cove edges into inner helical rims, markedly raises racemization barriers, and produces red-shifted emission and CPL activity; double [7]helicene 2c reaches 730 nm emission. The strategy enables late-stage conversion of planar or twisted precursors into three-dimensional chiral π-frameworks with tunable chiroptical properties.

10.1021/jacs.6c13570.zh: 该研究通过“中断式氮删除”实现脂肪骨架的 NH→CO、NH→O 和 NH→S 三类原子转变。杂芳基稠合哌啶先形成去芳构化 vinylcyclopropane 中间体，随后分别进入 Rh 催化 [5+1] 羰基化、I2/H2O 促进的极性开环/闭环或光化学自由基环化，生成环己酮、二氢吡喃和 thiane。计算表明，不同杂环的去芳构化能量代价可预测关键 isodiazene 更倾向形成目标 VCP 还是发生再芳构化，从而解释底物适用性。该工作展示了同一骨架编辑中间体可跨越过渡金属、极性和自由基三种反应模式。
10.1021/jacs.6c13570.en: The study uses interrupted nitrogen deletion to achieve three aliphatic skeletal transmutations: NH-to-CO, NH-to-O, and NH-to-S. Heteroaryl-fused piperidines first form dearomatized vinylcyclopropane intermediates, which then undergo Rh-catalyzed [5+1] carbonylation, I2/H2O-enabled polar ring opening/closure, or photochemical radical cyclization to give cyclohexanones, dihydropyrans, and thianes, respectively. Computed dearomatization penalties predict whether the key isodiazene partitions toward the productive VCP or rearomatized deletion product, rationalizing substrate behavior. The work shows that a common skeletal-editing intermediate can be exploited across transition-metal, polar, and radical reaction manifolds.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03726.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 Pd(II) 催化的一步级联反应，由 o-alkynylaryl nitrile 与富电子 arylboronic acid 直接构建 dibenzotropone。作者提出反应依次经历区域选择性 1,2-syn-carbopalladation、1,4-Pd migration、较少见的 o-aryl-Pd cis–trans isomerization 和分子内环化；调节 arylboronic acid 的电子性质有助于推动关键异构化。控制实验和 DFT 用于解释反应机理与区域选择性；当前证据未完整覆盖全部优化条件和底物数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03726.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A Pd(II)-catalyzed one-step cascade converts o-alkynylaryl nitriles and electron-rich arylboronic acids into dibenzotropone scaffolds. The authors propose regioselective 1,2-syn carbopalladation, a 1,4-palladium migration, an unusual cis–trans isomerization of an o-aryl-palladium intermediate, and intramolecular cyclization; electronic tuning of the arylboronic acid helps enable the key isomerization. Control experiments and DFT are used to rationalize the mechanism and regioselectivity. Full optimization and substrate-level data are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03682.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作实现 imine 与 1,3-diacyl gold carbene 的 [3+2] annulation，高效制备 2-acyl-3-aminopyrrole。机理研究支持 imine 先亲核加成到 gold carbene，形成 carbene–imine 中间体，随后由 1,3-dicarbonyl 三碳片段与 C=N 键发生分子内成环。对于带较大 ketone 取代基的 ynone，竞争性的 Wolff rearrangement 会增强；DFT 显示模型反应中 [3+2] 路径在能量上优于 Wolff 重排。当前证据未完整覆盖全部催化条件与范围。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03682.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The work develops [3+2] annulation of imines with 1,3-diacyl gold carbenes to access 2-acyl-3-aminopyrroles. Mechanistic studies support initial nucleophilic addition of the imine to the gold carbene, followed by intramolecular carbocyclization involving the three-carbon 1,3-dicarbonyl unit and the C=N bond. Bulky ketone substitution on the ynone promotes a competing Wolff rearrangement, whereas DFT for the model system finds the [3+2] pathway energetically favored. Full catalyst conditions and scope data are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03598.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展无金属 photoredox 催化的 isoprene 1,4-(hetero)arylalkylation，通过 arene C–H functionalization 实现高度选择性的双官能化。以 Mes-Acr+BF4− 为有机光催化剂、可见光驱动时，反应对多类 arene 和 imine 有适用性，并实现排他的 1,4-regioselectivity 与 >20:1 的 E:Z 控制。摘要中的机理研究支持 allylic radical 与 α-amino radical 依次生成并交叉偶联。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的具体条件、产率分布或控制实验细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03598.en: Abstract-based: The study reports a metal-free photoredox 1,4-(hetero)arylalkylation of isoprene through arene C–H functionalization. Using Mes-Acr+BF4− as the organic photocatalyst under visible light, the reaction accommodates diverse arenes and imines while delivering exclusive 1,4-regioselectivity and >20:1 E:Z selectivity. Mechanistic studies summarized in the abstract support sequential generation and cross-coupling of allylic and α-amino radicals. Uncaptured conditions, yield distributions, and control-experiment details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01671.zh: 该研究以 rongalite 同时作为还原剂和 C1 synthon，在无过渡金属条件下将 1-(2-nitrophenyl)pyrrole 或相应 indole 一锅转化为 pyrrolo[1,2-α]quinoxaline/indoloquinoxaline。优化研究表明碱和气氛会显著影响模型反应，方法可放大并支持后续衍生化。自由基捕获、甲醛检测和还原对照实验共同用于支持作者提出的还原—C1 引入—环化反应路径，为该稠合含氮骨架提供了不依赖贵金属的构建方式。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01671.en: The study uses rongalite simultaneously as a reductant and a C1 synthon to convert 1-(2-nitrophenyl)pyrroles or the corresponding indole substrate into pyrrolo[1,2-α]quinoxaline/indoloquinoxaline frameworks without a transition metal. Optimization shows that base and atmosphere materially affect the model reaction, and the protocol is scalable and amenable to further derivatization. Radical-scavenger experiments, formaldehyde detection, and reduction controls support the authors’ proposed reductive C1-incorporation/cyclization pathway, providing a precious-metal-free route to these fused N-heterocycles.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c00301.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作发展 allylic azide 与 diazomalonate 的一锅法 1-pyrroline 合成。第一步由 Rh2(esp)2 催化 allylic azide 截获 diazomalonate-derived carbenoid，形成 N-allyl imine；随后 DBU 促进该中间体发生 allylic imine cyclization。摘要报道该顺序两步过程在温和条件下可获得 30 种 1-pyrroline，最高收率 91%。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的催化剂负载、底物逐项数据和机理细节。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c00301.en: Abstract-based: A one-pot synthesis of 1-pyrrolines is developed from allylic azides and diazomalonates. Rh2(esp)2 catalyzes interception of the diazomalonate-derived carbenoid by the allylic azide to form an N-allyl imine, which is then cyclized under DBU promotion. The abstract reports 30 diverse 1-pyrrolines in up to 91% yield under mild conditions. Uncaptured catalyst loadings, substrate-level data, and detailed mechanistic information are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05520.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究提出 alcohol-driven coordination tailoring，把 P-containing POP 上原始 Ru1-3P 单位转化为高活性的 single-phosphine Ru1-1P 位点，并用于无碱添加剂的 borrowing-hydrogen N-alkylation。Ru1-1P/POPs 的 TOF 为 323 h−1、表观活化能 70.1 kJ mol−1，优于 Ru1-3P/POPs 的 145 h−1 和 103.3 kJ mol−1；Ru 在 10 次循环后仍保持原子级分散。作者的机理研究支持不同于传统碱依赖路线的 dihydride transfer，并将 β-hydride elimination 视为速率决定步骤。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和结构表征细节。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05520.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study introduces alcohol-driven coordination tailoring that converts pristine Ru1-3P sites on P-containing POPs into highly active single-phosphine Ru1-1P sites for base-additive-free borrowing-hydrogen N-alkylation. Ru1-1P/POPs gives a TOF of 323 h−1 and an apparent activation energy of 70.1 kJ mol−1, compared with 145 h−1 and 103.3 kJ mol−1 for Ru1-3P/POPs, while Ru remains atomically dispersed after 10 cycles. Mechanistic studies support a dihydride-transfer pathway distinct from conventional base-dependent routes and identify β-hydride elimination as rate-determining. Full substrate and characterization details are not completely captured.

10.1021/jacs.6c16630.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究重新设计 Wolff–Kishner reduction，以可见光在近室温、近中性条件下将芳香和脂肪族 carbonyl 化合物去氧为烃，避免传统方法所需的强碱和高温。模型芳基 hydrazone 在蓝光下使用 2 mol% Ir photocatalyst、10 mol% phosphite base 和 10 mol% TRIP-SH 时可得到 91% 产物；光和 photocatalyst 均为必要条件。方法对 ester、amide 及 α-carbonyl stereocenter 等碱敏感结构兼容性更好，初步机理研究表明 aryl 与 aliphatic hydrazone 具有不同的光化学活化模式。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物与机理细节。
10.1021/jacs.6c16630.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study reimagines the Wolff–Kishner reduction as a visible-light carbonyl deoxygenation that operates near room temperature under essentially neutral conditions, avoiding the strong base and high temperature of classical protocols. A model aryl hydrazone gives 91% product under blue light with 2 mol% Ir photocatalyst, 10 mol% phosphite base, and 10 mol% TRIP-SH; both light and photocatalyst are required. Esters, amides, and α-carbonyl stereocenters are better tolerated, and preliminary mechanistic studies indicate distinct activation modes for aryl and aliphatic hydrazones. Full scope and mechanistic details are not completely captured.

10.1021/jacs.6c15246.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作完成 (−)-methyl gummiferolate 的对映选择性全合成，目标 ent-atisane 四环骨架包含 bicyclo[2.2.2]octane 和三个全碳季碳中心。路线通过 pattern-recognition retrosynthesis 将复杂骨架拆分为源自 (S)-perillaldehyde 的片段和经 Rawal diene 不对称 Diels–Alder 获得的六元环片段；前向合成以 substrate-controlled MHAT-initiated Baran reductive olefin cross-coupling 构建 B 环，并用分子内烷基化建立 bicyclo[2.2.2]octane。天然产物从已知 cyclohexenone 12 出发以 18 步完成。当前证据未完整覆盖所有单步条件和收率。
10.1021/jacs.6c15246.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The work completes an enantioselective total synthesis of (−)-methyl gummiferolate, whose ent-atisane tetracyclic core contains a bicyclo[2.2.2]octane and three all-carbon quaternary centers. Pattern-recognition retrosynthesis traces the framework to a fragment derived from (S)-perillaldehyde and a six-membered-ring fragment accessed through an asymmetric Rawal-diene Diels–Alder reaction. The forward synthesis uses a substrate-controlled MHAT-initiated Baran reductive olefin cross-coupling to close the B ring and an intramolecular alkylation to construct the bicyclo[2.2.2]octane. The natural product is prepared in 18 steps from known cyclohexenone 12; full stepwise conditions and yields are not completely captured.

10.1021/jacs.6c12163.zh: 该研究提出 iodine nitrate（INO3）作为 counteranion-controlled iodocyclization reagent，并建立 Grignard–Sonogashira–iodocyclization–aromatization 四步路线合成 C3 对称三碘代 triphenylene（SITE）。关键步骤是 1,3,5-tris-arylalkynylbenzene 的三重 6-endo-dig cyclization；与 ICl 等传统 I–X 试剂相比，INO3 可避免竞争性卤化，并同时适用于富电子和缺电子底物。SITE 随后作为对称 π-extension hub，构建含 36、54、72、90 和 126 个 graphenic carbon 的五个 all-benzenoid graphene quantum dots。该系列还表现出随尺寸增大非辐射衰减减慢、C126 荧光量子产率 8.2% 等反常光物理趋势。
10.1021/jacs.6c12163.en: The study introduces iodine nitrate (INO3) as a counteranion-controlled iodocyclization reagent and develops a four-step Grignard–Sonogashira–iodocyclization–aromatization route to C3-symmetric triiodinated triphenylenes (SITEs). The key transformation is a triple 6-endo-dig cyclization of 1,3,5-tris-arylalkynylbenzenes; unlike conventional I–X reagents such as ICl, INO3 suppresses competing halogenation across both electron-rich and electron-poor substrates. The SITEs then serve as symmetry-matched π-extension hubs for five all-benzenoid graphene quantum dots containing 36, 54, 72, 90, and 126 graphenic carbons. The series also shows unusual photophysics, including slower nonradiative decay with increasing size and an 8.2% fluorescence quantum yield for C126.

10.1021/jacs.6c10893.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作通过分别合成 secalosides A/B 的两个候选非对映结构，最终解决其长期存在的结构歧义，并确定天然物为 (1S,2S,3R) 构型。早期 asymmetric carbonyl-ene/intramolecular Heck 和 NHC 路线受到氧化还原操作低效、选择性不足及副反应限制；修订路线利用宏环特性触发罕见的 transannular oxidative enolate coupling，在晚期 ring contraction 中同步形成高张力十元 bis-lactone 和具有正确 stereotriad 的 cyclopentane。合成两个候选结构并与天然样品光谱比对构成最终结构指认依据。当前证据未完整覆盖全部单步条件。
10.1021/jacs.6c10893.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The work resolves the long-standing structural ambiguity of secalosides A and B by synthesizing both proposed diastereomeric structures and identifying the natural products as the (1S,2S,3R) stereoisomers. Earlier asymmetric carbonyl-ene/intramolecular Heck and NHC-based approaches were limited by inefficient redox manipulations, poor selectivity, and side reactivity. The successful route exploits macrocyclic character to trigger an unusual transannular oxidative enolate coupling during a late-stage ring contraction, simultaneously forming the strained ten-membered bis-lactone and the cyclopentane with the correct stereotriad. Spectral comparison of both synthetic candidates with the natural material provides the definitive assignment. Full stepwise conditions are not completely captured.

10.1021/jacs.6c10628.zh: 该研究发展 Au 催化 aromatic thermoplastic 后聚合物改性，通过商业 phenyl-substituted alkyne 与聚合物芳环的区域选择性 hydroarylation 直接进行 C–H functionalization。方法适用于 amorphous/syndiotactic polystyrene、polysulfone、PET、poly(ether imide) 和 semiaromatic polyamide 等材料，并能在保持结晶度和关键热机械性质的同时引入 1,2-disubstituted alkene 及多种功能把手。模型研究在 25 °C DCE 中进行，电子吸引型 alkyne 有利于 Z-selective 1,2-disubstitution；即使功能化程度超过 50% 也可维持材料形貌。postconsumer plastic 亦表现相近反应性，说明该平台可用于真实塑料流的增值改造。
10.1021/jacs.6c10628.en: The study develops a gold-catalyzed postpolymerization modification of aromatic thermoplastics through regioselective hydroarylation of commercial phenyl-substituted alkynes with polymer arene C–H bonds. The chemistry is applied to amorphous and syndiotactic polystyrene, polysulfone, PET, poly(ether imide), and semiaromatic polyamide while preserving crystallinity and key thermomechanical properties and introducing 1,2-disubstituted alkenes bearing diverse functional handles. Model studies are performed in DCE at 25 °C, with electron-withdrawing alkynes favoring Z-selective 1,2-disubstitution; morphology can be retained even above 50% functionalization. Comparable reactivity with postconsumer plastics supports applicability to real waste streams.

10.1038/s41467-026-77771-y.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究提出通过 alkylidene carbene 构建 fluorine-stabilised semi-saturated 四元和五元 N/O heterocycle 的通用策略，解决这类介于饱和与不饱和之间的杂环因合成困难和易氧化而长期稀缺的问题。所得含氟半饱和杂环在多种取代模式和官能团下均可获得，并表现良好非对映选择性。动力学、voltammetry 和 metabolism 研究共同表明 fluorine 对这些骨架的氧化稳定性至关重要；产物还能选择性衍生为饱和、不饱和或继续保持半饱和的含氟类似物。当前证据未完整覆盖全部反应条件和底物数据。
10.1038/s41467-026-77771-y.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study presents a general alkylidene-carbene strategy for fluorine-stabilized semi-saturated four- and five-membered N/O heterocycles, addressing the synthetic inaccessibility and oxidative instability that have made these motifs rare. Fluorinated semi-saturated heterocycles are obtained across diverse substitution patterns and functional groups with useful diastereoselectivity. Kinetic, voltammetric, and metabolism studies collectively show that fluorine is critical to oxidative stability, and the products can be selectively converted into saturated, unsaturated, or retained semi-saturated fluorinated analogues. Full reaction conditions and substrate-level data are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03765.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究把经典 Doebner reaction 改造成 DNA-compatible 条件，使 aniline、aldehyde 和 pyruvic acid 能在温和、无催化剂条件下于 DNA 上构建 quinoline-4-carboxylic acid。electron-rich 和 electron-neutral aromatic amine 具有较广适用性，而 electron-deficient amine 的 conversion 通常较低。qPCR 与 NGS 结果表明反应条件能够保持 DNA 的可扩增性和序列保真度，为 DEL 中引入 quinoline scaffold 提供直接方法。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的具体浓度、时间或逐项转化率。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03765.en: Abstract-based: The classical Doebner reaction is adapted to DNA-compatible conditions, allowing anilines, aldehydes, and pyruvic acid to construct quinoline-4-carboxylic acids on DNA under mild, catalyst-free conditions. Electron-rich and electron-neutral aromatic amines show broad utility, whereas electron-deficient amines generally give lower conversion. qPCR and NGS measurements show that DNA amplifiability and sequence fidelity are preserved, providing a direct route to quinoline scaffolds in DNA-encoded libraries. Uncaptured concentrations, times, and substrate-by-substrate conversions are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03679.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究利用 PhSeBr 介导 o-alkynylbenzaldehyde 与 acrylamide 的 cascade annulation，构建 benzo[e]isoindolinone 多环骨架。反应具有较好的官能团耐受性和合成效率；控制实验与 deuterium-labeling 用于支持作者提出的级联路径。部分产物在 PC-3 前列腺癌和 HGC-27 胃癌细胞中表现出较强体外 antiproliferative activity，显示该骨架后续生物活性探索价值。当前证据未完整覆盖全部条件、收率和机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03679.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A PhSeBr-mediated cascade annulation of o-alkynylbenzaldehydes with acrylamides constructs benzo[e]isoindolinone polycycles with useful functional-group tolerance and efficiency. Control experiments and deuterium-labeling studies are used to support the authors’ proposed cascade pathway. Selected products show potent in vitro antiproliferative activity against PC-3 prostate-cancer and HGC-27 gastric-cancer cells, motivating further exploration of the scaffold. Full conditions, yields, and mechanistic details are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03662.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作通过 ligand control 实现 Co 催化 2,3-disubstituted 1,3-diene 的 stereodivergent hydroboration，可分别获得 E 和 Z 四取代烯烃，从而解决高取代烯烃两种几何异构体难以由同一底物平台选择性获得的问题。初步机理研究提示 Z-selectivity 可能涉及 Co–H 物种，而 E-selectivity 则来源于 oxidative migration 路径。当前证据未完整覆盖配体结构、各分支条件、底物范围和选择性数值。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03662.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Ligand control enables cobalt-catalyzed stereodivergent hydroboration of 2,3-disubstituted 1,3-dienes to access either E- or Z-tetrasubstituted alkenes from a common substrate class. Preliminary mechanistic studies suggest that Z selectivity may involve a Co–H species, whereas E selectivity originates from an oxidative-migration pathway. Ligand structures, branch-specific conditions, substrate scope, and selectivity values are not completely captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03657.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展 Cu 催化级联反应，以 C3-substituted indolyl α-diazocarbonyl compound 为前体，在单次转化中连续形成 C–C 和 C–O 键，统一构建 pyrano[3,2-a]carbazole 骨架。该策略完成 7 个天然产物的合成，其中包括 clausenanisine B 的首次全合成。初步 antimicrobial screening 显示部分合成产物对 fungi 和 Gram-positive bacteria 具有浓度依赖活性。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的催化条件、单步收率或机理细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03657.en: Abstract-based: A copper-catalyzed cascade uses C3-substituted indolyl α-diazocarbonyl compounds to construct the pyrano[3,2-a]carbazole framework through sequential C–C and C–O bond formation in a single transformation. The unified strategy is applied to seven natural products, including the first total synthesis of clausenanisine B. Preliminary antimicrobial screening shows concentration-dependent activity against fungi and Gram-positive bacteria for selected members. Uncaptured catalyst conditions, stepwise yields, and mechanistic details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03573.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究实现 aza-arene 的首次 dearomative C3-selective deuteration 与 N-deuteroformylation 一锅反应，以 Hantzsch ester、D2O 和 BrCF2CO2K 在无催化剂、无额外酸碱的温和条件下构建 Fsp3-rich deuterated aza-heterocycle。约 45 个实例中目标产物最高收率 95%、D incorporation 最高 98%，并包括复杂 N-heterocycle 的 late-stage deuteration。控制实验支持 zwitterionic difluoromethyl carboxylate 参与 heteroarene activation。当前证据未完整覆盖所有底物级数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03573.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study reports a one-step dearomative C3-selective deuteration and N-deuteroformylation of aza-arenes using Hantzsch ester, D2O, and BrCF2CO2K under mild conditions without a catalyst or added acid/base, generating Fsp3-rich deuterated aza-heterocycles. Across about 45 examples, yields reach up to 95% with deuterium incorporation up to 98%, including late-stage labeling of complex N-heterocycles. Control studies support activation through a zwitterionic difluoromethyl-carboxylate intermediate. Complete substrate-level data are not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03550.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作发展可见光驱动、NHC organocatalysis 介导的脂肪胺 γ-C(sp3)–H acylation，用于构建 γ-aminoketone。摘要中的机理描述为：electron-rich Breslow intermediate 的 enolate 在光照下向 aryl iodide 发生 SET 生成 aryl radical，随后该 aryl radical 对胺的 γ-C–H 进行 1,7-HAT，形成更稳定的 alkyl radical，并在该远端位点完成 acylation。该方法实现了传统局部官能化难以达到的远程位点选择性。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的具体条件、收率与范围数据。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03550.en: Abstract-based: Visible-light-driven NHC organocatalysis enables site-selective γ-C(sp3)–H acylation of aliphatic amines to access γ-aminoketones. The abstract proposes that the enolate form of an electron-rich Breslow intermediate transfers an electron to an aryl iodide under irradiation to generate an aryl radical; this radical then performs 1,7-HAT at the amine γ-C–H bond, creating the remote alkyl radical that undergoes acylation. The method therefore achieves remote site selectivity that is difficult to obtain by conventional local functionalization. Uncaptured conditions, yields, and scope data are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03493.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 photoredox-catalyzed alkene thioesterification/disulfuration，以 tetrasulfide 和 acyl disulfide 为硫源，在同一烯烃上区域选择性安装两种不同的 sulfur functionality。机理研究指出体系先原位生成 photosensitive acyl trisulfide，后者作为 excited photocatalyst 的 oxidative quencher，形成 acylthio radical 与 perthiolate；两类硫物种的差异化反应性使 chemoselective difunctionalization 成为可能。方法具有较广底物范围和高 regioselectivity；当前证据未完整覆盖全部反应条件和产率。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03493.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops a photoredox-catalyzed thioesterification/disulfuration of alkenes using tetrasulfides and acyl disulfides to install two distinct sulfur functionalities with high regioselectivity. Mechanistic studies indicate in situ formation of photosensitive acyl trisulfides, which oxidatively quench the excited photocatalyst to generate acylthio radicals and perthiolates; their differentiated reactivity enables chemoselective alkene difunctionalization. Broad scope and high regioselectivity are reported, while complete conditions and product-level yields are not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03328.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作发展无需金属和额外添加剂的 nitrone 转移氢化，以空气稳定的 PhSiH3 作为氢供体制备 hydroxylamine 衍生物。模型反应使用 2.0 equiv PhSiH3、toluene、70 °C、24 h，可得到 92% 收率；降低 silane 用量或缩短时间会降低转化，其他常见 hydrosilane 效果也较差。已捕获证据显示底物可容忍卤素、CF3、thioether、thiophene 和 furan 等官能团，并可放大。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物级数据和更深入机理研究。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03328.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The work develops a metal- and additive-free transfer hydrogenation of nitrones using air-stable PhSiH3 as the hydrogen donor to furnish hydroxylamine derivatives. The model reaction uses 2.0 equiv PhSiH3 in toluene at 70 °C for 24 h and gives 92% yield; reducing silane loading or reaction time lowers conversion, and several alternative hydrosilanes are less effective. The captured evidence shows tolerance of halides, CF3, thioether, thiophene, and furan substituents and supports scale-up. Complete substrate-level data and deeper mechanistic studies are not fully captured.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03148.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以 phenyl phosphorylcarbamodithioate 为共同前体，通过 AgF/AgF2 控制两类选择性 fluorination。AgF 促使 P–N 键选择性断裂，得到 phosphoramidofluoridate；AgF2 则推动连续 desulfurative fluorination，得到 N-CF3 phosphoramidate。该策略还能扩展到 N-CF2H、N-C2F5 和 N-CF2OPh phosphoramidate，并可用于 [19F]/[18F] phosphoramidofluoridate 的制备。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的底物范围、收率分布或完整机理。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03148.en: Abstract-based: Phenyl phosphorylcarbamodithioates serve as common precursors for two selectively controlled fluorination manifolds using AgF or AgF2. AgF promotes selective P–N bond cleavage to phosphoramidofluoridates, whereas AgF2 drives successive desulfurative fluorination to N-CF3 phosphoramidates. The strategy also extends to N-CF2H, N-C2F5, and N-CF2OPh phosphoramidates and supports preparation of [19F]/[18F] phosphoramidofluoridates. Uncaptured scope, yield distributions, and full mechanistic details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c02130.zh: 该研究建立 2-arylphenol 与 CO2 的一锅两步 C–H lactonization，先以 BBr3/AlCl3 进行 electrophilic C–H borylation，再用 ZnEt2/KOMe 将 C–B 键 carboxylation，构建 dibenzopyranone。标准序列为 BBr3 1.5 equiv、AlCl3 10 mol%、hexane、60 °C 12 h，随后 ZnEt2 5 equiv、KOMe 4 equiv、DMF、1 atm CO2、130 °C 24 h；代表性产物 2a 为 76% 收率。多类 2-arylphenol 可给 43–87% 收率，10 mmol 放大得到 62% 收率。D2O quench 提供 aryl-zinc intermediate 的直接证据，并显示 base 有利于 transmetalation。方法的限制包括 OMe、NMe2 和 ester 等部分 heteroatom-containing substituent 在该体系下不耐受。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c02130.en: A one-pot, two-step C–H lactonization converts 2-arylphenols and CO2 into dibenzopyranones through BBr3/AlCl3-mediated electrophilic C–H borylation followed by ZnEt2/KOMe-promoted C–B carboxylation. The standard sequence uses 1.5 equiv BBr3 and 10 mol% AlCl3 in hexane at 60 °C for 12 h, then 5 equiv ZnEt2 and 4 equiv KOMe in DMF under 1 atm CO2 at 130 °C for 24 h; model product 2a is obtained in 76% yield. Diverse 2-arylphenols give products in 43–87% yields, and a 10 mmol experiment gives 62% yield. D2O-quench studies provide direct evidence for an aryl-zinc intermediate and show that base facilitates transmetalation. A limitation is that several heteroatom-containing substituents, including OMe, NMe2, and ester groups, are not tolerated.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01679.zh: 该工作提出 triple alkylation 作为 adamantane/(hetero)adamantane (3+1) scaffold 的收敛构建方法。模型体系先以 LiTMP 3.3 equiv 在 THF/TMEDA 中从 −78 °C 升至室温生成 triple enolate，再加入 pentaerythrityl tetrabromide；碳中心 adamantane 3aa 最高 45% 收率。D2O quenching 给出高 D incorporation，支持 triple enolate 的形成。方法还能构建 Ge- 和 Si-bridgehead heteroadamantane，例如 phenylgermaadamantane 可达 70% 收率，并在若干底物上实现 mmol 级放大。该策略对 electrophile sterics/reactivity 较敏感，部分 aza- 和 phosphaadamantane 尝试未成功。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01679.en: The work introduces a convergent triple-alkylation route to adamantane and heteroadamantane (3+1) scaffolds. In the model system, 3.3 equiv LiTMP generates a triple enolate in THF/TMEDA while warming from −78 °C to room temperature, followed by addition of pentaerythrityl tetrabromide; carbon-centered adamantane 3aa is obtained in up to 45% yield. D2O-quench experiments with high deuterium incorporation support formation of the triple enolate. The method also accesses Ge- and Si-bridgehead heteroadamantanes, including a phenylgermaadamantane in 70% yield, and selected reactions are demonstrated on millimole scale. Reactivity is sensitive to electrophile sterics and leaving-group properties, and initial aza- and phosphaadamantane variants were unsuccessful.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01670.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以 Pd/trifluoromethyl-radical 协同策略，实现 N-homoallyl-2-substituted indole 的无导向基 C7-selective trifluoromethylative cyclization，并以 Togni-I reagent 构建 trifluoromethylated lilolidine（pyrrolo[3,2,1-ij]quinoline）骨架。反应能够覆盖 indole 本征更偏好的 C2 环化而选择 C7 位，具有良好官能团兼容性并可克级实施。由于仅有 Abstract 级证据，不补充未捕获的催化条件、具体收率或机理步骤。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01670.en: Abstract-based: A cooperative palladium/trifluoromethyl-radical strategy enables directing-group-free C7-selective trifluoromethylative cyclization of N-homoallyl-2-substituted indoles with Togni-I reagent to form trifluoromethylated lilolidine (pyrrolo[3,2,1-ij]quinoline) frameworks. The reaction overrides the innate C2 cyclization preference of indoles, shows good functional-group compatibility, and is amenable to gram-scale synthesis. Uncaptured catalyst conditions, numerical yields, and mechanistic details are not reconstructed.

10.1002/anie.9432471.zh: 该研究发展 Cp*Co(III) 催化的未活化烯烃 allylic C–H amidation，以 dioxazolone 作为 nitrene precursor，并分离得到明确的 π-allyl-cobalt(III) complex 作为机理探针。该方法具有较广底物范围、良好官能团耐受性和中等至高 regioselectivity。EPR 与 DFT 支持 open-shell singlet cobalt–nitrenoid intermediate；独立 π-allyl-Co 络合物可直接进入催化，光照促进 CO dissociation 后可与 dioxazolone 形成后续 nitrenoid/迁移插入中间体。该工作重点在于以可分离中间体建立 cobalt-mediated nitrene transfer 的直接机理证据，并为选择性 base-metal C–H amination 提供基础。
10.1002/anie.9432471.en: A Cp*Co(III)-catalyzed allylic C–H amidation of unactivated alkenes uses dioxazolones as nitrene precursors and isolates a well-defined π-allyl-cobalt(III) complex as a mechanistic probe. The method shows broad substrate scope, good functional-group tolerance, and moderate-to-high regioselectivity. EPR and DFT support an open-shell singlet cobalt–nitrenoid intermediate; the isolated π-allyl-Co complex is catalytically competent, and photolysis promotes CO dissociation before dioxazolone coordination and downstream nitrenoid/migratory-insertion chemistry. The work therefore provides direct mechanistic insight into cobalt-mediated nitrene transfer and a foundation for selective base-metal C–H amination.

10.1002/anie.7937631.zh: 该研究以手性 pyridoxal 模拟 PLP-dependent threonine aldolase，催化 glycinamide 与 aldehyde 的直接不对称 aldol reaction，一步获得 β-hydroxy-α-amino amide，最高 98% 收率、>20:1 dr 和 99% ee。优化后催化剂负载可降至 1 mol%；模型产物以稳定盐形式分离时为 86% 收率、>20:1 dr、99% ee。该反应还能直接修饰含 glycinamide 的 dipeptide 和 polypeptide，并用于 eliglustat 关键手性中间体的制备。机理研究支持与 threonine aldolase 类似的 cooperative carbonyl catalysis，解释 glycinamide 活化与高立体控制。
10.1002/anie.7937631.en: A chiral pyridoxal catalyst inspired by PLP-dependent threonine aldolase enables direct asymmetric aldol reactions of glycinamides with aldehydes to furnish β-hydroxy-α-amino amides in up to 98% yield, >20:1 dr, and 99% ee. Optimization allows catalyst loading as low as 1 mol%; the model product is isolated as a stable salt in 86% yield, >20:1 dr, and 99% ee. Glycinamide-containing dipeptides and polypeptides can be modified directly, and the chemistry provides a key chiral intermediate of eliglustat. Mechanistic studies support a cooperative carbonyl-catalysis pathway analogous to threonine aldolase, accounting for glycinamide activation and stereocontrol.

10.1002/anie.7845758.zh: 该研究发展 photocatalytic transannular functional-group migration（TFGM），由 alkylidene cyclobutane 与多类 radical precursor 在室温构建 1,1,3-trisubstituted cyclobutane，并通过刚性 BCH-type transition state 获得排他的 cis-selectivity。体系兼容 alkyl、acyl 和 sulfonyl radical，以及 heteroarene、nitrile、aldehyde、oxime 和 alkene 等迁移基团；部分 arylsulfonyl chloride 反应可使用低至 0.05 mol% 4-CzIPN。所得 cyclobutane 可进一步经 5-exo-tet cyclization 和 cross-coupling 模块化转化为 1,2,4-trisubstituted bicyclo[2.1.1]hexane。BCH-Olaparib/Fluzoparib 类似物的细胞和 PARP1 测试支持这些 BCH 作为 1,2,4-trisubstituted benzene bioisostere 的药物化学价值。
10.1002/anie.7845758.en: Photocatalytic transannular functional-group migration (TFGM) converts alkylidene cyclobutanes and diverse radical precursors into 1,1,3-trisubstituted cyclobutanes at room temperature with exclusive cis selectivity through a rigid BCH-type transition state. Alkyl, acyl, and sulfonyl radicals are accommodated, together with migrating heteroarenes, nitriles, aldehydes, oximes, and alkenes; selected arylsulfonyl-chloride reactions operate with as little as 0.05 mol% 4-CzIPN. The cyclobutanes can be transformed modularly into 1,2,4-trisubstituted bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes through 5-exo-tet cyclization and cross-coupling. Cellular and PARP1 studies of BCH-Olaparib/Fluzoparib analogues support these BCHs as bioisosteres of 1,2,4-trisubstituted benzenes.

10.1002/anie.6732152.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究把 (thio)urea H-bond donor 与 alkoxide chain-propagation site 共价预组织在单一催化/引发分子中，用于 glycolide 的可控 ring-opening polymerization。优化的 sodium-alkoxide Cat. 7 在温和条件下可获得 Mn 最高 222.4 kDa 的 PGA（Đ 1.57，TON 11,600，TOF 483 h−1）；晶体学、动力学、光谱和计算共同支持 intramolecular cooperative monomer activation/chain propagation。所得 PGA 的 tensile strength 为 116 MPa，催化剂也可快速聚合 ε-caprolactone 并构建 PCL-b-PGA block copolymer。作者明确指出尚未系统评估催化剂/聚合放大与长期储存稳定性，且 HFAB-containing medium 需要严格干燥和惰性气氛操作。
10.1002/anie.6732152.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study covalently preorganizes a (thio)urea H-bond donor and an alkoxide chain-propagation site within one catalyst/initiator for controlled ring-opening polymerization of glycolide. Optimized sodium-alkoxide Cat. 7 affords PGA with Mn up to 222.4 kDa (Đ 1.57, TON 11,600, TOF 483 h−1) under mild conditions; crystallographic, kinetic, spectroscopic, and computational evidence supports intramolecular cooperative monomer activation and chain propagation. The resulting PGA reaches a tensile strength of 116 MPa, and the catalyst also polymerizes ε-caprolactone rapidly and enables PCL-b-PGA block copolymers. The authors explicitly note that catalyst/polymerization scale-up and long-term catalyst storage have not been systematically assessed, and the HFAB-containing medium requires rigorous drying and inert-atmosphere handling.

10.1002/anie.5853261.zh: 该工作首次完成 (−)-penostatin G 全合成，并将其氧化衍生物转化为 penostatins B 和 C。路线从商业 cyclopentanone 出发，最长线性 12 步且全程无需保护基；关键包括 chiral exocyclic enone 控制的 exo Diels–Alder、MMPP 介导的 chemo-/regioselective Baeyer–Villiger oxidation，以及 cyclic vicinal tricarbonyl precursor 的 intramolecular oxa-Diels–Alder cascade，用于高立体选择性建立 dihydropyran 和桥环结构。全合成同时确认 penostatin G 的绝对构型，而由其氧化产物转化为 penostatin B/C 为这些天然产物的内在生源关系提供化学支持。
10.1002/anie.5853261.en: The work achieves the first total synthesis of (−)-penostatin G and converts an oxidized derivative into penostatins B and C. Starting from a commercial cyclopentanone, the route proceeds in 12 longest-linear steps without protecting groups. Key operations include a chiral-exocyclic-enone-controlled exo Diels–Alder reaction, MMPP-mediated chemo- and regioselective Baeyer–Villiger oxidation, and an intramolecular oxa-Diels–Alder cascade of a cyclic vicinal-tricarbonyl precursor that establishes the dihydropyran and bridged rings with high stereoselectivity. The synthesis confirms the absolute configuration of penostatin G, while conversion to penostatins B/C provides chemical support for their intrinsic biogenic relationship.

10.1002/anie.4322109.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 CuOAc-catalyzed 3,3-disubstituted cyclopropene 不对称 hydrogermylation，获得结构多样的手性 organogermane，并表现高至优异的 diastereo- 和 enantioselectivity。对照实验表明 copper carboxylate 对该反应具有独特作用，而 Cu(CH3CN)4PF6 与外加碱的组合几乎无反应。作者的机理研究提出 CuOAc–bisphosphine 催化剂可通过协同六元环 transition state 促进 H3GeAr/H2GeAr2 的关键 deprotonation。所得 organogermane 还可进行多种后续官能化。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物、条件和选择性数值。
10.1002/anie.4322109.en: Evidence coverage is partial. The study develops a CuOAc-catalyzed asymmetric hydrogermylation of 3,3-disubstituted cyclopropenes, furnishing diverse chiral organogermanes with high-to-excellent diastereo- and enantioselectivity. Control experiments show a unique role for copper carboxylate, whereas Cu(CH3CN)4PF6 combined with external bases gives negligible reactivity. Mechanistic studies propose that the CuOAc–bisphosphine catalyst enables critical deprotonation of H3GeAr/H2GeAr2 through a cooperative six-membered transition state. The products support versatile post-functionalization; full substrate, condition, and selectivity data are not completely captured.

10.1002/anie.2743830.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究发展 cascade photo-induced radical cyclization（PIRC）策略，程序化构建 peripheral N-doped nanographene 的单层和离散双层架构。以 nanographene 1 为平台，π-extension 生成更大单层 2，而调节外围位阻可形成 bilayer assembly (3)2。单晶 X-ray 确认 1/2 的单层结构，NMR、MALDI-TOF 与 DFT 支持 (3)2 为双层构型；双层相对单层出现符合 H-type coupling 的 broadened/blue-shifted absorption。外围 N–H 还能通过与含氧溶剂的 hydrogen bonding 触发 bilayer→monolayer 解离，表现出由 π–π interaction 与 hydrogen bonding 正交控制的 solvent-responsive、concentration-independent structural transformation。
10.1002/anie.2743830.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A cascade photo-induced radical cyclization (PIRC) strategy enables programmable peripheral N-doped nanographenes with monolayer and discrete bilayer architectures. Nanographene 1 serves as a platform for π-extension to larger monolayer 2, whereas tuning peripheral sterics produces bilayer assembly (3)2. Single-crystal X-ray analysis confirms monolayer structures 1/2, while NMR, MALDI-TOF, and DFT support the bilayer structure of (3)2; the bilayer shows broadened, blue-shifted absorption consistent with H-type coupling. Peripheral N–H groups enable hydrogen-bond-accepting oxygenated solvents to induce bilayer-to-monolayer dissociation, giving a solvent-responsive, concentration-independent structural transformation governed by orthogonal π–π interactions and hydrogen bonding.

10.1002/anie.2320378.zh: 该研究发展 amino-group-directed、无金属的一锅 benzofuran 构建法，由 α-diketone 与 diarylamine 在酸性条件下依次发生 intermolecular/intramolecular Friedel–Crafts-type 过程，区域选择性生成 fused benzofuran，并具有可用的底物范围和克级可操作性。该骨架进一步被用作 MR-TADF donor，构建 BNFFA 和 BNFFC；两者分别具有 20 和 25 nm 的窄带 FWHM，对应 OLED 的 maximum EQE 达 23.5% 和 29.3%。该工作把简洁的 heteroarene 合成直接连接到 blue–cyan narrowband emitter 的器件性能。
10.1002/anie.2320378.en: An amino-group-directed, metal-free one-pot synthesis of fused benzofurans couples α-diketones with diarylamines through sequential intermolecular and intramolecular Friedel–Crafts-type processes under acidic conditions, with useful substrate scope and gram-scale practicality. The resulting scaffold is used as an MR-TADF donor platform for BNFFA and BNFFC, which show narrow emission with FWHM values of 20 and 25 nm; OLEDs based on these emitters reach maximum EQEs of 23.5% and 29.3%, respectively.
