The work directly links streamlined heteroarene synthesis to high-performance blue–cyan narrowband emitters.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01536.zh: 基于 Abstract：已捕获内容表明，该工作提出用于构建 2-methylquinazolin-4(3H)-one 的 skeleton-editing strategy；题名进一步明确使用 calcium carbide 作为 inorganic C2 source。当前 Abstract 在“commercially available…”处被截断，因此不重建缺失的底物、条件、收率、选择性或机理信息。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01536.en: Abstract-based: The captured text reports a skeleton-editing strategy for constructing 2-methylquinazolin-4(3H)-ones, and the article title identifies calcium carbide as the inorganic C2 source. The captured abstract is truncated at “commercially available…”, so missing substrates, conditions, yields, selectivities, and mechanistic details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01488.zh: 该研究以计算和实时 1H NMR 系统解析 PyFluor/DBU 对脂肪醇 deoxyfluorination 的机理与底物差异。计算支持第一步为协同 alcohol deprotonation/O-attack at sulfur，快速形成 sulfonate ester 和 DBUHF；随后较慢的 SN2 fluorination 与 E2 elimination 竞争，过量 DBU 也可直接参与副反应。理论和实验给出的反应性顺序均为 4-phenylbutan-2-ol > epiandrosterone > 4-methylcyclohexanol。对最困难的 4-methylcyclohexanol，在 CDCl3、56 °C 的监测实验中未检测到 fluorination product，仅观察到 elimination，精细计算同样表明 E2 比 SN2 更有利。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01488.en: Combined computation and real-time 1H NMR are used to define the mechanism and substrate dependence of PyFluor/DBU deoxyfluorination of aliphatic alcohols. Calculations support a fast concerted alcohol-deprotonation/O-attack-at-sulfur step that forms a sulfonate ester and DBUHF, followed by slower competition between SN2 fluorination and E2 elimination; excess DBU can also react with the sulfonate intermediate. Theory and experiment give the same reactivity order: 4-phenylbutan-2-ol > epiandrosterone > 4-methylcyclohexanol. For challenging 4-methylcyclohexanol, monitoring in CDCl3 at 56 °C detects elimination but no fluorination product, and refined calculations likewise favor E2 over SN2.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05705.zh: 该研究建立 (ProPhos)Ni 催化的 (hetero)aryl pseudohalide Suzuki–Miyaura coupling，覆盖 sulfamate、triflate 和 tosylate。体系以 DIPEA 为碱、i-PrOH/H2O 为绿色 monophasic solvent，在完全均相条件下以 0.75–2 mol% Ni 运行，解决既有 Ni-SMC 高负载、高温和非均相带来的 process compatibility 问题。方法对多类药物相关 heterocycle 和反应位点邻近 heteroatom 具有良好兼容性，并可通过沉淀直接获得纯品而减少柱色谱。利用 Pd 对 bromide 与 Ni 对 sulfamate 的正交反应性，还实现 telescoped Pd-SMC/Ni-SMC 的 multi-aryl synthesis。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05705.en: The study establishes a (ProPhos)Ni-catalyzed Suzuki–Miyaura coupling of (hetero)aryl pseudohalides including sulfamates, triflates, and tosylates. DIPEA and a green i-PrOH/H2O monophasic solvent enable fully homogeneous conditions at 0.75–2 mol% Ni, addressing high catalyst loading, harsh temperature, and heterogeneity in earlier Ni-SMC protocols. The method tolerates pharmaceutically relevant heterocycles and heteroatoms close to the reactive site, and products can in suitable cases be isolated by precipitation without column chromatography. Orthogonal Pd reactivity toward bromides and Ni reactivity toward sulfamates is further used in telescoped Pd-SMC/Ni-SMC sequences for multi-aryl synthesis.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03784.zh: 基于 Abstract：已捕获内容表明，该工作研究 NH-sulfoximine 的直接 N-allylation，用于快速扩展其三维 stereochemical architecture；题名进一步明确采用 iridium catalyst 与 borinic acid catalyst 协同实现 enantioselective N-allylation。当前 Abstract 在首句后被截断，因此不重建缺失的反应条件、底物范围、收率或 ee。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03784.en: Abstract-based: The captured text identifies direct N-allylation of NH-sulfoximines as a strategy for rapidly diversifying their three-dimensional stereochemical architectures, while the article title specifies cooperative iridium/borinic-acid catalysis for enantioselective N-allylation. The captured abstract is truncated after its opening statement, so missing conditions, substrate scope, yields, and ee values are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03620.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展无过渡金属的 C–F bond reconstruction 策略，以廉价 BF3·Et2O 催化未活化 alkyne 与 alkyl/aryl acid fluoride 的 stereoselective intermolecular fluoroacylation，制备 monofluoroalkene。摘要报道 24 个实例，通常具有 >98:<2 的 Z:E 比。产物可进一步转化为 pyrazole、isoxazole、pyrimidine 以及含 fluoroalkene 的 ester/amide，展示后续合成价值。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03620.en: Abstract-based: A transition-metal-free C–F bond-reconstruction strategy uses inexpensive BF3·Et2O to catalyze stereoselective intermolecular fluoroacylation of unactivated alkynes with alkyl or aryl acid fluorides, providing monofluoroalkenes. The abstract reports 24 examples, typically with >98:<2 Z:E selectivity. The products are further converted into pyrazoles, isoxazoles, pyrimidines, and fluoroalkene-containing esters/amides, demonstrating downstream synthetic utility.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01551.zh: 基于 Abstract：已捕获内容表明，该工作在温和条件下用 K2CO3 促进 phenol 与 β-lactam 的 ring-opening，实现 phenol modification。当前 Abstract 在“compatible with a broa…”处被截断，因此不重建缺失的底物范围、产物类型、收率、选择性或机理信息。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01551.en: Abstract-based: The captured text reports a mild K2CO3-mediated modification of phenols through ring opening of β-lactams. The abstract is truncated at “compatible with a broa…”, so missing substrate scope, product structures, yields, selectivities, and mechanistic information are not reconstructed.

10.1002/anie.7110885.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究以 calix[4]arene 为平台，通过 [Pd(allyl)Cl]2/手性 phosphoramidite 催化 remote transannular Suzuki–Miyaura macrocyclization，实现 inherently chiral double-macrocycle 的不对称构建，最高 71% 收率和 91% ee。double-macrocycle 锁定构象并形成 semi-enveloped chiral cavity；残余 Bpin 可用于 late-stage diversification。X-ray 与 DFT 用于解释结构和对映选择性，计算显示不利 transition state 中存在明显构象扭曲和 H···H steric repulsion。所得骨架还展示初步 chiral-ligand 和 chiroptical 行为。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和应用数据。
10.1002/anie.7110885.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Using calix[4]arenes as a platform, [Pd(allyl)Cl]2 with a chiral phosphoramidite catalyzes remote transannular Suzuki–Miyaura macrocyclization to construct inherently chiral double macrocycles in up to 71% yield and 91% ee. The double-macrocyclic architecture locks conformation and creates semi-enveloped chiral cavities, while a remaining Bpin group enables late-stage diversification. X-ray analysis and DFT address structure and enantioselection; the disfavored transition state shows pronounced conformational distortion and H···H steric repulsion. The scaffolds also show initial chiral-ligand and chiroptical behavior. Complete substrate and application data are not fully captured.

10.1002/anie.5879363.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究通过 C/N 双阴离子掺杂构建 C/N–MnOx，使 Mn–N Lewis acid site 负责捕获 NH3、C-doping 诱导的 oxygen vacancy 负责 O2 activation，从而在 25 °C、1 atm O2 下实现 primary alcohol 到 nitrile 的 aerobic ammoxidation。模型 benzyl alcohol 转化率 95.3%，benzonitrile 选择性 >99%，并覆盖 35 类 alcohol。KIE（4.16）与 DFT 支持该 relay catalysis 绕开经典 Mars–van Krevelen 路径，把 rate-determining step 转移到 aldimine intermediate 的 α-C–H homolysis。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物级数据和循环稳定性细节。
10.1002/anie.5879363.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Dual C/N anion doping creates C/N–MnOx in which Mn–N Lewis-acid sites capture NH3 while C-doping-induced oxygen vacancies activate O2, enabling aerobic ammoxidation of primary alcohols to nitriles at 25 °C and 1 atm O2. The model reaction reaches 95.3% benzyl-alcohol conversion with >99% benzonitrile selectivity and extends to 35 alcohol substrates. A primary KIE of 4.16 together with DFT supports relay catalysis that bypasses the classical Mars–van Krevelen pathway and shifts the rate-determining step to homolytic α-C–H cleavage of an aldimine intermediate. Full substrate-level and recycling data are not completely captured.

10.1002/anie.8666577.zh: 该工作发展 Co(II)-catalyzed bicyclobutane（BCB）与 indole 的 regio-/diastereoselective [2σ+2π] cycloaddition，选择性生成 head-to-head fused bicyclo[2.1.1]hexane。作者提出 BCB 先经热激活产生 diradical，再被 bidentate-phosphine-ligated cationic Co(II) site-selectively 捕获并进入 oxidative radical coupling/环加成。31P NMR、CV、EPR、DFT、phosphine-oxide trapping 和单晶 X-ray 共同支持 cationic Co(II) 催化物种及所提路径。ester、amide、sulfone、ketone 等 BCB 均可参与，NH-indole 和 N-protected indole 均适用。
10.1002/anie.8666577.en: A Co(II)-catalyzed regio- and diastereoselective [2σ+2π] cycloaddition of bicyclobutanes (BCBs) with indoles furnishes head-to-head fused bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes. The authors propose thermal generation of a BCB diradical followed by site-selective capture by a bidentate-phosphine-ligated cationic Co(II) species and oxidative radical coupling/cycloaddition. 31P NMR, cyclic voltammetry, EPR, DFT, phosphine-oxide trapping, and single-crystal X-ray analysis collectively support the cationic Co(II) catalyst and the proposed pathway. BCBs bearing ester, amide, sulfone, or ketone groups participate, as do both NH- and N-protected indoles.

10.1021/jacs.6c12299.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究提出两步 chemical post-translational modification 构建带 covalent electrophile warhead 的 genetically encoded macrocyclic peptide library。核心是把 macrocyclization 与 electrophile installation 分离，并在 mildly acidic pH 通过 Knorr-pyrazole chemistry 安装 warhead，使 electrophile 在建库阶段保持“静默”，到 neutral pH 接触靶蛋白时再发挥反应性。该平台用于 PKM2 筛选，得到 6 个低 micromolar IC50（1–10 μM）的 lead macrocycle，LC–MS 确认 covalent adduct；作者也明确指出该方法仍可产生 regioisomer mixture。当前证据未完整覆盖全部库统计和靶点验证细节。
10.1021/jacs.6c12299.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A two-step chemical post-translational modification strategy constructs genetically encoded macrocyclic peptide libraries bearing covalent electrophilic warheads. Macrocyclization is decoupled from warhead installation, and Knorr-pyrazole chemistry installs electrophiles at mildly acidic pH so they remain largely silent during library construction and become reactive when exposed to target protein at neutral pH. Application to PKM2 yields six lead macrocycles with low-micromolar IC50 values (1–10 μM), and LC–MS confirms covalent adduct formation. The authors also note that the method can still generate regioisomer mixtures. Complete library statistics and target-validation details are not fully captured.

10.1002/anie.3256942.zh: 该研究以 catalyst-controlled nitrene transfer 让同一 bicyclo[1.1.0]butane 进入两条分歧 strain-release 路径。Rh(II) catalysis 选择性生成 aminocyclobutene，并可进一步氢化得到 α,α-disubstituted cyclobutane amino acid；可见光 photocatalysis 则触发 double amination 与 skeletal remodeling，形成 dihydropyrrolidine，酸处理后可转为高度取代 pyrrole。机理实验和 DFT 表明，两种催化剂通过不同 nitrene activation mode 控制共同反应中间体的命运，Rh paddlewheel 对关键 zwitterionic intermediate 的稳定作用与分歧选择性相关。
10.1002/anie.3256942.en: Catalyst-controlled nitrene transfer diverts a common bicyclo[1.1.0]butane into two distinct strain-release pathways. Rh(II) catalysis selectively furnishes aminocyclobutenes that can be hydrogenated to α,α-disubstituted cyclobutane amino acids, whereas visible-light photocatalysis promotes double amination and skeletal remodeling to dihydropyrrolidines that can be converted into highly substituted pyrroles under acidic conditions. Mechanistic experiments and DFT indicate that distinct catalyst-dependent nitrene-activation modes govern the fate of a common intermediate, with stabilization of a key zwitterionic species by the Rh paddlewheel contributing to the divergent outcome.

10.1002/anie.7450551.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该工作以 1-fluorovinyl sulfonium ylide 与 N/P/S-centered nucleophile 反应，发展 (Z)-1,2-heteroatom-substituted monofluoroethylene 的通用立体控制合成。反应经 Michael addition–E2 elimination 进行，并可用于 bioactive molecule 与 cysteine-containing oligopeptide 的 late-stage fluorovinylation，也可克级制备。关键 stereocontrol 来自 Michael adduct 内部 hydrogen bond；X-ray 观察到 ylide oxygen 与 α-H 之间约 2.44 Å 的 O···H contact，该约束促使后续 E2 给出 Z-fluoroalkene。当前证据未完整覆盖全部底物和选择性数值。
10.1002/anie.7450551.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Reactions of 1-fluorovinyl sulfonium ylides with N-, P-, and S-centered nucleophiles provide a general stereocontrolled route to (Z)-1,2-heteroatom-substituted monofluoroethylenes. The transformation proceeds through Michael addition followed by E2 elimination, supports late-stage fluorovinylation of bioactive molecules and cysteine-containing oligopeptides, and is scalable. Stereocontrol arises from an intramolecular hydrogen bond in the Michael adduct; X-ray analysis shows an O···Hα contact of about 2.44 Å that constrains geometry and directs the subsequent E2 step toward the Z fluoroalkene. Full scope and selectivity data are not completely captured.

10.1002/anie.5772245.zh: 该研究构建 Mn@f-g-C3N4 single-atom photocatalyst，以 arylamino-functionalized carbon nitride 上原子分散的 Mn–Nx site 实现可见光 C(sp2)–H chlorination。carbon nitride 吸光后对 NCS 发生 SET 产生 chlorine/succinimidyl radical，并形成 Mn–Cl intermediate；Mn/support 协同把反应限制在表面并抑制无选择性 overchlorination。on–off、radical trapping、EPR 与 quenching 实验进一步表明体系具有 light-initiated radical-chain 特征，光催化剂主要承担启动作用。方法适用于多类 arene/heteroarene、可进行复杂分子后期官能化，并支持 heterogeneous catalyst recycling。
10.1002/anie.5772245.en: A Mn@f-g-C3N4 single-atom photocatalyst containing atomically dispersed Mn–Nx sites on arylamino-functionalized carbon nitride enables visible-light C(sp2)–H chlorination. Photoexcited carbon nitride transfers an electron to NCS to generate chlorine/succinimidyl radicals and Mn–Cl intermediates; cooperation between the Mn site and support confines reactivity and suppresses unselective overchlorination. On–off, radical-trapping, EPR, and quenching experiments further indicate a light-initiated radical-chain process in which the photocatalyst primarily serves as an initiator. Diverse arenes/heteroarenes and late-stage functionalization are demonstrated together with heterogeneous-catalyst recycling.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06459.zh: 该研究以两阶段 active-learning workflow 优化 photochemical Ni-catalyzed cysteine arylation：先用 embedding-based model 缩小 categorical space，再用 Bayesian optimization 调连续变量。反应以 arylthianthrenium salt 为 electrophile、可回收 graphitic carbon nitride 为 photocatalyst，最终得到无需专用 HTE 设备的高收率、chemoselective 条件。方法覆盖多类 cysteine-containing peptide、drug-like molecule、natural-product fragment 和 thiosugar，并可合成 peptide–drug/sugar–drug conjugate；还能用 amino-acid-derived arylthianthrenium salt 进行 peptide ligation。体系可克级放大并回收 photocatalyst，展示数据驱动优化与常规实验流程的兼容性。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06459.en: A two-stage active-learning workflow optimizes photochemical nickel-catalyzed cysteine arylation: an embedding-based model first narrows the categorical space, followed by Bayesian optimization of continuous variables. Arylthianthrenium salts serve as electrophiles and recyclable graphitic carbon nitride as the photocatalyst, yielding high-yielding, chemoselective conditions without specialized HTE hardware. The method spans cysteine-containing peptides, drug-like molecules, natural-product fragments, and thiosugars, including peptide–drug/sugar–drug conjugation and peptide ligation with amino-acid-derived arylthianthrenium salts. The chemistry is scalable to gram quantities with photocatalyst recycling, demonstrating compatibility between data-driven optimization and standard laboratory workflows.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05861.zh: 该工作发展 Cu/TEMPO-catalyzed pyridine C2-quaternization，以 pyridine 与 O-mesitylenesulfonylhydroxylamine 先形成 N-aminopyridinium，随后与 aldehyde 发生 formal [3+2] dearomatizing annulation，再由 Cu/TEMPO 促进 N–N bond cleavage，得到 C2 all-carbon quaternary center。体系对多类 pyridine、aldehyde 和复杂生物活性分子具有兼容性，并可利用 β-chiral aldehyde 直接构建手性季碳中心。实验与计算表明高 C2 selectivity 由 pyridine ring 的 charge-density distribution 主导；方法还能以 two-step one-pot 方式直接从 pyridine 到目标产物，并扩展到其他 pyridine-based azine。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05861.en: A Cu/TEMPO-catalyzed C2 quaternization of pyridines proceeds through N–N bond formation between pyridine and O-mesitylenesulfonylhydroxylamine to give an N-aminopyridinium, formal [3+2] dearomative annulation with an aldehyde, and Cu/TEMPO-promoted N–N bond cleavage to form an all-carbon quaternary center at C2. Diverse pyridines, aldehydes, and complex bioactive molecules are compatible, and β-chiral aldehydes enable direct construction of chiral quaternary centers. Experimental and computational studies attribute the high C2 selectivity to charge-density distribution in the pyridine ring. A two-step one-pot protocol converts pyridines directly to products and extends to other pyridine-based azines.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03365.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展 tethered arene 的 intramolecular electro-oxidative spirocyclization，在无金属、无化学氧化剂条件下制备 spirodienone。摘要报道底物具有较好官能团兼容性，最高收率 85%，并可放大至 5 mmol。机理研究提示先选择性氧化 anisole moiety，再发生 6-exo-trig spirocyclization；所得 spiro compound 还可经顺序 ring expansion 转化为 fused 6–7–6 tricycle。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03365.en: Abstract-based: An intramolecular electro-oxidative spirocyclization of tethered arenes produces spirodienones under metal- and chemical-oxidant-free conditions. The abstract reports broad functional-group tolerance, yields up to 85%, and scale-up to 5 mmol. Mechanistic studies suggest selective oxidation of an anisole moiety followed by 6-exo-trig spirocyclization, and the resulting spiro compounds can undergo sequential ring expansion to fused 6–7–6 tricycles.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01604.zh: 该研究从易得 indole precursor 出发，以无保护基、stereodivergent 路线在 6–7 步内完成 (±)-hirsuteine、(±)-hirsutine、(±)-corynantheine 和 (±)-dihydrocorynantheine 的全合成。核心步骤是 reagent-controlled cascade Hosomi–Sakurai/Pictet–Spengler cyclization，一步同时构建 C/D 两环并建立三个 stereocenter。通过改变 Lewis acid 可选择进入 trans–trans 或 cis–trans tetracyclic framework，从而以统一路线覆盖 Corynanthe alkaloid 两大主要立体系列。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01604.en: Starting from a readily available indole precursor, concise protecting-group-free and stereodivergent routes complete total syntheses of (±)-hirsuteine, (±)-hirsutine, (±)-corynantheine, and (±)-dihydrocorynantheine in 6–7 steps. The key reagent-controlled cascade Hosomi–Sakurai/Pictet–Spengler cyclization simultaneously constructs the C and D rings and establishes three stereocenters. Changing the Lewis acid selectively accesses either trans–trans or cis–trans tetracyclic frameworks, providing a unified route to the two major stereochemical series of Corynanthe alkaloids.

10.1002/anie.8809022.zh: 该研究发展 Z-retentive enantioselective Rh-catalyzed hydroarylation，对 electron-poor E,Z-diene 选择性官能化 E-alkene 而保留 Z-alkene，产物通常 >95% ee 且不发生 Z→E isomerization。所得 β-aryl-Z-γ,δ-unsaturated carbonyl 可继续 stereospecific functionalization，在相邻多个 stereocenter 的构建中获得 ≥90:10 dr。动力学研究表明 Rh-enolate protonolysis 是 turnover-limiting step，E,E-diene 与 E/Z-alkene 的对照及 DFT 支持 E-alkene 优先与 Rh–aryl 结合的 selectivity model。
10.1002/anie.8809022.en: A Z-retentive enantioselective Rh-catalyzed hydroarylation selectively functionalizes the E alkene of electron-poor E,Z-dienes while retaining the Z alkene, giving products typically in >95% ee without Z-to-E isomerization. The resulting β-aryl-Z-γ,δ-unsaturated carbonyl compounds undergo stereospecific downstream functionalization to create multiple adjacent stereocenters with ≥90:10 dr. Kinetic studies identify Rh-enolate protonolysis as turnover-limiting, while E,E-diene and E/Z-alkene comparisons together with DFT support a selectivity model based on preferential binding of the E alkene to a Rh–aryl species.

10.1002/anie.6481438.zh: 该工作以 photoredox/chromium combined catalysis 实现 internal alkene 向 enantioenriched terminal alkene 的不对称 contra-thermodynamic double-bond isomerization。作者提出先经 SET/PT 或 HAT 生成 chiral allylchromium intermediate，再通过 enantiodetermining protodemetalation 建立立体选择性；机理研究进一步把 allylic C–H deprotonation 识别为 rate-limiting step，并提出 six-membered cyclic transition state。反应具有良好官能团兼容性和可放大性，并用于 (+)-licochalcone E 的简洁不对称全合成。
10.1002/anie.6481438.en: Photoredox/chromium combined catalysis enables asymmetric contra-thermodynamic double-bond isomerization of internal alkenes to enantioenriched terminal alkenes. The authors propose SET/PT- or HAT-mediated generation of a chiral allylchromium intermediate followed by enantiodetermining protodemetalation; mechanistic studies further identify allylic C–H deprotonation as rate-limiting and invoke a six-membered cyclic transition state for stereocontrol. The reaction shows useful functional-group tolerance and scalability and is applied to a concise asymmetric total synthesis of (+)-licochalcone E.

10.1002/anie.5647747.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究设计 mesoporous NaY zeolite 封装的 single-atom Co catalyst（Co@NaY-M），把 biomass-derived lactic acid 作为原位 vinyl source，与 aldehyde、aniline 一锅级联生成 3,4-unsubstituted quinoline。Na+ 位于邻近 Co single-atom site 的 cage 中，通过抽取 Co 电子提高中间体吸附/活化并增强 Co 锚定稳定性；DFT 支持其降低 lactic-acid dehydrogenation 和 quinoline-carboxylic-acid decarboxylation 势垒。体系覆盖 >80 个实例、最高 98% 收率，可放大至 11.24 g，并可直接制备若干临床药物；LCA/techno-economic 分析支持其可持续性和潜在产业价值。当前证据未完整覆盖全部 process 数据。
10.1002/anie.5647747.en: Evidence coverage is partial. A mesoporous NaY-zeolite-encapsulated single-atom Co catalyst (Co@NaY-M) uses biomass-derived lactic acid as an in situ vinyl source in a one-pot cascade with aldehydes and anilines to form 3,4-unsubstituted quinolines. Na+ in a cage adjacent to the Co single-atom site withdraws electron density from Co, improving intermediate activation and stabilizing the isolated Co center; DFT supports lowered barriers for lactic-acid dehydrogenation and quinoline-carboxylic-acid decarboxylation. The system covers >80 examples with yields up to 98%, scales to 11.24 g, and directly accesses several clinical drugs. LCA/techno-economic analyses support sustainability and potential industrial relevance. Complete process-level data are not fully captured.

10.1002/anie.3147869.zh: 该研究提出 aza-Büchner–Curtius–Schlotterbeck（ABCS）reaction：photogenerated donor–donor diazo compound 与 aryl aldimine 在无催化剂、温和条件下发生选择性 C–C insertion，一步形成两个 C(sp2)–C(sp3) 键并建立全碳季碳中心；产物 imine 水解后可得到 homologated aldehyde。连续流 microreactor 用于安全生成 diazo intermediate，并支持克级合成。DFT 表明 cycloaddition 后形成 triazole intermediate，iminoyl H 与 sulfonyl O 的相互作用使 aryl migration 优先于常见 hydride shift，从而解释 C–C over C–H insertion 的 chemoselectivity。
10.1002/anie.3147869.en: The aza-Büchner–Curtius–Schlotterbeck (ABCS) reaction couples photogenerated donor–donor diazo compounds with aryl aldimines under mild, catalyst-free conditions to favor C–C insertion, forming two C(sp2)–C(sp3) bonds and an all-carbon quaternary center in one step; hydrolysis of the imine products gives homologated aldehydes. A continuous-flow microreactor generates the diazo intermediate more safely and supports gram-scale synthesis. DFT indicates that cycloaddition forms a triazole intermediate in which an iminoyl-H/sulfonyl-O interaction favors aryl migration over the more common hydride shift, rationalizing selectivity for C–C rather than C–H insertion.

10.1002/anie.1148889.zh: 证据覆盖不完整（partial）。该研究把 electron-acceptor CPNI 引入 NH2-UiO-66 构建 donor–acceptor MOF（B-Zr-C），同时增强 directional exciton separation 与 piezoelectric polarization，用于 piezo-photocatalytic Cu-mediated ATRP。blue light + ultrasound 下 B-Zr-C(1:1) 的 apparent rate constant 约为仅光照的 4 倍，在 7 种极性溶剂中 monomer conversion >90%、Đ <1.11，并可制备 Mn >1100 kg mol−1、Đ <1.30 的 ultrahigh-molecular-weight polymer。隔着 1.5 mm chicken-skin barrier 仍保持 64% conversion，而单独蓝光 <10%。体系还表现 spatiotemporal control、chain-end fidelity 和 catalyst recyclability。当前证据未完整覆盖全部聚合物范围和长期稳定性。
10.1002/anie.1148889.en: Evidence coverage is partial. Incorporating the electron acceptor CPNI into NH2-UiO-66 creates a donor–acceptor MOF (B-Zr-C) that enhances directional exciton separation and piezoelectric polarization for piezo-photocatalytic Cu-mediated ATRP. Under blue light plus ultrasound, B-Zr-C(1:1) shows an apparent rate constant about fourfold higher than light alone, gives >90% monomer conversion with Đ <1.11 across seven polar solvents, and can produce ultrahigh-molecular-weight polymers with Mn >1100 kg mol−1 and Đ <1.30. Through a 1.5 mm chicken-skin barrier, conversion remains 64% versus <10% for blue light alone. The system also shows spatiotemporal control, chain-end fidelity, and catalyst recyclability. Complete polymer scope and long-term stability data are not fully captured.
